Fourteen years later, he arrives in Auran seeking a ghostwriter to reshape his crime-ridden past, as memories of his youth in Thiruvanjipuram - friendships, betrayals, and clashes with local goons - come flooding back.

Episodes.Title: Attack on the Cop
Episodes.Description: In 2004, a gold-smuggling heist leaves young Arikuttan scarred and entangled in violence. Fourteen years later, he arrives in Auran seeking a ghostwriter to reshape his crime-ridden past, as memories of his youth in Thiruvanjipuram - friendships, betrayals, and clashes with local goons - come flooding back.

Episodes.Title: Gangster take over Ponakavu
Episodes.Description: As SI Suresh recovers, Arikuttan and his friends are drawn deeper into revenge, leading them to Bonakkad, a criminal hideout with ties to their past. When a violent act changes everything, the boys commit their first crime and go into hiding, setting in motion consequences that will haunt them all.

Episodes.Title: Ponkashi Milk Mafia at large
Episodes.Description: After surviving a near-fatal shooting, Arikuttan finds himself cared for by his friends and SI Suresh. As Maniyan pursues music and love, Kanji enters PSC training, and Moonga lures the gang into a lucrative milk smuggling scam with Suresh at its core. Their newfound prosperity fuels ambition and reckless choices - from kidnapping a music director to brutal revenge on Senthil for misbehaving with women. But as the gang enjoys cars, cable TV, and influence, Inspector Stalin's pursuit puts a dent into their plan.

Episodes.Title: Goons take over the state capital
Episodes.Description: While serving time in jail, Arikuttan reconnects with his estranged father, forging an uneasy bond. Meanwhile, Senthil's wealthy plantation family retaliates for his public humiliation by sending an army of workers led by Muthuvel to Thiruvanjipuram, unleashing a wave of violence against local gangs. As Maniyan's dreams are shattered in the clashes and the city descends into chaos, unlikely alliances form, but peace only returns once the Tamil gang withdraws - leaving behind broken clubs, ruined friendships, and broken Thadippalam on the brink of demolition.

Episodes.Title: Cold-blooded Christmas
Episodes.Description: As SI Suresh plots to seize control of the city's flower trade from the powerful Pookada Vava, Arikuttan and his gang are drawn into a dangerous scheme of arson and revenge. Meanwhile, Maniyan's dreams of becoming a singer unravel in jealousy and violence, leaving Pranita devastated. In the present day, Arikuttan urges his ghostwriter to paint him as a victim, but the truth of Vava's death casts a darker shadow over his story.

Episodes.Title: Gunfires at the Festival
Episodes.Description: After the murder of Pookada Vava, suspicion falls on Kanji, who is arrested and sentenced, while Arikuttan rises in power, winning tenders and fulfilling his childhood dream of leading a temple festival. Maniyan finds fame as a singer, but tragedy strikes when Ramani, seeking vengeance for her husband's death, unleashes a violent chain of retribution. As betrayal, love, and ambition collide, Arikuttan's world spirals into bloodshed and loss, leaving behind only fragments of memory - and a half-finished book that may be his last attempt at redemption.

At the same time, Ji Hyuk feels lost and betrayed when his mentee, a known troublemaker on the team, is suddenly promoted thanks to connections in the company. Overwhelmed by frustration, Ji Hyuk submits his resignation in the heat of the moment.

Episodes.Title: When Everything Falls Apart

To Ok Rye, who is extremely worried about Ji Hyuk, Sang Cheol says she should forget about him and consider Ji Wan her eldest grandson from now on. Meanwhile, Seong Jae tries to comfort Eun Oh, who is deeply disappointed in Ji Hyuk.

Episodes.Title: Lost And Unfound
Episodes.Description: The family's anxiety grows when Ji Hyuk's phone number is disconnected. Heartbroken, Eun Oh throws away anything that reminds her of Ji Hyuk. Meanwhile, Sang Cheol's struggle to find work further damages his fragile self-esteem. Far from home, Ji Hyuk begins rediscovering a version of himself he'd long forgotten while fleeing his reality.

Episodes.Title: Under One Roof
Episodes.Description: Eun Oh is shocked to see Ji Hyuk return, acting like a completely different person. Out of the blue, he announces he's starting his own business and sets up an office in the cafe's storage room. As he settles in, he and Eun Oh constantly bicker over even the smallest things, testing her patience each day.

Episodes.Description: Jamie meets with a psychologist. He's reluctant to speak at first, but eventually he opens up about his complex feelings towards Katie.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: On Eddie's birthday, the Millers try to celebrate like everything is normal. But a series of upsetting events threatens to send the family over the edge.

Entries.Title: Ang Mutya ng Section E
Entries.Description: What happens when a girl joins a class full of rowdy boys? It's the notorious section E versus the fierce new girl. All Jay-jay wants is an uneventful and trouble-free new life at her new school, but Section E's grumpy president, Keifer, has other plans.

Episodes.Title: Welcome To Section E
Episodes.Description: What happens when a girl joins a class full of rowdy boys? It's the notorious section E versus the fierce new girl. All Jay-jay wants is an uneventful and trouble-free new life at her new school, but Section E's grumpy president, Keifer, has other plans.

Episodes.Title: Special Order
Episodes.Description: The troublesome section's crazy antics gets crazier after finding out Jay-jay's family background. And Section E's former president comes back to reclaim his position, and possibly get Jay-jay's attention too, but Keifer does not back down.

Episodes.Title: Band-Aid
Episodes.Description: Does absence really make the heart grow fonder? Days after the PE incident, Keifer tries to make up for what he did to Jay-jay with the help of Section E. But is it a genuine apology or is it still part of his plan?

Episodes.Title: After The Rain
Episodes.Description: Keifer involves the whole section E in his plan to make Jay-jay fall for him. Amidst Keifer's grand plan, Jay-jay spends a rainy day with the aloof Yuri and gets to know him. Will Yuri still be up for the plan after getting close to Jay-jay?

Episodes.Title: Love Letters
Episodes.Description: Jay-jay finds herself caught in trouble again after helping Mica, Calix's ex-girlfriend. In need of closure or perhaps a second chance, Calix and Mica finally discuss their ugly past, while Jay-jay and Keifer are on guard, not as meddlers... but possibly matchmakers?

Episodes.Title: Frame-Up
Episodes.Description: Keifer continuously annoys Jay-jay, who still has mixed feelings about their accidental kiss. The tension grows as Keifer starts to have conflicting feelings about his plan against Jay-jay. Meanwhile, Ci-N gets into trouble, and the whole section E comes to his defense.

Episodes.Title: Superhero
Episodes.Description: Jay-jay and Section E become Superman's unexpected heroes as they help him with his family's struggling business. And as they serve food and good looks, Keifer and Yuri go on a silent battle to impress Jay-jay.

Episodes.Title: The Suitor
Episodes.Description: Keifer and Jay-jay's bond deepens but Kiko enters the picture. However, an even greater threat than Kiko is about to disrupt their budding romance.

Episodes.Title: Positive
Episodes.Description: Section E goes to the amusement park. Amidst the fun and chaos, Jay-jay confirms that Keifer cares for her. Or is it still part of the plan? Meanwhile, an unplanned revelation about Denzel surprises Section E.

Episodes.Title: The Rescue
Episodes.Description: Ram abducts Jay-jay to exact revenge. Section E, led by Keifer, comes to her rescue. Amidst the chaos, Jay-jay's childhood trauma resurfaces, and Keifer witnesses her misery. Can Keifer rescue Jay-jay from her nightmares?

Episodes.Title: The Festival
Episodes.Description: Section E finally joins the festival and shows everyone how talented they are. Amidst the competition on stage, a more intense battle is happening. It's Keifer versus Yuri. Whose performance will capture Jay-jay's heart?

Episodes.Title: The Aftermath
Episodes.Description: Jay-jay learns about Kiko's evil plan and how Section E, led by Keifer, came to her rescue. Sem break approaches and Jay-jay finds herself confronting a scary feeling during a Halloween party.

Episodes.Title: Fight for Her
Episodes.Description: Keifer's actions confuse Jay-jay more. Amidst their push and pull, Jay-jay gets involved in Drew's mix-up with a notorious gang leader. To settle Drew's debts, Yuri steps in to fight and prove to Jay-jay that his love for her overcomes his past trauma.

Episodes.Title: Profanity
Episodes.Description: Jay-jay finds herself absent-mindedly agreeing to a silly deal made by Keifer. A kiss for every profanity. Meanwhile, Yuri makes a bold move to prove to Jay-jay that he is the right choice.

Episodes.Title: The Choice
Episodes.Description: Tita Gemma tells Jay-jay that the one who gave her the ring truly loves her, but Aries demands she return it. During Section E’s Christmas party, fun turns to shock when an unexpected love confession stuns everyone. Will this lead to happiness or another heartbreak?

Episodes.Title: The Engagement
Episodes.Description: Jay-jay gets the shock of her life when a simple New Year's celebration turns out to be her engagement party. Keifer shows up, confusing Jay-jay more. Will she choose to help her family, or will she listen to her heart?

Entries.Title: Kakushite! Makina-san!!
Entries.Description:
Eita Akutsu is a gloomy, friendless, and virgin mechanical otaku. Even someone like him has a girl he admires—Makina Agatsuma, the popular and glamorous “gyaru.”

One night, as Eita returns to his lonely apartment, he finds none other than Makina crouching in front of his doorway...

Episodes.Title: Makina Is Discovered as a Robot
Episodes.Description:
Eita Akutsu is a gloomy, friendless, and virgin mechanical otaku. Even someone like him has a girl he admires—Makina Agatsuma, the popular and glamorous “gyaru.”

One night, as Eita returns to his lonely apartment, he finds none other than Makina crouching in front of his doorway...

Episodes.Title: Makina Is in My Room
Episodes.Description: Makina Agatsuma is actually an AI robot created to captivate men. She immediately sets her sights on seducing Eita Akutsu to make him her pawn. However, Eita is extremely uncomfortable with anything sexual. On top of that, Makina herself is restricted from accessing sexual content due to limitations in her programming...

Episodes.Title: Makina Bathes with a Guy
Episodes.Description: Makina, armed with inaccurate knowledge about sex, tries to seduce Eita. However, Eita, inexperienced with girls, is too busy awkwardly trying to be considerate. Sensing a lack of progress, Makina, under the pretense of taking care of him, barges into the bathroom while Eita is taking a shower.

Episodes.Title: Makina Gets a Uniform
Episodes.Description: Eita Akutsu begins living together with Makina Agatsuma to help her maintain a normal life without revealing her true identity. Carefully avoiding the watchful eyes of their landlady, the two head to a park where Eita’s close friend Mamimi is waiting. There, they’ve arranged to receive a hand-me-down school uniform for Makina.

Episodes.Title: Thus, Makina Can No Longer Hide
Episodes.Description: Having returned to school life, Makina slips on a banana peel and falls. Eita can’t stop worrying that her malfunctioning left leg might fall off at any moment. Seeing his anxious behavior, Mamimi becomes convinced that he must be a dangerous stalker targeting Makina…

Episodes.Title: Thus, Makina Is Taken
Episodes.Description: Makina, whose mechanical identity must remain a secret, frantically calls Mamimi from her apartment to explain away the commotion caused at school. During the call, she starts making odd sounds due to Eita's ongoing maintenance, but somehow manages to keep her cover until the end. Just as things settle down, a mysterious girl suddenly appears at their apartment...

Episodes.Title: Thus, the Sisters Swap Places
Episodes.Description: Makina loses her body to her younger sister robot, Mimika. According to Makina, Mimika is an agent-type robot skilled at pretending to be fragile in order to manipulate others emotionally. To track down the now-missing Mimika, Eita proposes a strategy only a true mecha geek could devise.

Episodes.Title: Thus, Makina Becomes a Ghost Story
Episodes.Description: Shrunken down to a tiny size, Makina finds herself in a tense face-off with a now gigantic Mimika. However, she’s unable to make a move—Eita is being held hostage. Mimika threatens Eita, demanding that he perform maintenance on her. As Eita trembles in fear, Makina reveals a secret plan for a dramatic comeback.

Episodes.Title: Thus, Makina Shares a Kiss
Episodes.Description: After her dramatic comeback victory, Makina points her weapon at Mimika, intending to destroy her. Eita rushes to stop her, revealing his soft-hearted nature. Sensing this, Mimika cunningly seizes the opportunity and shows her true shrewd self. Moved by her act, Eita ends up agreeing to live together with Mimika. Seeing this, Makina becomes jealous and sulks...

Episodes.Title: Thus, the Weapon Awakens
Episodes.Description: Eita continues repairing Makina’s fragile left leg, but thanks to Mimika’s suggestion, they visit a riverside embankment that lingers in Makina’s fading memories. Meanwhile, Mamimi, still determined to take down Eita, encounters a new robotic warrior named Alma…

Episodes.Title: Thus, Makina Gets Covered in Burrs
Episodes.Description: After their riverside visit, Makina and Mimika return home in a panic—their hair is completely covered in burdock burrs! Meanwhile, Mamimi, now armed with Alma, devises a completely outrageous strategy to utterly defeat Eita.

Episodes.Title: Thus, Makina Does a Naughty Workout
Episodes.Description: As Eita and Makina head to school the next day, Makina, thrilled by the improvements to her left leg, can’t stop smiling. But in gym class, disaster strikes—soft tennis is on the schedule! Eita just wants to keep a low profile, but Mamimi has other plans, setting a devious trap that will drag him right into the spotlight…

Entries.Title: The Share House's Secret Rule
Entries.Description: After Ryota moves into a share house, he finds himself living with two gorgeous housemates. At first, it seems like a dream come true, but he soon discovers that the two girls are incredibly lazy! Ryota’s patience quickly runs out, and decides to leave. But before he can go, the two make him an intriguing offer: “How about a new rule? For every chore you do, you get to touch us for one minute…”

Episodes.Title: My roommates are way too cute
Episodes.Description: After Ryota moves into a share house, he finds himself living with two gorgeous housemates. At first, it seems like a dream come true, but he soon discovers that the two girls are incredibly lazy! Ryota’s patience quickly runs out, and decides to leave. But before he can go, the two make him an intriguing offer: “How about a new rule? For every chore you do, you get to touch us for one minute…”

Episodes.Title: Come on... Touch me
Episodes.Description: Taking advantage of the "Touch Points" system his roommates suggested, Ryota and Momoka begin to get a bit closer. But after things go a little too far, the atmosphere between them turns awkward. Has Kanade noticed what’s going on? Either way, she doesn’t hold back—leaning in as Ryota massages her shoulders, she whispers, “Come on... touch me. For one minute, you can do whatever you want…”

Episodes.Title: I’ll do it for you...
Episodes.Description: Ryota uses his "Touch Points" with Kanade, and before he knows it, the two of them start getting hot and heavy... Given the recent developments, Ryota feels the dynamic with his two beautiful roommates shifting. Just then, Momoka decides it’s time to join in on the housework, declaring, “I have points from housework too... Now I'll do it for you…”

Episodes.Title: I'm just working out...!
Episodes.Description: After things heat up between Momoka and Ryota, she starts to feel embarrassed and begins avoiding him around the house. Ryota then hears a loud noise at the entrance—it’s Kanade, stumbling in, clearly drunk! With no other choice, Ryota helps her to her room. But as they reach her bed, Kanade, still tipsy, looks up at him and pleads, “Hey… you’ve still got some Touch Points left, right?”

Episodes.Title: They might hear me...
Episodes.Description: After learning that Momoka is being followed by a male student from her university, Ryota steps in to help by posing as her boyfriend to keep the stalker at bay. Though the plan succeeds, the stalker lashes out, and Ryota ends up injured while protecting her. Later, as Momoka cares for him in the hospital, the two find themselves closer than they’ve been in a long time.

Episodes.Title: You've had too much to drink...
Episodes.Description: After the restaurant that Kanade works at becomes short-staffed, she desperately asks Ryota for help. To his surprise, he encounters a completely different side of Kanade—responsible, hardworking, and mature—far from the lazy person he knows at the share house. As the night winds down, Kanade serves Ryota a drink. But after some time, a tipsy Ryota finds himself getting closer and closer to her.

Episodes.Title: We can’t do this in a movie theater...
Episodes.Description: Ryota and Kanade’s passionate connection continues to deepen, and it doesn't go unnoticed, even by Momoka. Sensing the growing tension between them, Momoka decides to invite Ryota to the movie theater to find out how he truly feels. However, Momoka ends up clinging to Ryota in fear of the scary movie. Overcome by the sight of her vulnerability, Ryota can’t help but give in to the moment.

Episodes.Title: One minute... There's no way I can stop...
Episodes.Description: Ryota overhears Momoka and Kanade talking in secret. Have they discovered that he's slept with both of them? But as if to chase away his worries, the girls suggest Ryota spend time together in the living room, with a very specific idea in mind. “Tonight, we'll fulfill one of your requests.” Ryota finds himself faced with a big decision... “One minute... There's no way I can stop...”

Entries.Title: When the Stars Gossip
Entries.Description: Coming from two different backgrounds, Gong Ryong and Eve Kim embark on a space mission. But trouble strikes after launch, jeopardizing their expedition.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Coming from two different backgrounds, Gong Ryong and Eve Kim embark on a space mission. But trouble strikes after launch, jeopardizing their expedition.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Upon arriving in space, Ryong panics as Eve threatens to ruin his secret mission. Shortly after, a crisis emerges, forcing Ryong to attempt a novel feat.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Determined to carry out the secret mission himself, Ryong tries to circumvent Kang Kang-su. During a space walk, Eve experiences a sudden problem.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: With Eve's life in jeopardy, Ryong watches helplessly — as protocol prevents him from saving her. With every passing second, she loses precious oxygen.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Following Ryong's sudden confession, Eve discovers a hurtful truth unfolding back on Earth. Soon, she learns of an even more disturbing reality in space.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Eve discovers an unethical secret, forcing her to act decisively despite Ryong's objection — which drives him to take matters into his own hands.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: After Ryong learns the results of his experiment, a potential calamity approaches the crew — threatening his safety and the survival of his work.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Eve risks everything to heroically rescue Ryong, facing treacherous danger. However, returning home seems increasingly improbable.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: With Ryong and Eve stranded in space, those on Earth scramble to save them — albeit for different reasons. Park Dong-a steps forward to take the risk.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Despite their promises in space, Ryong and Eve return to earthly realities — facing duty, recovery, suspicions, confessions and lingering longing.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: While Ryong and Eve adjust to normal life, Chief Kang requests a detailed report of their time in space — leading them to agonize over their story.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Choi Go-eun confronts Eve after encountering her at Ryong's place. Chief Kang advises Eve not to see Ryong again — despite Eve's true desires.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Chief Kang summons Ryong and Kang Kang-su regarding their forbidden experiment in space. Eve uncovers a painful truth about her past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: A deployed investigative team discovers Ryong's cell phone in space — sparking an inquiry into who is responsible for the unauthorized events there.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: The consequences of the experiment in space finally manifests, leaving Ryong devastated. Later, Eve learns that her life is about to change forever.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: As Eve's new state prevents her from coming back to Earth, Ryong commits to joining her in space. Once there, they debate a risky return to Earth.

Kee gathers her courage, hugs her, and pours out her true feelings while giving her the engineering gear necklace. Peem accepts with a tender smile and seals it with a heartfelt kiss.

Kee tries to find Peem and learns that Peem's father is forcing her to date Poon, making Kee devise a plan to win Peem back.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: The Samed trip turns into a sweet escape for Kee and Peem, as playful moments and tender confessions lead to a magical night of romance bringing their hearts even closer than before.

Entries.Title: CITY THE ANIMATION
Entries.Description: CITY—something happens every day. Tsurubishi dives a crispy fried noodle into a customer's bag, while Nagumo witnesses it. An absolute, desperate situation! Matsuri and Eri enjoying their after-school adventures. Todoroki and Onikamaboko struggle to create a joke for "Rakutan-kun." Episodes.Description: CITY—something happens every day. Tsurubishi dives a crispy fried noodle into a customer's bag, while Nagumo witnesses it. An absolute, desperate situation! Matsuri and Eri enjoying their after-school adventures. Todoroki and Onikamaboko struggle to create a joke for "Rakutan-kun." After hearing Niikura's dream, Nagumo starts thinking what they want to do. Something starting to blossom in CITY.

Perpetually broke Nagumo faces off against Niikura, who just wants her money back. When Wako joins in, their chaotic campus life kicks into high gear. Meanwhile, the CITY Minami Eleven soccer team scrambles to protect their always-injured ace, Sasago. Todoroki negotiates the fate of Rakutan-kun—testing the bond between editor and author. And the sun sets on CITY.

With a performance approaching, Tekaridake Theater's leader, Tekaridake, tries to rally his unmotivated troupe. Sleepwalker Riko Izumi steals the heart of 16-year-old Tatewaku Makabe. Spring is just around the corner. Matsuri and Eri share kindness to protect world peace. Nagumo, Niikura, and Wako find a treasure map—let the battle begin! Another peaceful day in CITY.

Tanabe loves handing out awards for anything and everything, and now she begins the search for Nagumo! Tsurubishi visits the izakaya 'Yamabushi,' eager to get the iconic 'Boss! The usual!' and starts frequenting it. Niikura chases after a pendant that got caught on a 'Mimineko.' Matsuri and Eri embark on a big adventure chasing the Mimineko. The lives of each person intersect in CITY.

Nagumo is taken away by Tanabe. Their destination is the Tanabe Residence Hospitality Twin Towers. With the help of a kind person they meet along the way, Nagumo and Wako try to escape, but the guardians on each floor block their path... Meanwhile, Niikura continues to run recklessly, chasing the Mimineko. Disconnected dots begin to connect in CITY!

The Adataras' morning is always busy. Umi, Sora, Kamome, Tatsuta, and Ryota, all head off together as usual. An anonymous manuscript titled 'Kanki-kun' arrives at the CITY magazine editorial office. Feeling something special about it, Todoroki makes a proposal to Onikamaboko. At the riverside at dusk, Eri tries to convey something to Matsuri... The seasons of CITY continue to change.

Taking over for the owner of Café Yamabushi, Tsurubishi sets out to make the ultimate fried rice. With pride, he embarks on a journey to find the perfect ingredients. Late night, Niikura is struck by hunger and eats whatever she can. Meanwhile, Kuratake, the barber known as “the baddest guy in CITY,” been selling off gifts from his regulars. In CITY, there's no light without a little darkness.

A girl in love can't stop sighing. After 18 years of waiting for an invitation, Tanabe finally learns his crush's favorite food?! Tekaridake casts Nagumo as the lead in "Throat". Despite endless NGs, he powers through—and the curtain rises! A police officer becomes a fan of Riko Izumi. Tatewaku, too, ends up asking her out. Something is blooming in CITY.

The CITY race with a 1-million-yen prize is on. Nagumo competes against Obaba. Niikura aims to steal pendant from the CITY Minami Eleven. Tekaridake runs with a pair in tow. Matsuri and Eri move in sync. The Three Crows hold fine sake in hand. With surprises at every turn, the unpredictable race keeps everyone on edge. Who will win the race? As everyone runs, CITY begins to spin!

Episodes.Description: Banwari discovers the bike has been stolen! Bhugol and Teepu cook up a story casting suspicion on Amavas. The Sarpanch reaches Dhadakpur with good news. Banwari and Roshni question the prime suspect. Sparks fly between the two ex-lovers as they reminisce about their past. Roshni and Banwari return with no leads. Only 7 days left for wedding!

Episodes.Title: Oh Mere Jija Ji
Episodes.Description: Amavas decides to fulfill his duty of being a good ex-lover. Kuber arrives in Dhadakpur to check out his beloved bike. Banwari enlists Pandit and Bhugol's help to ensure Kuber is left in a tizzy. Madan discovers Jha family's secret. Banwari decides to do the unthinkable. Only 6 days left for the wedding!

Episodes.Title: Kanoon Ke Haath
Episodes.Description: ASI Mithlesh suspects something is amiss in Dhadakpur. He awakens from his slumber when he discovers it has something to do with his old nemesis Banwari. Amavas puts forth his plan at the village meeting. Madan is nabbed and taken to the police station. Amavas and Bhugol set off on a journey to save Dhadakpur's pride and Roshni's wedding. Only 5 days left for the wedding!

Episodes.Title: Piyo Magar Pyaar Se
Episodes.Description: Sarpanch questions Pushpalata about the rumours he's heard . Relatives arrive for the wedding festivities. Roshni begins to have doubts. Durlabh instigates Kuber to verify if the bike has truly been bought. Amavas shares his vulnerable side with Bhugol as they gulp down a few drinks and pass out while the second hand bike stands ready to be collected. Only 4 days left for the wedding!

Episodes.Title: Ullu Mat Bolna
Episodes.Description: Bhugol and Amavas have to perform at a special birthday party to pay for the bike. Roshni confronts Kuber. Madan finally gets his dream job but is in a moral dilemma. Frustrated Banwari reaches the cop station. Pushpalata announces a strict punishment at the village meeting. Teepu helps Nirmal with the cash for her treatment. Only 3 days left for the wedding!

Episodes.Title: Ulta Chor Kotwal Ko Dante
Episodes.Description: Mithlesh sets out to find the thief with renewed vigor. Amavas and Bhugol escape from Parmanu's clutches. Amavas is not impressed with Kuber. Pushpalata considers resigning. Mithlesh's investigation leads him to a suspect but just then Teepu reveals important evidence. Roshni's dilemma builds. Only 2 day left for the wedding!

Episodes.Title: Bhootpurv Premi
Episodes.Description: Nirmal is at the cusp of getting her treatment. Banwari struggles with the wedding arrangements because of the boycott. A crucial eye witness confesses to Mithlesh. Amavas confronts Bhugol about Kuber. An action packed scuffle threatens the arrival of the bike. The wedding party is on the way. Few hours before the wedding!

Episodes.Title: Atmanirbhar
Episodes.Description: The day of reckoning. Nirmal speaks to Pushpalata about the boycott. Kuber arrives with the wedding party at the Jha household but there is no sign of the bike. The wedding is in jeopardy! Mithlesh nabs the thief- but there is a bigger mastermind at play. Dhadakpur learns an important lesson that has a lasting impact. Bhugol manages to finally fulfill his dream!

Entries.Title: The Lady's Companion
Entries.Description: Chaperone Elena Bianda works to earn the trust of Pedro Mencía's daughters — and his attractive godson. At a high-society ball, things go out of control.

Episodes.Title: Lesson 1: Never Fall in Love
Episodes.Description: Chaperone Elena Bianda works to earn the trust of Pedro Mencía's daughters — and his attractive godson. At a high-society ball, things go out of control.

Episodes.Title: Lesson 2: Do Not Tell Lies
Episodes.Description: Elena tries to support Cristina in the wake of her revelation. Sara shares her secret. A face from the chaperone's past makes an unwelcome appearance.

Episodes.Title: Lesson 3: The Past Is in the Past
Episodes.Description: Both with ulterior motives, Gabriel and Cristina flirt with each other and confuse Santiago. Elena must confront secrets from her rebellious past.

Episodes.Title: Lesson 4: Ward Off Temptation
Episodes.Description: After a night of indulgence, Cristina pleads with Elena to talk to Santiago, with unexpected results. Josefina and Esther struggle with their feelings.

Episodes.Title: Lesson 5: Stay True to Your Lady
Episodes.Description: Elena tries to discourage Santiago's feelings while dealing with a rival chaperone. A betrayal surfaces during a séance. Cristina hears from Eduardo.

Episodes.Title: Lesson 6: Your Desires Come Second
Episodes.Description: Complications almost expose Cristina's secret, and Elena resorts to asking Angustias for help. Santiago battles with doubts about Cristina.

Episodes.Title: Lesson 7: Maintain Proper Decorum
Episodes.Description: Elena is stunned when her own mother tries to interfere with the Mencías, while Eduardo's return makes things even more confusing for everyone.

Episodes.Title: Lesson 8: Make Your Lady Happy
Episodes.Description: After a shocking revelation, the sisters are furious with Elena. A professional opportunity for Santiago prompts Cristina to figure out her feelings.

Entries.Title: Code of Silence
Entries.Description: A deaf catering worker who is struggling to make ends meet is called upon by a police detective superintendent to lip-read the conversations of criminals.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: A deaf catering worker who is struggling to make ends meet is called upon by a police detective superintendent to lip-read the conversations of criminals.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Alison's vital lipreading aids the detectives in uncovering the gang's plans, but she can only conceal her meeting with Liam from them for so long.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Alison's risky tactics identify the gang's target, but her deception and the gang's escalating violence threaten to unravel her relationship with Liam.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Alison joins Liam on a luxury trip where she scrabbles for clues about his plans while torn between her growing feelings for him and the police's doubts.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Alison discovers Liam's betrayal and races to stop the gang's heist - chaos erupts as lives are endangered and Alison is forced to confront the fallout.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Alison is reeling from Liam's betrayal and consumed with guilt over her role in the heist when her life is suddenly threatened by one of the gang.

Entries.Title: The Hooligan
Entries.Description: After an unfortunate run in with some of the Kosynierzy men, Kuba is lured into the security and camaraderie of Zyga's inner circle.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After an unfortunate run in with some of the Kosynierzy men, Kuba is lured into the security and camaraderie of Zyga's inner circle.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Michał begins to suspect that Kuba's loyalty to his club may get him into a spiral of trouble, while Justyna has a score to settle with a DNA test.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Recovering from his injury, Kuba struggles to separate the club from the man, and Michał fears for the safety of his family when the police come knocking.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: When Kuba's new allegiance to Kosynierzy comes under question, he must prove to them that he is truly one of their own... no matter the consequences.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: In the wake of tragedy, Justyna reaches out to Blanka hoping to right the mess that Kuba finds himself tangled in – before it's too late.

Entries.Title: The Ex-Morning
Entries.Description: After an angry outburst is accidentally broadcast live, Phi finds himself losing the support of his fans and colleagues.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After an angry outburst is accidentally broadcast live, Phi finds himself losing the support of his fans and colleagues.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: In order to repair Phi's reputation, he and Tawan begin producing a new program together. However, the two are challenged by the history that exists between them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Phi needs a team to help produce his show, but his colleague Tae is not eager to lend a hand.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Tam convinces Phi to return home to do a story on his mother's salt farm.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Are you sure you're not thinking about anything?

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: It's time to follow your heart.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Start over with the same person whose heart still loves you.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: A case of dengue fever lands Tam in the hospital. Phi stays by his side, providing diligent care as he recovers.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Tam and Phi find themselves stranded on a beach after a narrow escape during their investigation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: No matter what changes, my love for you will never change.

Entries.Title: Oh My Ghost Clients
Entries.Description: After a failed cryptocurrency gamble, Mu-jin finds himself jobless, broke, and separated from his wife. Urged by a friend, he studies and passes the labour attorney exam. With no clients and heavy pressure to succeed, he opens a tiny office but still struggles to pay the rent. However, an idea from Hee-ju starts to get the ball rolling.

Episodes.Title: Licensed To Fight
Episodes.Description: After a failed cryptocurrency gamble, Mu-jin finds himself jobless, broke, and separated from his wife. Urged by a friend, he studies and passes the labour attorney exam. With no clients and heavy pressure to succeed, he opens a tiny office but still struggles to pay the rent. However, an idea from Hee-ju starts to get the ball rolling.

Episodes.Title: A Ghost's Grudge
Episodes.Description: After a near-death experience, Mu-jin strikes a strange deal with a mysterious figure named Bo-sal. But in return, he begins to see terrifying ghosts with grudges. Haunted by the spirit of Min-uk, Mu-jin gets pushed to investigate the unsafe factory where Min-uk died. Gyeon-woo goes undercover as a new hire and meets Nimal, a migrant worker afraid to speak out, but as the truth surfaces, the team is exposed and forced into a desperate retreat.

Episodes.Title: Possessed By Vengence
Episodes.Description: To his shock, Mu-jin still encounters vengeful spirits and is even more stunned by the fine print in his six-month contract. His next case involves Cho Eun-young, a nurse consumed by revenge. Not only does she terrify him, but she also takes control of his body, unleashing chaos in the hospital as she hunts down those responsible for her death.

Episodes.Title: Behind Hospital Walls
Episodes.Description: Mu-jin and his team look for evidence to reclassify Nurse Cho Eun-young's suicide as an industrial accident, aiming to hold the hospital accountable for covering up suspected workplace bullying and medical malpractice. However, with Mu-jin blacklisted from the hospital, it falls to Gyeon-woo to infiltrate the facility and locate the one piece of evidence Mu-jin remembers seeing while possessed.

Episodes.Title: The Unjust Test
Episodes.Description: Mu-jin's father suspects his mother of having an affair and asks him to investigate. When Mu-jin visits, he encounters a ghost, a close friend of his mother, seeking justice. Following his mother to her university, Mu-jin uncovers a mysterious test that may explain the ghost's tragic death.

Episodes.Title: Union Power
Episodes.Description: With the protest shut down by police, Mu-jin and the workers regroup to form a union, vowing to fight to the end. However, when the university refuses to meet their demands, they have no choice but to go on strike. Just as the situation begins to look hopeful, they encounter unexpected backlash from students, prompting them to question the very cause for which they have been fighting.

Episodes.Title: Yoon-jae's Collapse
Episodes.Description: Mu-jin encounters the restless spirit of Yoon-jae in a hospital and discovers that Yoon-jae collapsed because of exploitative working conditions at a foreign-owned supermarket. With Yoon-jae in a coma, Mu-jin seeks institutional support and tangible evidence of employer negligence and must also convince Yoon-jae's spirit not to surrender to despair.

Episodes.Title: Factory Fire
Episodes.Description: When things look to be slowing down for Mu-jin and his team, a fire in a factory takes the lives of factory workers who all show up before him looking for help. As Mu-jin uncovers the extent of the factory's willful disregard for fire safety regulations, he realizes that the true source of the negligence lies with a more powerful entity, Myungeum Constructions. Determined to hold those truly accountable, Mu-jin seeks out the factory's figurehead for more answers.

Episodes.Title: The Flash Drive Chase
Episodes.Description: The flash drive and the witness vanish, leaving Mu-jin's case in shambles. Though morale is low, he resolves to keep fighting for the eight victims of the Buguk Warehouse fire. With Myungeum Constructions closing in and Mu-jin restrained, Hee-ju and Gyeon-woo race to recover the evidence. Will Mu-jin's final move be enough to turn the tide?

Episodes.Title: The Crumbling Truth
Episodes.Description: Mu-jin's push for a confession from President Kim puts everyone inside the poorly built Myungeum Tech Plaza in danger. As the structure begins to collapse, Assemblywoman Moon finally confronts the deadly consequences of cutting corners and vows to hold President Kim accountable. When a fire breaks out and all exits are sealed, President Kim is brought to his knees and forced to sign a contract for a second chance at life with the burning man in jeans.

Entries.Title: Station Cafe
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Hunting Party
Entries.Description: When a massive explosion at a top-secret prison known as the Pit allows notorious serial killer Richard Harris to escape, disgraced FBI agent Bex Henderson is called back into action to hunt him down before he kills again.

Episodes.Title: Richard Harris (Pilot)
Episodes.Description: When a massive explosion at a top-secret prison known as the Pit allows notorious serial killer Richard Harris to escape, disgraced FBI agent Bex Henderson is called back into action to hunt him down before he kills again.

Episodes.Title: Clayton Jessup
Episodes.Description: Clayton Jessup, a deranged serial killer who targets happy families, is on the loose and looking to kill again. The team must race against time to stop him before it's too late. Bex learns who she can and can't trust.

Episodes.Title: Lowe
Episodes.Description: In rural Montana, the team hunts down Lowe, a brutal serial killer obsessed with wolves. Bex and the team must track Lowe through the wilderness while dealing with local Rangers.

Episodes.Title: Doctor Ezekiel Malak
Episodes.Description: Dr. Ezekiel Malak, a hospital psychiatrist turned serial killer, is prowling for new victims in Chicago. Bex and the team work to find a method to his madness in a desperate bid to get ahead of him until Malak makes a move no one saw coming.

Episodes.Title: Roy Barber
Episodes.Description: When Bex and the team race to stop Roy Barber, known as the Couples Killer, before he strikes again, they uncover a chilling scheme that puts Roy's crimes in an entirely new light.

Episodes.Title: Arlo Brandt
Episodes.Description: Arlo Brandt, a hoarder-turned-serial killer, emerges from the Pit with newly found purpose. As Arlo hunts for innocent victims, Bex and the team must get inside a deranged mind.

Episodes.Title: Mark Marsden
Episodes.Description: Bex and the team race to catch Mark Marsden, known as the Widower, a handsome and charming serial killer who murdered three of his wives in cold blood. Everything changes when Mark decides to take a new bride.

Episodes.Title: Denise Glenn
Episodes.Description: The student becomes the master when an escaped serial killer from the Pit decides to adopt another inmate's style of killing as a way of paying homage to them.

Episodes.Title: Tom Beecher
Episodes.Description: Bex and the team hunt their most depraved serial killer yet, Tom Beecher, who seeks pleasure in other people's pain.

Episodes.Title: Jenna Wells
Episodes.Description: Bex and the team track the brilliant and beguiling Jenna Wells, the notorious Killer Chemist whose therapy in the Pit has made her even more dangerous and deranged.

Entries.Title: Beneath the Undertow
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Criminal Justice - A Family Matter
Entries.Description: Dr Raj Nagpal is found holding a bloodied body after his daughter's birthday. Officer Gauri Karmarkar expects a simple case, but an unexpected player asks Madhav Mishra for help.

Episodes.Title: A Birthday to Remember
Episodes.Description: Dr Raj Nagpal is found holding a bloodied body after his daughter's birthday. Officer Gauri Karmarkar expects a simple case, but an unexpected player asks Madhav Mishra for help.

Episodes.Title: Buried Secrets
Episodes.Description: Raj is denied bail for Roshni Saluja's murder. Madhav grows suspicious after meeting Anju and Ira. Gauri intensifies her hunt for the murder weapon.

Episodes.Title: Quid Pro Quo
Episodes.Description: As Raj stays in custody, Madhav's team digs deeper, uncovering new suspects. Meanwhile, Gauri intensifies her hunt for the weapon, but complications arise.

Episodes.Title: Domino Effect
Episodes.Description: While Madhav uncovers a new lead at Roshni's funeral, Gauri uncovers secrets about Roshni. Lekha Agastya takes over as the prosecutor, and Anju takes matters into her own hands.

Episodes.Title: Trauma Flashback
Episodes.Description: Kamala's memories reveal a new clue, giving Lekha the upper hand. As husband and wife face off in court, Madhav scrambles to defend Raj with mounting evidence against him.

Episodes.Title: Sins of the Privileged
Episodes.Description: With 2 days to prepare, Madhav faces Kamala on the stand. Lekha changes tactics with a surprise witness. Her closing argument casts doubt on the Nagpal family, pushing Madhav to the edge.

Episodes.Title: The Missing Link
Episodes.Description: As Raj's defence begins, Madhav calls a new witness. Meanwhile, Ratna and Deep uncover crucial evidence, rushing to court and shifting the trial's dynamics dramatically.

Episodes.Title: The Higher Law
Episodes.Description: As the trial nears its end, Anju's testimony unveils new secrets. A closed-chamber meeting calls an unexpected witness, and Madhav senses the case is far from over.

Entries.Title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms with Dignity
Entries.Description: While helping at his family's patisserie, Rintaro meets Kaoruko. He fears his appearance has scared her off — but she returns the next day to see him.

Episodes.Title: Rintaro and Kaoruko
Episodes.Description: While helping at his family's patisserie, Rintaro meets Kaoruko. He fears his appearance has scared her off — but she returns the next day to see him.

Episodes.Title: Chidori and Kikyo
Episodes.Description: Tensions between the two schools escalate during a commotion at Chidori's gates. Later, Rintaro finds a surprise visitor waiting at the patisserie.

Episodes.Title: A Kind Person
Episodes.Description: Desperate to improve their grades, Rintaro and Shohei cram in the library. There, Rintaro runs into Kaoruko, but their tender moment gets interrupted.

Episodes.Title: Warmth of the Heart
Episodes.Description: Though Rintaro becomes more comfortable with Kaoruko during their study session, he faces unexpectedly strong opposition to their growing bond.

Episodes.Title: Premonition of a New Beginning
Episodes.Description: Pressure mounts as Rintaro's friends discover a note from Kaoruko hidden in his notebook. Saku's frustration towards Rintaro's reticence grows.

Episodes.Title: Self-Loathing / I Love You!
Episodes.Description: It's an important night of confessions, apologies and cherished memories when Subaru and Kaoruko catch up at the park where they used to play as kids.

Episodes.Title: Coolest Guy Ever
Episodes.Description: Noticing Rintaro's strange behavior, Shohei, Saku and Ayato follow him after school and try to eavesdrop on his meeting with Kaoruko and Subaru.

Episodes.Title: The Meaning of These Feelings
Episodes.Description: Despite the awkwardness, Rintaro manages to introduce his friends to the girls. Later, Kaoruko makes a bold suggestion on how Rintaro could repay her.

Episodes.Title: Blond Hair and Pierced Ears
Episodes.Description: While Rintaro struggles with his tangled emotions about Kaoruko, he invites his friends over to his home — but two unexpected visitors shake things up.

Entries.Title: Hound's Hill
Entries.Description: After heading to Zybork for closure and to meet with his estranged family, Mikolaj and his wife realise that there are more unresolved traumas to face.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After heading to Zybork for closure and to meet with his estranged family, Mikolaj and his wife realise that there are more unresolved traumas to face.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Mikolaj and Justyna decide to extend their stay in the small town, after a sudden and mysterious death raises more questions than answers.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Some revealing texts expose the fragility of the couple's marriage. Mikolaj reconnects with an old friend who is less than happy to see him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: With an eye witness statement and his father hospitalized, Mikołaj begins to revisit memories of that fateful night, blaming himself for what went down.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Mikolaj is faced with the harrowing truth of what happened the night of Daria's murder. Will justice be served or will the darkness be buried forever?

Entries.Title: Newtopia
Entries.Description: Young-joo, who is focused on adjusting to her new job, grows tired of the constant complaints of her boyfriend, Jae-yoon, who's serving in the anti-aircraft unit at 77 A Tower. She breaks up with Jae-yoon, and he accepts the breakup with a heartfelt voice message. Upon hearing this, Young-joo heads to the tower to meet Jae-yoon, but on her way there, she encounters an unexpected incident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Young-joo, who is focused on adjusting to her new job, grows tired of the constant complaints of her boyfriend, Jae-yoon, who's serving in the anti-aircraft unit at 77 A Tower. She breaks up with Jae-yoon, and he accepts the breakup with a heartfelt voice message. Upon hearing this, Young-joo heads to the tower to meet Jae-yoon, but on her way there, she encounters an unexpected incident.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Jae-yoon and his direct junior, In-ho, head down to Eden Hotel, right below their air defense unit, for an errand. Upon arrival, they find a plane crashing into the heart of Seoul, and the hotel turned into a bloody chaos. Meanwhile, Young-joo and Jin-wook also confront zombies and team up with Tae-shik, who happens to be passing by. Together, they begin their fight for survival.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Soo-Jeong and chef Jung from the Eden Hotel, Jae-Yoon, and In-Ho manage to return to the military unit. The find out the base they thought was safe begins to face the threat of zombies. Young-Joo sees the text messages sent by Jae-Yoon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: In the midst of the zombie crisis, Jae-yoon and Young-joo reminisce about their happy past and long for each other even more. Meanwhile, Jae-yoon and his squad mourn the loss of their comrades but find relief in the news of a supply helicopter's arrival. Young-joo’s group encounters Tripeater, who has been bitten by a zombie but has not yet turned.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: After downing the supply helicopter, First Sergeant Jung Tae-hwa realizes that survival at their station is impossible. He plans to lead his platoon in an escape from the zombie-ridden A Tower. Meanwhile, Young-joo's group finally reaches the gate of A Tower, only to be greeted by a horde of zombies.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Young-joo is left by herself at the Express Bus Terminal Station, but a stroke of luck leads her to a metro staff office, where she gathers supplies to battle the zombies. Meanwhile, Jae-yoon's group reaches Eden Hotel, where they run into Arron Park, who has survived there alone. But the group gets split up by an unexpected attack by the zombies, throwing them into separate hotel rooms.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: On her way to Suseo Station, Young-joo meets a very special person, who helps her reminisce on the good memories with Jae-yoon. She relentlessly fights the zombies alone on her way to Jae-yoon. Meanwhile, Jae-yoon and the squad successfully reach the 35th floor through the ducts, but they must find another way down to the first floor.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Jae-yoon escapes the A Tower first and saves others with a brilliant idea. But they must endure another goodbye. In the meantime, Young-joo runs into people who are even more brutal than zombies. Will Jae-yoon and Young-joo, the two lovers fighting their own separate battle, finally reunite in this chaotic apocalypse?

Entries.Title: Stick
Entries.Description: Pryce is down on his luck when a chance encounter at the driving range sends him on a mission to secure the opportunity of a lifetime.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Pryce is down on his luck when a chance encounter at the driving range sends him on a mission to secure the opportunity of a lifetime.

Episodes.Title: Grossweiner's Law
Episodes.Description: Mitts and Pryce evaluate Santi's game over 18 holes. While testing out new clubs, Pryce tries to impart some wisdom about staying in the moment.

Episodes.Title: Daddy Issues
Episodes.Description: The gang hits the road in Mitts' RV. Pryce's coaching methods get tested in their first tourney. Santi makes a friend who unlocks his game.

Episodes.Title: Zero Sum Game
Episodes.Description: Pryce does everything he can to break through to Santi and get back to training. Zero is presented with an unexpected offer.

Episodes.Title: The Birdie Machine
Episodes.Description: Santi tees off at the qualifier with a new caddy as Pryce deploys covert coaching tactics. Mitts delivers harsh truths—and gets some right back.

Episodes.Title: RV Shangri-La
Episodes.Description: Ahead of the U.S. Amateur Championship, Pryce gives everyone a rest day on the campgrounds. Mitts takes a risk. Santi makes a painful discovery.

Episodes.Title: Dreams Never Remembered
Episodes.Description: After a blowup with Santi, Pryce is lost in thought about his past and what could've been. The gang prepare to go their separate ways.

Episodes.Title: Clark the Mark
Episodes.Description: A brazen plan is hatched to hustle Clark Ross. Pryce gets a chance to prove he was always the better golfer.

Episodes.Title: Showtime
Episodes.Description: Pryce tries to help Santi deal with the pressure of his first PGA tournament. Romantic sparks fly as Santi starts climbing the leaderboard.

Episodes.Title: Déjà Vu All Over Again
Episodes.Description: On the last day of the tournament, an unexpected visitor shakes things up while Santi's golf dreams hang in the balance.

Entries.Title: Unmasked
Entries.Description: Oh Soryong steps in a case, while Han Do, once a drama producer, joins the Trigger team.

Episodes.Title: In This Beautiful World of Ours
Episodes.Description: Oh Soryong steps in a case, while Han Do, once a drama producer, joins the Trigger team.

Episodes.Title: Setback
Episodes.Description: Han Do finds himself accused in a case and decides to track down the real culprit.

Episodes.Title: For the Loser
Episodes.Description: The team must catch the culprit before things take a turn for the worse.

Episodes.Title: Mighty Is the Camera
Episodes.Description: A suspect in a disappearance case returns twenty years later, seeking out Soryong.

Episodes.Title: Price Tag
Episodes.Description: A building collapses, and Soryong has an emotional clash with Han Do.

Episodes.Title: Dreaming of Love
Episodes.Description: A familiar face returns to Trigger after ten years, seeking help again for a renewed threat.

Episodes.Title: Inertia
Episodes.Description: A surprising confession unsettles Han Do and Soryong. Cracks form within the Trigger team.

Episodes.Title: The Vanished Witness
Episodes.Description: The team finds a new lead in a case, but the past is firmly sealed to unravel.

Episodes.Title: Cho Haewon
Episodes.Description: As Soryong hunts for answers, Giho throws the team into chaos.

Episodes.Title: Oh, Soryong
Episodes.Description: Soryong uncovers hidden truths behind the case from twenty years ago.

Episodes.Title: Trigger Unleashed
Episodes.Description: Soryong and Han Do dig into a vast conspiracy, finally coming face-to-face with a shocking truth.

Episodes.Title: The Confession
Episodes.Description: The Trigger team risks all to reveal the truth while fending off the villain's counterattacks.

Entries.Title: The Too-Perfect Saint: Tossed Aside by My Fiancé and Sold to Another Kingdom
Entries.Description: Saint Philia works hard to protect her country, but her "charmless" demeanor earns her nothing but scorn.

Episodes.Title: The Saint Who Never Smiled
Episodes.Description: Saint Philia works hard to protect her country, but her "charmless" demeanor earns her nothing but scorn.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Parnacorta
Episodes.Description: Philia tries to get adjusted to her new life in Parnacorta, while the locals try to get adjusted to her.

Episodes.Title: Our First Date
Episodes.Description: Osvalt takes Philia on a date around Almburg while Mia tries to learn more about her sister's departure.

Episodes.Title: Feelings Entrusted
Episodes.Description: Philia gets a new ally, and she and Mia learn more about the forces conspiring against them.

Episodes.Title: Golden Freesia
Episodes.Description: Philia takes on an apprentice and learns more about the pasts of princes Reichardt and Osvalt.

Episodes.Title: Reason and Emotion
Episodes.Description: Mia seeks to impart the situation's urgency to Prince Julius, while Philia and her new friends send aid.

Entries.Description: After receiving the shocking news of her husband Emmanuel Mijares' death, Daniela, in disbelief, heads to a mysterious mansion. She can't process what's happening, but soon, her best friend, Yuri, arrives to support her. Shortly after, Lupita, Emmanuel's secretary, joins them. But once Dulce, a woman no one knows, makes an unexpected entrance, one of Emmanuel's many secrets is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Lies
Episodes.Description: After receiving the shocking news of her husband Emmanuel Mijares' death, Daniela, in disbelief, heads to a mysterious mansion. She can't process what's happening, but soon, her best friend, Yuri, arrives to support her. Shortly after, Lupita, Emmanuel's secretary, joins them. But once Dulce, a woman no one knows, makes an unexpected entrance, one of Emmanuel's many secrets is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Jackals, Beavers, and Parasites
Episodes.Description: The war between Daniela and Dulce is inevitable. As they each recount their stories, it becomes clear that their memories and versions of the past differ greatly. As they reconstruct the events and try to make sense of Emmanuel's life, the rivalry and competition between them intensify rapidly. But tensions explode when Lupita, by accident, reveals that she, too, has been hiding a shocking secret.

Episodes.Title: Behind a Great Man
Episodes.Description: It's Lupita's turn to take them back to a distant past and unveil the hidden story of her life. As the others attempt to piece together past events and understand their own experiences, emotions run high, leading to a heated confrontation. And just when things seem like they couldn't get worse, Lupita confesses another truth that leaves Daniela completely frozen.

Episodes.Title: Quadratic Equations
Episodes.Description: As Yuri shares her own history of the past, we begin to understand how Daniela's arrival in her life changed everything. Daniela challenges and provokes her until Yuri finally reveals long-buried truths that break her friend's heart. And just as they think there's nothing left to say and are about to leave, Lupita drops another bombshell.

Episodes.Title: Boozy Night
Episodes.Description: The four women soon realize that six months before meeting in the mansion, they had all crossed paths in the city's hottest nightclub-El Patio. As each one recounts her night there, they start piecing together a series of coincidences and near-misses where their many secrets almost came to light. Meanwhile, we see Emmanuel Mijares playing a dangerous and risky game.

Episodes.Title: Nutty Night
Episodes.Description: As they compare memories of that night at El Patio, the four women truly connect for the first time. They all agree that from that night on, something changed in Emmanuel Mijares. Though they try to downplay it, they all stay on the same path. This triggers yet another explosive confrontation between Daniela and Yuri, one that exposes Daniela's long-hidden secret.

Episodes.Title: Confessions
Episodes.Description: With no choice but to confess, Daniela finally reveals her intimate secret. This sparks Dulce to do the same, unable to hold back any longer. Then Lupita follows, sharing things she never spoke of before. Finally, with great difficulty, Yuri lays everything on the table, forever altering her bond with Daniela. But in the end, the biggest secret of all belongs to Emmanuel Mijares.

Episodes.Title: Truths
Episodes.Description: Determined to uncover the truth, the four women set out to finally understand who Emmanuel Mijares really was and why he did what he did. As the pieces fall into place, they each face a final confrontation-not with each other, but with themselves. They must question who they are without lies or secrets and, most importantly, decide how they want to live the rest of their lives.

Sho Shinkai witnesses the destruction of a sacred artifact in the main hall of the shrine and injures his finger on a fragment he picked up. This was a sign of a quiet and strange occurrence. A few days later, rumors spread that a stone statue of a girl had appeared in the park. In response to this mysterious occurrence, Sho goes to investigate the rumor with his classmates Yoichi Fukazawa and Miyako Kujo to see if it is true. Is it a coincidence or fate? The "story" quietly begins to move.

Kujo Miyako, who seems to know something, offers to help Sho. As Sho and Miyako search for the cause of the fire, a supernatural being with the ability to freely control flames appears before them. Facing a threat that cannot be countered by common sense, Miyako activates her powers using an accessory called an "Artifact," which bestows special abilities. As danger looms, the two join forces to face the supernatural being. What fate awaits them at the end of the battle?

The two of them build a strong bond through their investigation. The night of the grand launch, where a valuable jewel is stolen, leaves Nilüfer at the center of all suspicions. The power struggles between Kaan and his step-sister Sevil drag Kaan and Nilüfer into a common adventure that will unite their destinies.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Saying goodbye to her ordinary life and stepping into the magnificent and intriguing world of the Lutesya Hotel, Nilüfer's dreams are turned upside down by the unexpected arrival of the hotel's mysterious heir, Kaan Tunca. The night of the grand launch, where a valuable jewel is stolen, leaves Nilüfer at the center of all suspicions. The power struggles between Kaan and his step-sister Sevil drag Kaan and Nilüfer into a common adventure that will unite their destinies.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: After their unexpected encounter in the royal suite, Kaan and Nilüfer fight. When Nilüfer says she doesn't want to work with Kaan, Sevil threatens to have her thrown in jail. Nilüfer forcibly enters Kaan's life as the royal suite's servant. Nilüfer is torn between Kaan's orders and Sevil's threats. On the one hand, despite Kaan's harsh attitude, she feels an unexpected attraction towards him. This situation makes Nilüfer a part of a dangerous game.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Nilüfer has convinced Gamze that Kaan is in love with her. Kaan assigns Nilüfer the task of keeping Gamze away. However, Gamze takes advantage of every opportunity to get closer to Kaan. Meanwhile, Kaan announces that 50 employees at the hotel need to be laid off. Tensions rise between Sevil and Kaan. All the employees begin to hate Kaan. Nilüfer comes up with a plan to save the employees from being dismissed. But nothing goes as she planned.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Kaan gets closer to Nilüfer after his panic attack. He tries to stay away from her by running away from his feelings for her. When Nilüfer is chosen as the face of the hotel, she gets involved in Kaan's Bursa plans and they have to travel together. This journey drags them into adventures they never expected. In the meantime, Gamze, who thinks she will go to Bursa with Kaan, is after them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Kaan taking Nilüfer instead of Gamze to the press conference leads to a jealousy crisis, and Gamze demands Nilüfer's dismissal. The tension between Kaan and Gamze escalates. As Kaan tries to rehire Nilüfer, a closeness develops between them. Nilüfer's unexpected encounter with Teoman adds a new dimension to the events.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Kaan tries to find out whether Nilüfer is engaged. Nilüfer, on the other hand, no longer wants to act as an informant for Sevil. A conflict arises between Sevil and Kaan that will determine their future at the hotel. Sevil threatens Nilüfer, demanding she get information from Kaan. As Nilüfer grows closer to Kaan, she begins to feel guilty. If she spies for Sevil, it will lead to Kaan’s downfall. Nilüfer is forced to choose between her feelings and her logic.

Monica was already struggling, and to make matters worse, the tea party announcement was made. Her group is Monica’s friends Lana Colette and Casey Grove, as well as Claudia who is an intelligent woman known as the “walking library.” How will the tea party and Monica’s re-examination for the ballroom dance go?

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: The orphanage director Maged acts as guarantor to get Welaa, Moftah, Almaz and Atayef released after they steal a bag. As Tahani decides to document the orphanage's violations under Maged's supervision, Maged threatens her to delete the photos, so she tells him that she sent them to the editor-in-chief.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Welaa and Moftah steal the editor-in-chief's phone on Maged's orders to get rid of the photos. Obaid tries to commit suicide because of Maged, so Welaa decides not to give the phone to Maged. Atayef tries to help Tahani escape from the orphanage, and Sahar refuses to marry Welaa, so he gets depressed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: While escaping from the orphanage, Tahani discovers documents that incriminate Maged, so she takes them to the editor-in-chief. Atayef tries to look for her after he becomes attracted to her. Maged asks Welaa and Moftah to go to Yassin Al Haddad's villa to steal important documents that belong to him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Welaa and Moftah bring the files from Yassin, and the editor-in-chief tells Tahani that he lost the data, so they quarrel and he fires her. Amina agrees to marry Khedr, and it is revealed that Souad is working for Maged. Welaa goes to Sahar after she agrees to marry him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Sayed rebukes his mother for her intention to marry Welaa, so the marriage is cancelled. Souad asks Maged for money in exchange for telling him information about Moftah, and Yassin agrees with Welaa to give him information about his mother’s location in exchange for recovering the stolen file.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Almaz decides to leave the orphanage after turning eighteen, and Welaa and Moftah take the children of the orphanage to an apartment they rented using Maged's money, but the latter follows them, which puts them in an unexpected confrontation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Maged rebukes Welaa and Moftah, takes the money, and returns to the orphanage with the children, but he discovers that the file that Atayef stole is missing. Atayef tests Tahani's loyalty to him by telling her that he will not give her the file, so she decides not to meet him again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Amina asks Obaid to stay away from her because he abandoned her under Maged's threats. Obaid tells Maged that Atayef is the one who stole the file, so Maged decides to take revenge on him by killing him with poison to make it look like a natural death. Moftah discovers that Souad has lied to him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Obaid decides to kill Maged, but he then backs down. Tahani asks Moftah to bring the file, so Moftah and Welaa grow suspicious of the reason for Atayef's death. Maged tempts Souad with money into driving a wedge between Welaa and Moftah, so she goes to confess her love to Welaa, and Sahar sees them.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: After Welaa and Moftah confirm Maged's involvement in Atayef's murder, they lock him in and decide to take control of the orphanage and run it, but Maged tries to manipulate Welaa's feelings, telling him that his mother is still alive and that he knows where she is.

Episodes.Description: On 7 July 2005, bombs go off at four separate sites across London, sparking untold devastation and the biggest manhunt the United Kingdom had ever seen.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: The clues take the investigation from London, to Luton, to Leeds, where the community is left reeling at the news — and the backlash from the media.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Two weeks after the bombing, the situation escalates yet again. Desperate to find the attackers, the police double down on their hunt.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The police are desperate to find the bombers, but the trail is getting cold. Until a call from a member of the public turns the investigation around.

Entries.Title: Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms
Entries.Description: Mona Kawai had never met a boy who could resist her charms. Enter Medaka Kuroiwa, who not only withstands her every move but also acts like he's disgusted by them! Is Mona's queen bee ego capable of taking no for an answer?

Episodes.Title: Can't Charm Him
Episodes.Description: Mona Kawai had never met a boy who could resist her charms. Enter Medaka Kuroiwa, who not only withstands her every move but also acts like he's disgusted by them! Is Mona's queen bee ego capable of taking no for an answer?

Episodes.Title: In Love with Him
Episodes.Description: Mona continues her attempts to charm Medaka, but she suddenly realizes that she might have competition?

Episodes.Title: School Festival with Him
Episodes.Description: It’s time for the school festival, and Mona is convinced that the event vibes will make her moves on Medaka more effective. Is she right, though?

Episodes.Title: Legend with Him
Episodes.Description: Mona and Medaka find themselves at the Bridge of Love, the location of the school festival legend.

Episodes.Title: Basketball Girl with Him
Episodes.Description: Mona and Medaka encounter Asahi Shonan, a strong-willed basketball star who seems rather confrontational.

Episodes.Title: Nursing with Him
Episodes.Description: When Medaka comes down with a cold, caring for him becomes a new battleground for Mona and Asahi.

Episodes.Title: Lockscreen with Him
Episodes.Description: A new battle arises over the fate of Medaka's phone wallpaper... and Halloween costumes for the girls.

Episodes.Title: Halloween with Him
Episodes.Description: Mona sets out for the Halloween party, her sights set on making Medaka's lockscreen.

Episodes.Title: Best Friend with Him
Episodes.Description: Tomo, Mona's childhood friend from Osaka, is here in Tokyo and ready to cause some chaos!

Episodes.Title: Theme Park with Him
Episodes.Description: The gang hits up a theme park for Tomo's welcome party, and she and Asahi both have plans afoot!

Episodes.Title: Alone with Him
Episodes.Description: Mona is stranded with Medaka at the theme park, leading to an important realization

Episodes.Title: First Love with Him
Episodes.Description: Mona is in love! How will this change the dynamic between her and the gang, and Medaka most of all?
