Entries.Title: Love Me to Death
Entries.Description: Elite office worker Masato Kamishiro (Hiroki Narimiya) and his wife Mio (Miori Takimoto) were living a smooth-sailing married life. But one day, Mio realizes that a photo sent by Masato, who was supposed to be away on a business trip, is an alibi photo he picked up from the internet. A hint of doubt is brought into their peaceful daily life. Furthermore, a "murder of a female journalist" has occurred in the neighborhood, and it has been making the news day after day with the culprit still at large. Something begins to fall apart behind the scenes of their happy marriage...

Episodes.Title: Bluebird
Episodes.Description: Elite office worker Masato Kamishiro (Hiroki Narimiya) and his wife Mio (Miori Takimoto) were living a smooth-sailing married life. But one day, Mio realizes that a photo sent by Masato, who was supposed to be away on a business trip, is an alibi photo he picked up from the internet. A hint of doubt is brought into their peaceful daily life. Furthermore, a "murder of a female journalist" has occurred in the neighborhood, and it has been making the news day after day with the culprit still at large. Something begins to fall apart behind the scenes of their happy marriage...

Episodes.Title: Beautiful Day
Episodes.Description: Detective Tomizawa (Yamaguchi Makiya) visits Mio Kamishiro (Takimoto Miori), who works at a patisserie, to investigate the "murder of a female journalist." The victim, Yuhi Minamizawa (Kumada Rinka), frequently visited the patisserie, despite not liking sweets. Furthermore, a mysterious man (Hosoda Yoshihiko) who moved into the room next to the Kamishiro couple has been watching and eavesdropping on Masato Kamishiro (Narimiya Hiroki) and Mio. Meanwhile, a new incident unfolds.

Episodes.Title: Beautiful Poison
Episodes.Description: Ayaka Koizumi (Miku Tanaka), a colleague of Mio Kamishiro (Mio Takimoto), is found dead. Pastry chef Joji Oyamada (Jin Katagiri), who had been threatened by Ayaka, is being investigated as a key witness in the murder of female journalist Yuhi Minamizawa (Rinka Kumada ). Masato Kamishiro (Hiroki Narimiya) tries to calm the anxious Mio, but behind the scenes he has been meeting with investor Masumi Nagano (Mariko Tsutsui). Masato's true colors are starting to come out...

Episodes.Title: Monster's Tail
Episodes.Description:
Masato Kamishiro (Hiroki Narimiya) and Mio (Mio Takimoto) promise to hold their wedding just the two of them on their wedding anniversary trip.

In fact, Masato has taken out a large amount of life insurance on Mio and is planning to kill her during the trip. Mizuki Segawa (Reina Matsui), a psychiatrist, is worried that Mio's dependency on Masato is getting worse. Meanwhile, Souma Ishiguro (Yoshihiko Hosoda), who believes Masato is the real culprit of the murder, travels to Kobe to trace the past of Masato, an orphan of the earthquake disaster. Why did Yuhi Minamizawa (Rinka Kumada) have to be killed?

Episodes.Title: The Beginning of theEnd
Episodes.Description: Ishiguro Souma (Hosoda Yoshihiko) visits Detective Tomizawa (Yamaguchi Makiya) with the interview data on Kamishiro Masato (Narimiya Hiroki) that Minamizawa Yuhi (Kumada Rinka) risked her life to obtain. The data reveals a truth about Masato that is hard to believe. Masato's past and true nature are revealed. What is Masato planning?

Episodes.Title: I Won't Kill You
Episodes.Description: The true identity of Kamishiro Masato (Narimiya Hiroki) is gradually revealed. Detective Inspector Tomizawa (Yamaguchi Makiya) decides to start the investigation into the murders of Minamisawa Yuhi (Kumada Rinka) and Koizumi Ayaha (Minamisawa Yuhi) from scratch. Meanwhile, Masato and Mio (Takimoto Miori) are preparing for their wedding anniversary trip. Masato's plan to murder Mio for the insurance money reaches its final stage. His former lover Nagano Masumi (Tsutsui Mariko) appears. Meanwhile, Ishiguro Souma (Hosoda Yoshihiko) contacts Mio and the turbulent final chapter begins.

Episodes.Title: For the One You Love
Episodes.Description: Masato Kamishiro (Hiroki Narimiya) and Mio set off on an anniversary trip to plan the murder of Mio (Miori Takimoto). Souma Ishiguro (Yoshihiko Hosoda) chases after them to stop them, but Masato notices them. Meanwhile, the police are in an uproar after it is revealed that Masato's ex-wife, Aya Kamishiro (Noriko Aoyama), was also murdered. Mio has complete faith in Masato. In an empty chapel, the two of them hold a wedding ceremony, but a desperate chase between Masato, Ishiguro, and the police begins.

Episodes.Title: The Man Who Killed Love
Episodes.Description: Mio Kamishiro (Miori Takimoto) and Souma Ishiguro (Yoshihiko Hosoda) desperately try to escape Masato Kamishiro (Hiroki Narimiya), but he gradually closes in on them. When they can no longer escape, what decision will Mio make? Where will the "ultimate love" of the murderer Masato and Mio lead...?

Hyun Joong offers to transform her life through intense training, but his brutal honesty drives her away. Still, his words hit a nerve. Can Hyun Joong change heartbroken Mi Ran's life and save the crumbling gym?

Episodes.Title: When Muscles Meet Meltdowns
Episodes.Description: Do Hyun Joong, a fallen bodybuilding star, now manages a rundown 24-hour gym. Lee Mi Ran, fresh off a breakup, mistakes it for a nightclub and ends up humiliated. Hyun Joong offers to transform her life through intense training, but his brutal honesty drives her away. Still, his words hit a nerve. Can Hyun Joong change heartbroken Mi Ran's life and save the crumbling gym?

Episodes.Title: Heartbreak Bootcamp
Episodes.Description: Mi-ran sets out on a gruelling fitness journey to win back her ex, and the entire gym gets caught up in her mission. Hyun-joong sees a spark of potential in her, pushing her even harder. But is it for her sake or the gym's survival? As every rep tests her spirit, Mi-ran must confront what she's really fighting for.

Episodes.Title: Mi Ran’s Training Crumbles
Episodes.Description: Mi Ran's intense training program falls apart and goes to waste after she breaks down in front of her ex-boyfriend. Despite achieving some results, including fitting into an undersized dress, Mi Ran quits the gym and demands a refund, leaving Hyun Joong frustrated. Meanwhile, Hyun Joong puts everything on the line to attract 120,000 new members to the gym, determined to turn the struggling gym around.

Episodes.Title: Pushed Too Far
Episodes.Description: Mi-ran struggles with harsh criticism from her visiting mother while Rosa faces pressure to prove herself in a bodybuilding competition. As Hyeon-joong supports both women, emotional bonds deepen—especially when Mi-ran comforts a drunk Hyeon-joong. Rosa overcomes injury and self-doubt to compete, rekindling her confidence. The episode ends with a shocking twist as a child appears at the gym, calling Hyeon-joong “Daddy.”

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Balder has kept his family's past a secret, even from his partner, Helle. At the baptism of his first child, he organizes a peaceful family gathering, but his plans get threatened when his father, Lars, shows up unannounced.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Balder tries to make the best of the situation, but Anne-Lise flees the scene when she sees her ex-husband Lars. Back in the happier '70s, Lars sends a photo of Anne-Lise's naked behind in a competition, resulting in a personal and domestic conflict.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Balder fails to stop Lars from telling Helle what he used to do for a living. In the 1970s, Balder and Bjørnar realize their father has put his marriage in jeopardy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Lars and Anne-Lise can't contain their resentment, disrupting the ceremony before it begins. In the past, Balder falls in love with a Danish nude model. Back at the christening party, Lars shows all the guests how his films are actually innocent.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: In the 1980s, Balder feels embarrassed when his friends find one of his father's films. Back at the christening party, Balder locks up Bjørnar in the basement when he threatens to disclose Balder's yet another secret.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Balder makes an aggressive attempt to finish the christening quickly. In the 1990s, Norway bans pornographic films, forcing Anne-Lise to return to her teaching job. Back at the christening, Balder finally loses it completely.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: The day ends and no baby has been baptized. Instead, Lars hosts a party on his boat, but Balder interrupts the karaoke to share something with everyone. Back in the 1990s, Balder and Bjørnar nearly escape a police raid.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The events of the failed christening have Helle ready to leave Balder, but he gets one last chance to make things right. In the past, Lars and Bjørnar are arrested outside Remy's sex shop with a van full of illegal porn.

Entries.Title: Anyway, I'm Falling in Love with You.

However, when she sees a group of high school students having fun, she recalls her own adolescence. 10 years ago, during her second year of high school, Mizuho had four childhood friends who she grew up with in a residential neighborhood known as Koigahama Highlands…

Episodes.Title: An Awful Birthday
Episodes.Description: July 1st, 2030. Manga editor Nishino Mizuho is having the worst 27th birthday ever. The manga she’s in charge of will be ending. However, when she sees a group of high school students having fun, she recalls her own adolescence. 10 years ago, during her second year of high school, Mizuho had four childhood friends who she grew up with in a residential neighborhood known as Koigahama Highlands…

Episodes.Title: I'll Be by Your Side
Episodes.Description: Kizuki, who Mizuho saw as the crybaby little brother of the group, has lately been hitting on her. Since Mizuho believed her and Kizuki would be childhood friends forever, she is not sure how to approach this situation. He's on her mind to the point where she seems disoriented, and even says something that could potentially push Kizuki away.

Episodes.Title: Warmth
Episodes.Description: Afraid of ruining their relationship, Mizuho tells herself not to fall for Kizuki. All the stress makes her ill, and her friends come to help.

Episodes.Title: Fireworks for the Future
Episodes.Description: After spending the day at the aquarium, Kizuki asks Mizuho to cheer for him at his swim meet.

Episodes.Title: How to Be Together Forever
Episodes.Description: As the fireworks are set off, Mizuho rushes to look for Kizuki. At the pool she runs into...?

Episodes.Title: I Don't Want to Be Just Friends
Episodes.Description: Mizuho is reluctant to visit Kizuki's house for dinner while her dad is away.

Episodes.Title: Playing Nice
Episodes.Description: Shugo's older brother, Togo, makes a surprise return to Koigahama Highlands.

Episodes.Title: The Shape of One-Sided Love

Episodes.Title: The Times I Spent With You

Episodes.Title: Impulse

Episodes.Title: Things That Change

Episodes.Title: Neverending Dream
Episodes.Description: Shin and Kizuki compete over Mizuho. Meanwhile she finds out the results of the Newcomers' Manga Competition.

Entries.Title: 7 Bears
Entries.Description: Snow White has moved in — and she won't budge until the bears help her reclaim her magic boots. The bears think their brother has transformed into a fly.

Episodes.Title: Snow White and the Seven Bears / The Seven Bears Not Dwarfs
Episodes.Description: Snow White has moved in — and she won't budge until the bears help her reclaim her magic boots. The bears think their brother has transformed into a fly.

Episodes.Title: The Dancing Potion / The Potato Touch

Episodes.Title: Stumblebumpskin / The Perfect Toast
Episodes.Description: The bears meet a naughty gnome who challenges them to a butt-kicking contest. A search for the perfect slice of toast puts Snow White in danger.

Episodes.Title: Bearpunzel / Princilocks and the Seven Bears
Episodes.Description: A bear's wish for a big, bouncy butt lands him in a tight spot. The brothers help Prince Charmless win the King's approval with a royal manners makeover.

Episodes.Title: Bearsel & Gretel / Jack & the Bearstalk
Episodes.Description: The bears hear a rumor that makes them worry the Witch wants to eat them. One bear gets the King's attention after eating magic beans.

Episodes.Title: The Big, Bad Favor / Basket Case
Episodes.Description: The bears protect three pigs — and a huge potato stash — from a hungry wolf. Red Riding Hood drags the brothers into her battle with the Big Bad... Jerry?

Episodes.Title: The Pied Butt Scratcher / Princess & the Pea-tato
Episodes.Description: Armed with a magic flute, the bears try to rid the land of itchy butt bugs. A tiny potato hidden under a mattress gives the bears a sleepless night.

Episodes.Title: Bears Vs. Dwarfs / The Bear in the Magic Lamp

Episodes.Title: The Bear Prince / The Ugly Guardling

Episodes.Title: Cinderella's Quiceanbeara / Puss' N Bears
Episodes.Description: Fairy asks the bears to host Cinderella's 15th birthday party. Then, Puss in Boots helps the brothers track down the mythical, magical... Crystal Potato!

Episodes.Title: Contact
Episodes.Description: Yoshiki and Hikaru investigate Nonuki-sama and its link to Kubitachi's history. While at the library, they get an important lead from a surprising source.

Entries.Title: Bet Your Life

Episodes.Description: Unable to pay rent and with debt collectors on his tail, Isa's crumbling career forces him to take on the mysterious murder case of a businessman.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2

Episodes.Title: Episode 3

Episodes.Title: Episode 4

Episodes.Title: Episode 7

Episodes.Title: Episode 8

Entries.Description: Meachum and Oliveras butt heads as the hunt for a DHS officer's killer leads Blythe's newly assembled task force all over LA… and ends with a startling revelation.

Episodes.Description: Meachum and Oliveras butt heads as the hunt for a DHS officer's killer leads Blythe's newly assembled task force all over LA… and ends with a startling revelation.

Episodes.Title: Dead Lots of Times
Episodes.Description: Blythe's team heads to Mexico to pull off a daring mission for a deadly cartel in exchange for information on the shipment at the port.

Episodes.Title: Happy Birthday Final
Episodes.Description: The team stages a high stakes prison break in an attempt to gain knowledge on the identity and whereabouts of the mysterious Volchek.

Episodes.Title: Bite 'Em Down
Episodes.Description: Still reeling from their loss, the team tracks down Timur Novikov's uncle, Mikhail… and hatches a plan to lure Volchek out into the open.

Episodes.Title: Blurred Edges
Episodes.Description: The team pays a visit to the Belarusian consulate in search of files that could finally reveal who Volchek is… and how far he's willing to go.

Episodes.Title: A Needle or a Bullet
Episodes.Description: The team follows a new lead out to the California desert, where their suspect isn't going down without a fight. Meanwhile, Volchek initiates the next phase of his plan.

Episodes.Title: Nothing Else Helps
Episodes.Description: While the team splits up to pursue a trio of new leads, consul general Astapov's security detail attempts to persuade Volchek to abandon his plans... by force.

Episodes.Title: The Nail in the Chair
Episodes.Description: The team races to try and catch Volchek as he begins to deploy his weapons of mass destruction around Los Angeles.

With their leader fighting for his life and Meachum's medical condition worsening by the minute, the team finally comes face to face with the true nature of their enemy's plans as time is running out to stop him.

Episodes.Description: The task force violently confronts Volchek to save a city of millions. As the smoke clears and Meachum works to resolve his medical issues, a new threat emerges from Secret Service agent Ryan Fitzgerald.

Episodes.Title: Run
Episodes.Description: Shepherd works to decipher the manifesto recovered at Cabin 6 while the rest of the team pursues a suspect on the run.

Episodes.Title: This Is His Signature
Episodes.Description: As another death ratchets up the pressure, the team makes a startling new discovery about their suspect.

Episodes.Title: Your People Are in Danger
Episodes.Description: The team zeroes in on a suspect and moves for a take-down... but soon find one of their own in grave danger.

Entries.Title: Ceylan
Entries.Description: Ceylan is a young, innocent, and loving mother who dreams of overcoming the hardships fate has placed before her, hand in hand with her son, Yusuf. While enduring the cruelty of her abusive husband, Necmi—whom she was forced to marry—she works, studies, and secretly saves money, hoping to build a new life with her son. But a ruthless scheme by Necmi pushes Ceylan to the brink of losing the only thing that keeps her going—her son, Yusuf. Determined to save her child and chase her dreams, Ceylan steps into the dangerous world of Bekri, a powerful underground mafia boss. There, she crosses paths with Ferhat, a man with a secret mission of his own.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Ceylan is a young, innocent, and loving mother who dreams of overcoming the hardships fate has placed before her, hand in hand with her son, Yusuf. While enduring the cruelty of her abusive husband, Necmi—whom she was forced to marry—she works, studies, and secretly saves money, hoping to build a new life with her son. But a ruthless scheme by Necmi pushes Ceylan to the brink of losing the only thing that keeps her going—her son, Yusuf. Determined to save her child and chase her dreams, Ceylan steps into the dangerous world of Bekri, a powerful underground mafia boss. There, she crosses paths with Ferhat, a man with a secret mission of his own.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Ceylan swears to find those who stole the kidney of her only son Yusuf, who is fighting for his life in the hospital, and to make him pay the price. Fate has given her son to her, but the fire of revenge has already fallen into her heart. With Necmi's mind games and surprises, Ceylan is convinced that Ferhat, who saved her son, is guilty and decides to confront Ferhat for revenge.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Just as Ceylan is reunited with her son, she faces the bitter truth. Ceylan needs to find money for Yusuf to return to his old life. Ceylan starts to look for a possibility in the impossibility, but there is no solution. Bekri, who comes close to death in a conspiracy set up by his enemy, makes an offer that will change Ceylan's whole life. Ceylan is on the verge of sacrificing her present for the future she dreams of with her son; she is about to step into a dark world from which there is no turning back. As fate weaves its web, will Ferhat be able to protect Ceylan in this dangerous world he has never known? How far will Ceylan go to save her son; will she be able to find a way out for the sake of the dreams she has barely kept alive in the darkness?

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Ceylan, who accepts Bekri's illegal job offer in order to cover Yusuf's treatment expenses, is determined. She risks everything for her son to regain his health. Despite all Ferhat's efforts, Ceylan does not give up; she cannot give up. Knowing the end, she steps into this dark world, hoping to leave behind the pain she has experienced and build a brand-new life with her son. On his first mission, he faces great danger and comes close to death. Gaining Bekri Vezirli's trust will not be as easy as she thinks. How will Ceylan cope with the darkness of this dangerous world she has never known? How will Ceylan's courage, who sacrifices herself for her son, affect Ferhat?

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: After passing Bekri’s ruthless loyalty test, Ceylan notices a suspicious detail about Bekri’s associates during her first mission. Though the dangers of her new job make her want to turn back while she still can, it's already too late. The dark world she entered to save Yusuf draws her in deeper with every step. Losing patience, Ferhat secretly works against Bekri—no matter the cost—to uncover the truth. As Yusuf is discharged from the hospital, Ceylan and Ferhat grow closer despite all the odds stacked against them. Meanwhile, Necmi, who narrowly escaped death, picks up right where he left off—making Ceylan’s life a living hell. He poses even greater threats and tests concerning her son and their future. Can Ceylan find a way out while fighting to survive on every front? And can Ferhat resist the feelings he harbors for Ceylan and her son while haunted by the ghosts of his past?

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Returning home, Yusuf confronts the childhood that was stolen from him, while Ceylan, surrounded by both her old life and the dark world she is involved in, tries to escape by taking her son and leaving everything and everyone behind. The more she struggles, the deeper she seems to sink. Ferhat tries to lighten her burden with the closeness he feels a little more deeply every moment, to make her believe that another life is possible, but in vain! He cannot break down the walls of Ceylan who closes her doors to love with the wounds of the past. When she learns about Necmi's illegal gold business, Ceylan finds herself in the middle of a new fire. Necmi is ready to make Ceylan and Yusuf's lives a living hell for the sake of money, without blinking an eye if necessary.

Entries.Title: Love You to Death
Entries.Description: Raúl navigates heart health...and heartbreak. Marta interrupts an awkward celebration. A sudden loss sparks an unusual connection.

Episodes.Title: Eros and the Funeral
Episodes.Description: Raúl navigates heart health...and heartbreak. Marta interrupts an awkward celebration. A sudden loss sparks an unusual connection.

Episodes.Title: The Date
Episodes.Description: Marta grapples with what comes next. Edu urges Raúl to loosen up. Things take a turn on a romantic night out.

Episodes.Title: The Art of Advertising
Episodes.Description: Raúl begrudgingly makes a bucket list. Marta struggles to protect her secret. Worlds collide on the set of a commercial.

Episodes.Title: Who Lives There?
Episodes.Description: Pressured by her parents to move out of their apartment, Marta bends the truth about Raúl.

Episodes.Title: Wasteland
Episodes.Description: Marta asks Raúl for a favor at the dealership—and finds herself face-to-face with Georgina.

Episodes.Title: The Shortest Night of the Year
Episodes.Description: Raúl and Marta's Noche de San Juan plans dissolve into disaster. A truth comes to light.

Episodes.Title: Until the Countdown Ends
Episodes.Description: Raúl prepares for surgery and sets out to tell Marta how he feels. Marta experiences a new unknown.

Entries.Title: You and Idol Precure ♪
Entries.Description: Uta Sakura lives in Hanamichi Town. One day while on a walk, she meets a fairy named Purirun. Purirun has come in search of Kirakiland’s savior called Idol Precure.

Episodes.Title: Cure Idol Debuts!
Episodes.Description: Uta Sakura lives in Hanamichi Town. One day while on a walk, she meets a fairy named Purirun. Purirun has come in search of Kirakiland’s savior called Idol Precure.

Episodes.Title: Am I Going Viral?
Episodes.Description: The Queen of Kirakiland, Pikarine, tells Uta about Team Chokkiri and their boss, Darkine. Meanwhile, Cure Idol is going viral on TV and social media as a “mysterious new idol.”

Episodes.Title: Have Courage! Cure Wink Debuts!
Episodes.Description: Nana, who is feeling down about a mistake she made during her piano competition, is invited to Uta’s family’s home, Café Glitter. Uta and Uta’s little sister Hamori cheer her up, and she is ready to do her best at the school welcome event…

Episodes.Title: The Legendary Idol?! Kaito Hibiki
Episodes.Description: Just like it did with Cure Idol, the word is spreading about Cure Wink. Meanwhile, another popular “legendary idol” Kaito Hibiki drops by Cafe Glitter.

Episodes.Title: We Got a Manager!
Episodes.Description: A man named Tanaka appears before Uta and Nana and says he knows they're Idol Precures. Meanwhile, a message arrives that says, “I want to hire the Pretty Cures.”

Episodes.Title: My Heart's Going Kyun-Kyun?!
Episodes.Description: Uta and Nana get to know Kokoro Shigure, president of the Cure Idol and Cure Wink Research Club. Purirun wants to become friends with Kokoro and follows her after school.

Episodes.Title: Dancing Heart! Cure Kyun-Kyun's Debut!
Episodes.Description: Kokoro is shocked to see Cure Idol and Cure Wink battle the Makkuranda, and runs away, saying “I can’t do that!” She tries to forget about the Idol Precures that she loves by putting away all her merchandise and dancing her troubles away, but…

Episodes.Title: Sleepover! Idol Precure Study Session!
Episodes.Description: Kokoro says she wants to study Cure Idol and Cure Wink, so they decide to have a sleepover at Uta’s house.

Episodes.Title: The Seven Wonders of Nana!
Episodes.Description: On their way home from school, Nana suddenly begins acting strangely. When she continues to say and do strange things, Uta and Kokoro start to count the “Seven Wonders of Nana.”

Episodes.Title: CD Debut! Idol Precure!
Episodes.Description: The Idol Precure songs are being made into a CD, so Cure Idol and the others start recording. But Cure Kyun-Kyun is so nervous that she can’t sing well.

Episodes.Title: Trio Dreams
Episodes.Description: Inspired by the school broadcast, Uta and the others begin to think about their dreams for the future. To help Uta, who is having trouble deciding, Nana and Kokoro begin “Uta’s Dream Search Project.”

Episodes.Title: Purirun's fan, Meroron is here!
Episodes.Description: A new arrival to Hanamichi Town from Kirakiland is discovered. Purirun says it’s Meroron, and Uta and her friends go searching for them.

Episodes.Title: Go! Go! Kirakilight!
Episodes.Description: Uta and her friends form a girls volleyball team for the school ball-game tournament. On her team is Wakaba, a member of the official school team. She’s in love with Shota, another volleyball player, and declares that she’ll tell him her feelings if they win.

Episodes.Title: Dear Mom, a Message from Kokoro
Episodes.Description: Kokoro’s mother has to work despite it being the weekend, and Kokoro sees her off. Kokoro buys her a carnation for Mother’s Day and has trouble coming up with a good message for the card, so she drops by Cafe Glitter to get some advice.

Episodes.Title: Operation Make Sissy Fall In Love
Episodes.Description: Meroron is jealous of Purirun’s relationship with Uta, so Uta and the others, who also want to be closer with Meroron, encourage Purirun to spend more time with Meroron. Purirun invites Meroron to dress in matching outfits and go on a date.

Episodes.Title: Full Bloom! Intensive Practice! Hanamichi Town Festival!
Episodes.Description: Idol Precure is invited to appear at the Hanamichi Town Festival. Uta and the others want to make the event a success, so they ask Tanaka to help them make an intensive practice regimen.

Episodes.Title: Purirun's Decision! Let's Go to Kirakiland!
Episodes.Description: Purirun desperately wants to help Uta and decides to go to Kirakiland with Meroron. Meanwhile, Uta and the others are preparing to go on stage at the Hanamichi Town Festival.

Episodes.Title: Who Are You? Zukyoon Through My Heart!
Episodes.Description: A mysterious duo has suddenly appeared: Cure Zukyoon and Cure Kiss. Uta wakes up in the middle of a dream about Cure Zukyoon, and even at school her head is full of Cure Zukyoon all day. Kokoro sees this and determines that Uta has become a fan of Cure Zukyoon.

Episodes.Title: The Pair's Vow! Cure Zukyoon and Cure Kiss Debut!
Episodes.Description: Cure Idol and her friends chase after Cure Zukyoon and Cure Kiss but lose sight of them. Sometime later, a magazine reporter who wants to learn the truth about the duo appears, and Uta and the others offer to help.

Episodes.Title: Puri! A Picnic to Find Memories!
Episodes.Description: Uta and the others learn that Purirun gave up all their memories of them to become a Precure. Uta and the others invite the fairies on a picnic to try to recover Purirun's memories.

Episodes.Title: Super-Duper! A Miracle in Unison!
Episodes.Description: Uta, who fainted due to a cold, gets upset and cries about how Purirun's memories aren't returning. But once she feels better, she visits Purirun and proposes they make new memories together, and they begin taking selfies.

Episodes.Title: Idol Precure VS ZukyoonKiss?!
Episodes.Description: Idol Precure and ZukyoonKiss are hired for a promotional campaign showdown at Pretty Holic. But Meroron sees Purirun’s usual carefree attitude and comes up with an idea…

Episodes.Title: This Is My Signature!
Episodes.Description: The Precures are asked to sign a present for a fan, and they realize they’ve never made their own signatures. At that moment, they hear the news that Kaito Hibiki has resumed his activities.

Episodes.Title: Tanakhan's Summer Holiday!
Episodes.Description: When Uta and the others learn that Tanaka hasn’t taken a summer holiday in years, they offer to do his usual jobs for him so he can rest. But when faced with a sudden day off, he’s not sure what to do with himself.

Episodes.Title: Wink in a Field of Sunflowers
Episodes.Description: Thanks to an idea from Nana, they decide to visit some sunflower fields. Nana enjoys the vast expanses of blooming sunflowers, but she can’t stop worrying about Zakkuri.

Episodes.Title: The Kyun-er the Better!
Episodes.Description: They decide to create an Idol Precure and ZukyoonKiss fanclub and Kokoro works especially hard at it. While answering a question about favorite sayings for the fanclub newsletter, Kokoro remembers something from her early years.

Episodes.Title: Let's all have Kyun-Kyun hearts together!
Episodes.Description: As the Idol Precure and ZukyoonKiss Fanclub gains momentum, Uta and the others decide to begin making videos for their fans on their CureTube channel. Then, at school check-in day during their summer holidays, Uta receives a letter.

Episodes.Title: Woof Woof! Together with Kyu-Chan!
Episodes.Description: Uta and the others visit Grandpa Heiji Sakura’s house. They bring the family dog, Kyutaro, along and when something makes Uta feel lonely, he wants to help cheer her up.

Episodes.Title: Meroron's Friend
Episodes.Description: In response to a fan question, Idol Precure say, “We are all friends.” However, Cure Kiss can’t accept those words and takes Cure Zukyoon away, saying, “We’re not friends.”

Episodes.Title: Precure! Kirakkiran for You!
Episodes.Description: Meroron is locked in a dark capsule generated by the legendary Heart Kirari Lock. Uta and the others call Pikarine and ask about the most precious thing that Meroron locked away.

Episodes.Title: Who's the Center of Idol Precure?!

Entries.Title: Safe Harbor
Entries.Description: Marco and his best friend Tobias are hackers and dream of big money. When they come into contact with Sloane and her brother Farrell, members of the infamous Irish mafia Walsh family, they devise a plan to illegally gain access to the Rotterdam port system in order to control container routes. When things don't go as planned, Marco ends up with Farrell's gun to his head.

Episodes.Title: The Pony
Episodes.Description: Marco and his best friend Tobias are hackers and dream of big money. When they come into contact with Sloane and her brother Farrell, members of the infamous Irish mafia Walsh family, they devise a plan to illegally gain access to the Rotterdam port system in order to control container routes. When things don't go as planned, Marco ends up with Farrell's gun to his head.

Episodes.Title: For The Birds
Episodes.Description: The mission didn't go as planned, but Sloane is confident they are on the right track. She asks Marco to help them again. Marco is reluctant, but agrees. Toby is enthusiastic and thinks he has solved the problem with the pony. The next problem arises when Marco is linked by the police to the truck accident.

Episodes.Title: Joint Venture
Episodes.Description: The second operation is a great success. Sloane wants a permanent partnership with Marco and Toby. Toby enjoys the wealth and can finally pay Rika back. When Marco is on his way to an appointment with Sloane, he is followed by the police. The situation escalates when Oncko and his motorcycle gang also arrive at the location.

Episodes.Title: Love Of The Irish
Episodes.Description: Nothing seems to be able to stop Marco anymore. But when Toby discovers who they really work for, it creates tension. Marco is appointed Chief Technology Officer of the Irish mafia by Sloane.

Episodes.Title: Massacre On Valentine's Day
Episodes.Description: Now that the port of Rotterdam is being monitored more than ever by the police, Sloane and Marco come up with new ways to bring in the drugs. Marco suggests exchanging Rotterdam for the port of Antwerp.

Episodes.Title: Antwerp
Episodes.Description: After the break with Rika, Toby is back. Sloane senses too much self-confidence in Marco and puts him back down to earth. Toby manages to set up the pony in Antwerp. Just when everything seems to be going well, a shipment is stolen. Toby manages to track down the cargo, but when they want to retrieve the cargo, a fierce confrontation ensues.

Episodes.Title: Lull Before The Storm
Episodes.Description: After the break with Rika, Toby is back and wants to be part of the company. Marco's plan makes the operations more profitable than ever. Even Oncko wants to discuss a possible collaboration. When Toby is shot and hospitalized, Sloane asks her father Kieran for help.

Episodes.Title: Shipment Showdown
Episodes.Description: Now that Kieran is in Rotterdam, things are heating up between the Irish and Oncko's gang. Marco is relieved when Toby wakes up. The next operation will be bigger than ever and he can use Toby's help.

Episodes.Title: Blood Bath
Episodes.Description: Thirty years ago, a newlywed couple were murdered at the Cold River Motel in a satanic ritual; a group of true crime enthusiasts have been invited to the motel's reopening, where they discover history might be repeating itself.

Episodes.Description: Trapped by the raging storm and unable to call for help, the guests retreat to their rooms, uncertain who among them is the killer. Meanwhile, two strangers seeking shelter hide their true identities from the others.

Episodes.Title: Grand Guignol

Entries.Title: The Proper Way to Write Love

Episodes.Title: How to Reunite
Episodes.Description: A former school bully shows up at Hiro's salon and suddenly confesses his love. So Hiro agrees to date him—just to get revenge. But waking up to find him already in his room? That wasn't part of the plan.

Episodes.Title: How to Take Revenge
Episodes.Description: Hiro reluctantly agrees to go on a date with the persistent Natsuo planning to make it the “perfect” revenge date. But nothing goes as planned—until an unexpected stop at a flower park brings back old memories… and unexpected feelings.

Episodes.Title: How to Confront
Episodes.Description: Hiro and Kiryu must face off in a test to represent their company. Confident at first, Hiro starts to feel the pressure after seeing Kiryu’s detailed hair designs. Then, Kiryu shows up at Hiro’s place unannounced...

Episodes.Title: How to Give a Gift
Episodes.Description: After the contest, Hiro agrees to reward Natsuo with a date. Expecting something outrageous, he's surprised by a simple walk. But when Natsuo gets too close and Hiro pushes him away, the date takes an unexpected turn—leaving Hiro with a sudden realization.

Episodes.Title: How to Deal with a Rival in Love
Episodes.Description: On his birthday, Hiro grants Natsuki’s wish for a kiss. The next day, he feels uneasy when Oribe, Natsuki’s former crush, asks to be alone with him. The tension grows when Natsuki calls Oribe “fragile, unlike Hiro.”

Episodes.Title: How to Hide an Injury
Episodes.Description: Hiro learns he was Natsuo’s first love and can’t stop thinking about it. Distracted, he gets hurt, and Natsuo shows up to care for him. Living under the same roof brings them closer—until news from the hospital changes everything.

Episodes.Title: How to Face the Past
Episodes.Description: Hiro gives Natsuo a spare key, but a reunion invite stirs painful memories. Refusing to go, Hiro leaves for work—until Natsuo, staying behind, makes a discovery that could change everything.

Episodes.Title: The Proper Way to Write Love
Episodes.Description: Hiro reveals to Natsuo that he had been dating him as part of a high school revenge plan, leaving Natsuo shocked. While apart, Hiro takes on cutting popular influencer RaMu’s hair—but an accident news from Aoi changes everything…

Entries.Title: Shifting Gears
Entries.Description: Widowed car restoration shop owner Matt is forced to confront his estranged daughter, when she and her children move in with him, creating a major upheaval in his life as he navigates the challenges or reconnecting with his family while restoring classic cars in his garage.

Episodes.Title: Restoration
Episodes.Description: Widowed car restoration shop owner Matt is forced to confront his estranged daughter, when she and her children move in with him, creating a major upheaval in his life as he navigates the challenges or reconnecting with his family while restoring classic cars in his garage.

Episodes.Title: Accommodations
Episodes.Description: Matt joins Riley at Carter's high school open house, where he's unsettled to learn about the "accommodations" made for his grandson's anxiety. Meanwhile, Riley reconnects with Caitlin, a former classmate, and sets her up with Gabriel.

Episodes.Title: Job
Episodes.Description: Riley, desperate for work, reluctantly takes a job at Matt's shop; Gabriel and Stitch secretly stray from Matt's vision on a high-stakes restomod project.

Episodes.Title: Grief
Episodes.Description: When Riley discovers a closet filled with her late mother’s clothes, she insists Matt hasn’t processed her death and urges him to see a grief counselor. Meanwhile, Gabriel faces a crisis of confidence when he’s put in charge of the shop for a day.

Episodes.Title: Jimmy
Episodes.Description: Riley’s estranged husband, Jimmy, shows up to win her back, much to Matt’s dismay. While Matt struggles to get through to him, Riley finds support in an unexpected place.

Episodes.Title: Valentine's
Episodes.Description: A Valentine's Day visit to his late wife's grave sparks an unexpected connection for Matt in an unlikely place; Riley is thrust into the spotlight for a promotional video at the dance studio.

Episodes.Title: Picnic
Episodes.Description: The feud between Parker Customs and Premiere Dance Lab heats up when Matt confronts the owner over a picnic table placed in the shared alleyway; Carter's need for "me time" sparks a conversation with Matt.

Episodes.Title: Career
Episodes.Description: Georgia invites Matt and Riley to speak at her school's Career Day, where playful competition turns tense when Riley learns Georgia is ashamed of her job; Gabriel mentors Carter's car project until a more urgent piece of business arises.

Episodes.Title: Gummies
Episodes.Description: Riley is horrified when she finds weed gummies in Carter’s pocket, prompting surprising advice from Matt. Meanwhile, Eve inadvertently lands Gabriel and Stitch in hot water after asking them to donate to a charity auction.

Episodes.Title: Kiss
Episodes.Description: Riley is torn between her past and her future.

Entries.Title: MIRU: Paths to My Future
Entries.Description: Yoshimura, a space janitor who has spent 10 years collecting space debris is urged to retire by his boss, due to advances in AI technology. His replacement is a young pilot named Umi. While Umi takes her training seriously, Yoshimura remains unmotivated. However, the two soon find themselves facing a critical emergency.

Episodes.Title: Episode 079: Stardust ‌Memory
Episodes.Description: Yoshimura, a space janitor who has spent 10 years collecting space debris is urged to retire by his boss, due to advances in AI technology. His replacement is a young pilot named Umi. While Umi takes her training seriously, Yoshimura remains unmotivated. However, the two soon find themselves facing a critical emergency.

Episodes.Title: Episode 101: The ‌King ‌of ‌the ‌Forest
Episodes.Description: Mario, who lives in a tropical rainforest, works as a tour guide, spending his days leading tourists through the forest. However, the forest has gradually changed since he was a child. Then one day, he stumbles upon an illegal gold mining site…

Episodes.Title: Episode 217: Londonderry Air
Episodes.Description: Ame attends music school, pursuing her dream of becoming a professional pianist. While she works at a construction site to pay for her tuition, her secret joy is playing a public piano on a street corner. One day, her piano skills are noticed, and she is invited to participate in an AI demonstration experiment…

Episodes.Title: Episode 630: Re: MIRU
Episodes.Description: In a world plagued by division, conflict, and worsening global warming, a young diplomat, Toshi, returns home after successfully brokering a peace negotiation. But his moment of relief is short-lived, as news of the negotiation’s collapse plunges him into despair. Exhausted and wandering the streets aimlessly, he is unexpectedly saved by an unremarkable, middle-aged man.

Episodes.Title: Episode 926: Wait, I’ll Be There
Episodes.Description: In a frozen post-apocalyptic world, Airu travels with her companion Pochimaru. Their mission is to travel the world making flowers bloom using the “magic sand” left behind by her mother, a botanist. Deep in a mountain of dead trees, they meet Izumif, a boy who says he’s from the distant future…

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the murderous party File 1
Episodes.Description: Wealthy heiress Reiko Hosho leads a double life as a novice detective. One day, an incident erupts at a birthday party she attends with friends from her college days. The victim is one of her old classmates, and Reiko's friends are labeled as suspects for matching the attacker's description. Stirring in confusion with only 20 minutes to solve the case, a man suddenly appears to reveal the culprit.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the murderous party File 2 / Here's a message from the dead File 1
Episodes.Description: Mystery butler Kageyama concocts a peculiar plan to catch the criminal lurking in a luxury hotel, after which Reiko and her friends realize the hidden complexity of their own emotions. Reiko then tackles the murder case of a real estate tycoon. Each of the victim's relatives harbor suspicious motives to kill, but a single photograph proves essential in accelerating this perplexing investigation.

Episodes.Title: Here's a message from the dead File 2
Episodes.Description: While investigating the murder of a real estate tycoon, Reiko examines an erased dying message, a bloody trophy, and a cord yanked from the curtains. Without proof, however, she reaches a dead end...until savage butler Kageyama emerges to solve the mystery. Reiko and Kyoichiro think outside the box to trap the murderer, peek inside the victim's mindset, and end a chain of events fueled by revenge.

Episodes.Title: Please be aware of two-timing affairs File 1
Episodes.Description: With Kageyama as her chauffeur, Reiko and her friends visit a crowded summer festival, where a cracked smartphone is discovered. Its owner was poisoned in his apartment, and he died wearing nothing but briefs. Three women the victim dated simultaneously on a matching app fail to match the height of a suspect seen exiting his residence, which leaves Reiko puzzled at the true culprit's identity.

Episodes.Title: Please be aware of two-timing affairs File 2 / The person who dropped it is a VTuber File 1
Episodes.Description: Women of differing heights are spotted at the crime scene. Kageyama suspects that elevator shoes disguised the murderer's appearance. After learning that the victim had scammed several women via dating apps, Reiko inches closer to the truth. Later, a delivery man is found dead with an item belonging to his favorite VTuber, and it's discovered that the two even frequented the same hospital.

Episodes.Title: The person who dropped it is a VTuber File 2
Episodes.Description: After a delivery man falls to his death, Reiko and Kyoichiro investigate his connection to popular VTuber "Kuru Kuru-Chan," who is blamed for the murder by fans online. Kageyama assists in analyzing a mystery figure planting bugs, untouched food deliveries, and hints to the true culprit left at the crime scene. The victim leaves a note reading, "I've had enough of this world," but in what context?

Episodes.Title: There is no such thing as a completely locked room File 1
Episodes.Description: A famous painter is stabbed in his own studio, pointing to his masterpiece wall painting "Sleeping Beauty" just before dying. Suspects include his art-jacking son, his second wife, and an art magazine writer with whom he supposedly had an affair. Reiko and Kyoichiro investigate how the killer escaped a locked studio, eventually learning of the victim's connection to a certain "Appraisal Queen."

Episodes.Title: There is no such thing as a completely locked room File 2 / Please don't drown in this river File 1
Episodes.Description: Kageyama locates a secret passageway to solve the locked-room murder mystery. Upon encountering a deranged woman wielding a knife, Reiko is left with nowhere to escape. On the next case, a white-suited journalist's body is discovered by the river. Despite being dry, his cause of death is drowning. With debts to pay, he had targeted a well-known "Shaketopia" actress whom Reiko adored as a child.

Episodes.Title: Please don't drown in this river File 2
Episodes.Description: Journalist Ryota Ishiguro's body is found on the riverbank, but although the cause of his death is drowning, the body is dry. Reiko's investigations lead her to Shiho and Satoshi Kambara, a loving couple from whom Ishiguro had been demanding money, but they claim to have an alibi. The discovery of a silver spoon with the engraving "Shiho to Leo" takes the case in an unexpected direction.

Episodes.Title: Murder lies in a beautiful rose
Episodes.Description: A woman's body is found in a bed of blooming roses at the prestigious Fujikura residence. The victim is Toshio Fujikura's fiancée, and the suspects include members of the family. Reiko, who happens to be their neighbor, is fearful that her identity will be exposed. As the investigation continues, they discover that the victim's pet cat is missing, which may be a key to solving the case.

Episodes.Title: The bride is behind locked doors
Episodes.Description: Reiko attends the wedding of Sawamura Yuri, who she cherishes like a younger sister. The groom is Hosoyama, a consultant for a family friend. When Yuri is attacked and gravely injured in her room during the party, Reiko risks her identity being revealed to help solve the case. But when the crime scene is found to be a perfect locked room, Reiko is suspected of being an accomplice.

Episodes.Title: What is it that you have lost?
Episodes.Description: Trouble strikes the Sawamura family again when Miyuki Sawamura is kidnapped and a ransom of 50 million yen is demanded. With no other suspects, Reiko sets her sights on Hosoyama. She takes Kageyama to the ransom handover disguised as a couple. Despite the perpetrator's traps, they inch closer to the truth, and find that the case is connected to an incident that occurred three years prior.

Entries.Title: KAMITSUBAKI CITY UNDER CONSTRUCTION
Entries.Description: The witchlings address an unfolding disaster at City Hall, but Sekai foresees a greater disaster to come.

Episodes.Title: -Witchling- (2)
Episodes.Description: The witchlings address an unfolding disaster at City Hall, but Sekai foresees a greater disaster to come.

Episodes.Title: Song of Purification
Episodes.Description: As the RD struggles to keep the outbreak under control, Sekai rushes to save the people of her old church.

Episodes.Title: Fragment
Episodes.Description: The witchlings debate the fallout from their last mission while the RD Chief struggles to understand.

Episodes.Title: Malice
Episodes.Description: The witchlings are left reeling from a sudden betrayal as disappearances rise around the city.

Episodes.Title: Familiar
Episodes.Description: The witchlings are forced to run from suspicious townspeople while trying to find and stop Kugel.

Episodes.Title: Memory Egg
Episodes.Description: Exploring Kugel's memories forces the witchlings to confront a shocking truth about their world.

Episodes.Title: Phenomenon
Episodes.Description: As time ticks down for Kamitsubaki CIty, Kafu confronts the forces preventing her from singing.

Episodes.Title: Blackout
Episodes.Description: Maxwell prepares to unleash hell on Kamitsubaki City, but the witchlings are far from a united front.

Episodes.Title: Desire
Episodes.Description: The situation grows even more dire for the witchlings as Maxwell's plan comes to fruition.

Entries.Title: Breaking the Shadows
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Umamusume: Cinderella Gray
Entries.Description: Nestled in the sleepy countryside lies Kasamatsu Tracen Academy. Jo Kitahara, a trainer, can't help but bemoan the state of regional races compared to the star-studded national scene. But one day, as he passively watches the newest batch of racers practice, he spots an ashen-haired Umamusume. After seeing her stunning racing form, Jo Kitahara is convinced—at long last, he's found a star.

Episodes.Title: I'm Here
Episodes.Description: Nestled in the sleepy countryside lies Kasamatsu Tracen Academy. Jo Kitahara, a trainer, can't help but bemoan the state of regional races compared to the star-studded national scene. But one day, as he passively watches the newest batch of racers practice, he spots an ashen-haired Umamusume. After seeing her stunning racing form, Jo Kitahara is convinced—at long last, he's found a star.

Episodes.Title: Let Me Race
Episodes.Description: Oguri Cap and Belno Light are officially scouted by Jo Kitahara. Seeing as a racer needs to belong to a team in order to race, Oguri Cap accepts and begins training for her debut race. When the day arrives, she finds the student hailed as their generation's ace—Fujimasa March—waiting for her...

Episodes.Title: View from the Top
Episodes.Description: Up until now, Oguri Cap has simply run because she can, but after her heated race with Fujimasa March, her heart wells with a new, bitter emotion. As Oguri Cap and her team ensure she's properly prepared for her next race, another opponent shows her face: Norn Ace. Annoyed by Oguri Cap, Norn Ace's friends propose a certain "strategy" to her...

Episodes.Title: The Junior Crown
Episodes.Description: The day of the Junior Crown is here, and Oguri Cap and Fujimasa March make good on the promise they made at Mt. Kinka to enter. While Oguri Cap had no answer when Fujimasa March asked her for her goal back then, her aspirations will surely take shape during this race with her rival.

Episodes.Title: What's Best for Her
Episodes.Description: Oguri Cap and the rest of her team make their way to Chukyo Racecourse for the Chukyo Hai, but Kitahara can't shake Musaka's ominous words from his mind. Brows furrowed, he heads for the stands, only to discover Symboli Rudolf and Maruzensky have come to observe the race.

Episodes.Title: The Beast
Episodes.Description: After Symboli Rudolf offers his trainee a place in the Twinkle Series, Kitahara approaches a reluctant Oguri Cap with a wager—if she wins the Gold Junior, she'll transfer to the nationals; otherwise, they'll aim for the Tokai Derby. As she heads into the race, Oguri Cap remains conflicted. She wants to give her all in her long-awaited battle against March, but...

Episodes.Title: Tracen Academy
Episodes.Description: Musaka gives Tracen Academy's two newest students—Oguri Cap and Belno Light—a tour of the expansive campus. Afterwards, Oguri Cap comes face to face with her new classmates—and potential rivals. As class begins, the teacher explains the goal of many of her contemporaries, the G1 Classic Triple Crown. There's just one problem...

Episodes.Title: The Right Stuff
Episodes.Description: Oguri Cap's transfer from Kasamatsu has unfortunately overlapped with the registration deadline for the Classic races. Eager to show Symboli Rudolf she has what it takes to take on these races, she sets her sights on the G3 Pegasus Stakes. But standing in her way is a racer with four consecutive wins under her belt...

Episodes.Title: The Japanese Derby
Episodes.Description: Symboli Rudolf witnesses Oguri Cap's might firsthand—the no-name racer from the boonies wipes the floor with even the strong national racers. In her, Symboli Rudolf sees a star capable of setting the Twinkle Series alight. But should she use her authority to advocate for a miracle at the Japan Derby, or should she remain loyal to the rules?

Episodes.Title: The Peak
Episodes.Description: Ultimately, Oguri Cap is unable to enter the Japanese Derby, which means she needs a new racing goal. Hoping to inspire Oguri Cap, Musaka takes her and Belno Light to see the Takarazuka Kinen, a Grand Prix race where the lineup is decided by a fan poll. There, Oguri Cap witnesses the racer currently dominating the Twinkle Series.

Episodes.Title: The Star of Kasamatsu
Episodes.Description: Musaka declares that if Oguri Cap wants to take on Tamamo Cross in the fall Tenno Sho, she has to win the Mainichi Okan. A task easier said than done, as Oguri Cap's winning streak means all her rivals' eyes are on her. This year's Mainichi Okan is shaping up to be a ten-versus-one race...

Episodes.Title: The Fall Tenno Sho
Episodes.Description: At last, the day of the fall Tenno Sho arrives, and with it, the first clash between the two ashen-haired Umamusume, Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap. Hoping to surpass the top racer and become the best in all of Japan, Oguri Cap steps onto the turf. Although Tamamo Cross holds a similar dream, there's a special someone in her heart as she enters the course.

Episodes.Title: Japan's Best
Episodes.Description: The crowd is on the edge of their seats as the racers enter the homestretch of the fall Tenno Sho. With 400 meters remaining, each runner musters the last of their strength. With Oguri Cap right on her tail, Tamamo Cross begins to feel the pressure. As exhaustion creeps in, her past flashes before her eyes. Her loved ones in her heart, Tamamo Cross breaks past her limits and enters a zone beyond her rivals...

Entries.Title: Goosebumps: The Vanishing
Entries.Description: Two siblings unearth a link between a family tragedy and a long-dormant threat.

Episodes.Title: Stay Out of the Basement (1)
Episodes.Description: Two siblings unearth a link between a family tragedy and a long-dormant threat.

Episodes.Title: Stay Out of the Basement (2)
Episodes.Description: As Anthony continues his research, Trey breaks into his basement lab, unleashing unexpected horrors.

Episodes.Title: The Haunted Car
Episodes.Description: Alex steals a car that has a mind of its own.

Episodes.Title: Monster Blood
Episodes.Description: Cece's anxiety spikes while trying to maintain her perfect image, leading to a sticky situation.

Episodes.Title: The Boy Who Cried Monster
Episodes.Description: After CJ sees something horrific at Anthony's house, his friends and family don't believe his tale.

Episodes.Title: The Girl Next Door
Episodes.Description: The teens uncover shocking new evidence about the disappearance 30 years ago -- and their parents.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Camp Nightmare
Episodes.Description: The curtain is pulled back on the mysterious person who's been concealing the truth for decades.

Episodes.Title: Invasion of the Body Squeezers
Episodes.Description: The teens band together to save themselves, their neighbourhood and the world.

Entries.Title: Chuhai Lips: Canned Flavor of Married Women
Entries.Description: Tsuyoshi, a third-year college student, leads a lazy life drinking cheap and tasty canned chuhai. One day, his aunt, Yui Koriyama, who he has a soft spot for, pays him an unexpected visit.

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of My Strict Aunt's Lips
Episodes.Description: Tsuyoshi, a third-year college student, leads a lazy life drinking cheap and tasty canned chuhai. One day, his aunt, Yui Koriyama, who he has a soft spot for, pays him an unexpected visit.

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Sun-Kissed Gyaru's Lips
Episodes.Description: On a midsummer's day, Tsuyoshi heads to the convenience store to get chuhai, and reunites with Ai Natsuno, his junior from high school. Ai is now married, with a huge makeover as a sun-kissed gyaru, but acts like a spoiled child around Tsuyoshi, just like she used to.

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Married Club Senpai's Lips
Episodes.Description: Tsuyoshi starts an online drinking session with his two guy friends, and the college idol senpai, Miki Kanzaki. As Miki gets drunk from canned chuhai and exposes herself on screen, Tsuyoshi and the gang can't take their eyes off her.

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of My Russian Friend's Sister's Lips
Episodes.Description: Tsuyoshi goes round Joseph's house and meets his older sister and married Russian beauty, Anastasia. The three have canned chuhai, but Anastasia gets dead drunk and mistakes Tsuyoshi for her younger brother. He ends up taking care of her, but...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Mysterious, Tanuki-Faced Married Woman's Lips
Episodes.Description: One night when Tsuyoshi was wandering around town with canned chuhai in his hand, he meets a wild tanuki, and gets led to a big mansion. There he meets a tanuki-faced beauty, Tamami Miyazawa, who gives him a warm reception, but for a certain reason...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Baby-Faced, Cheeky Married Woman's Lips
Episodes.Description: By chance, Tsuyoshi ends up having a one-night stand with Nozomi Kuji, a married woman who looks too young for her age. Since then, they've become canned chuhai drinking buddies. In the midst of this, Nozomi vents out her frustration about her busty-loving hubby, and Tsuyoshi gets lectured on the appeal of small breasts...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of an Otherworldly, Married Dark Elf's Lips
Episodes.Description: Tsuyoshi enters a parallel universe and saves a dark elf beauty, Symphis with the skill he gained from the chuhai god. Tsuyoshi gradually becomes drawn to Symphis as she talks about her husband, but something doesn't add up...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Quiet Former Rebel, the Barbershop Owner's Lips
Episodes.Description: As Tsuyoshi goes to his regular barbershop, the quiet forty-odd beauty owner, Sari Kirihara, announces that the shop will be closing down. Tsuyoshi ends up drinking canned chuhai at Sari's house without the presence of her husband, but realizing her secret feelings, tries to snuggle up to her...

Entries.Title: Art Detectives
Entries.Description: When an art historian is found murdered in his home, DI Mick Palmer and DC Shazia Malik are sent to investigate. As they dig into the case, they uncover a vandalized painting, sabotaged security footage, and a dark family secret.

Episodes.Title: Pictures at an Exhibition
Episodes.Description: When an art historian is found murdered in his home, DI Mick Palmer and DC Shazia Malik are sent to investigate. As they dig into the case, they uncover a vandalized painting, sabotaged security footage, and a dark family secret.

Episodes.Title: Dead & Buried
Episodes.Description: The detectives look into the discovery of a gold Viking hoard stolen from a prehistoric burial chamber. After the site is reopened, they unearth a series of secrets and betrayals leading to a thousand-year-old cover-up.

Episodes.Title: Warped
Episodes.Description: A music producer is battered to death in his studio and his rare rock memorabilia stolen. But when the victim's collection is later found dumped in the river, Mick and Shazia question the killer's motive.

Episodes.Title: Noble Rot
Episodes.Description: At an exclusive wine tasting, host Raymond Bettane dies from a spiked drink. As the detectives question each of the guests, Mick makes a shocking discovery about Bettane's vintage wines.

Episodes.Title: Ice Cold
Episodes.Description: An American millionaire who planned to donate his collection of Titanic memorabilia is found dead in his hotel room in Belfast. Discovering that the man was poisoned, Mick and Shazia suspect someone wanted to stop the donation.

Episodes.Title: Final Bid
Episodes.Description: Mick's father, Ron, is taken hostage by a criminal gang for stealing a valuable painting from them-and Mick gets an ultimatum; he and Shazia must investigate the theft of a rare Chinese vase that has disappeared from a locked vault.

Entries.Title: In the Mud
Entries.Description: A prison transport is hijacked, freeing one female convict and cementing the fates of six others. Prison politics get heated between competing factions.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: A prison transport is hijacked, freeing one female convict and cementing the fates of six others. Prison politics get heated between competing factions.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: María makes Gladys an offer and attacks La Zurda with long-lasting consequences. Marina receives news regarding her release. A prison birth goes wrong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Moranzón cracks down on the inmates. Marina enters La Zurda's den. María calls Gladys. La Gallega gets a special surprise — and a devastating one.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Brisa wins Eugenia's favor. Marina's court hearing goes awry. La Zurda takes La Gallega under her wing. Antín makes Gladys a life-changing offer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: For Marina, everything comes with strings attached. La Gallega suffers a loss, and Yael lets Brisa spend time with Eugenia. María is betrayed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Faccia blackmails Moranzón in exchange for Brisa. María's death shakes up the prison's hierarchy. Gladys and Yael grow closer. Noelia gives birth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Moranzón's past is explored, and Alan saves Marina from a visitor. Gladys gives Antín intel on Moranzón's illicit dealings. Yael's fate is in limbo.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Lunati enlists the help of an old friend for Marina's case. Moranzón's empire crumbles. La Gallega's revenge comes for Gladys — but at what cost?

Entries.Title: Welcome to the Outcast's Restaurant!
Entries.Description: Dennis, cast out of a top-tier adventuring party, decides to follow his dreams and open his own restaurant.

Episodes.Title: You Are Free
Episodes.Description: Dennis, cast out of a top-tier adventuring party, decides to follow his dreams and open his own restaurant.

Episodes.Title: It's Crazy Delicious!
Episodes.Description: The Adventurer's Restaurant is open at last, and their first customer is...someone wearing full plate armor?!

Episodes.Title: That's an Adventurer!
Episodes.Description: A boy named Vivia comes to the restaurant. He's been cast out of his party, so he may deign to join a new one.

Episodes.Title: Then, I'll Have the Daily Special
Episodes.Description: Bachel has been thoroughly ground down by her crushing workload. Then another scolding pushes her to the edge.

Episodes.Title: It's Too Soon for a Marriage Proposal!
Episodes.Description: The restaurant is booming, but Dennis is worried about Atelier! Katie approaches Dennis with a request.

Episodes.Title: I've Come for Lady Atelier
Episodes.Description: The Workstatt family butler arrives to retrieve Atelier. He tells Dennis and the others of her tragic past.

Episodes.Title: Get Better Soon
Episodes.Description: The restaurant is packed, but Dennis falls ill. As he dreams of his youth, the others try to cook for him.

Episodes.Title: Today, We Are Closed for Business Reasons
Episodes.Description: It's a cause for celebration as three of the regulars at the restaurant have acquired new jobs. While the group soaks in the hot springs and enjoys some barbecue, a shadow lurks around the temporarily closed establishment.

Episodes.Title: If It's Important to You, Then Please Don't Let Go of It!
Episodes.Description: Dennis and Atelier decide to leave town to protect their friends, but familiar figures block their way.

Episodes.Title: The Higher and Further Away a Place Is, the More I Aim to Reach It
Episodes.Description: Dennis and the others continue preparing for battle. Vigo thinks back on what he's done to get this far.

Entries.Title: Enloqueciendo contigo
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Suspicious Partner
Entries.Description: Judicial apprentice Sakura mistakes prosecutor Haruto for a pervert. Their paths continue to cross in awkward ways, eventually taking a darker turn.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Judicial apprentice Sakura mistakes prosecutor Haruto for a pervert. Their paths continue to cross in awkward ways, eventually taking a darker turn.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Sakura is arrested on suspicion of murdering her ex-boyfriend. Haruto is assigned as the prosecutor for the case and pressures Sakura to confess.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Haruto decides to go his separate way as Sakura tries to find the real killer. Two years later, mysterious events bring them back together.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Sakura puts aside her feelings for Haruto. A potential real killer has broken into her office. Haruto insists she stay at his place for her safety.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Haruto's ex Sakiko visits and Sakura acts as his new lover, creating a tense situation. Sakiko later leaves after realising the troubles she caused.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Sakura, Ren, Shinjo and Yoneda join Haruto on his law office's first case. Despite lacking an alibi, the client requests Sakura's representation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Sakura confesses her feelings to Haruto but he tells her not to fall in love with him. Ren uncovers crucial information related to their case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Sakura dines with Inaba but still likes Haruto. Concerned, Haruto follows them. Sakura asks why he suspects Inaba but Haruto has no good answer.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: As Haruto's feelings for Sakura grow, two dead bodies are found. Sakura heads to one of the crime scenes, where she hears a familiar melody.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Haruto gets the truth from Inaba about his colleague’s assault, but everything unravels. Alone together, Haruto and Sakura’s emotions overflow.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Haruto finds Sakura tied to his parents' death. Sakura sensing Haruto's secret, turns to Ren for answers, prompting a hard choice as truths unfold.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Stabbed and fading, Haruto recalls the fire that killed his parents. As guilt over Sakura haunts him, the killer is caught. Was it fate that they met?

Entries.Title: Dope Thief
Entries.Description: Ray and Manny decide their fake drug busts could be more lucrative, so they recruit a third partner and target an unassuming country house.

Episodes.Title: Jolly Ranchers
Episodes.Description: Ray and Manny decide their fake drug busts could be more lucrative, so they recruit a third partner and target an unassuming country house.

Episodes.Title: Bat Out of Hell
Episodes.Description: Dealing with the repercussions of their robbery gone wrong, Ray and Manny go into hiding while trying to keep their families safe.

Episodes.Title: Run, Die, or Relapse
Episodes.Description: Ray combs the streets looking for Manny as the biker gang closes in. DEA agents search for new leads in their hunt for Ray.

Episodes.Title: Philadelphia Lawyer
Episodes.Description: Ray enlists Son’s help with the biker gang. Manny descends deeper into despair. Agents pressure Michelle as a way to get to Ray.

Episodes.Title: Fear of God
Episodes.Description: Manny feels compelled to make amends. Mina digs into Jack's part in the operation. An unexpected person comes to Ray's rescue.

Episodes.Title: Love Songs from Mars
Episodes.Description: Ray refuses to go to the hospital as the situation at Theresa’s house unfolds into chaos.

Episodes.Title: Mussolini
Episodes.Description: Agents devise a plan to see if Ray knows more than he's letting on. Sherry gives Manny news.

Episodes.Title: Innocent People
Episodes.Description: Ray comes clean and finds an unlikely ally in his search for the truth.

Entries.Title: Beheneko: The Elf-Girl's Cat Is Secretly an S-Ranked Monster!
Entries.Description: A knight dies and is reincarnated into a baby Behemoth, an S-rank monster that looks just like a cat! A novice D-rank adventurer, Aria, adopts him as her kitty cat!

Episodes.Title: The Elf Girl and the Knight's Vow
Episodes.Description: A knight dies and is reincarnated into a baby Behemoth, an S-rank monster that looks just like a cat! A novice D-rank adventurer, Aria, adopts him as her kitty cat!

Episodes.Title: The Tigris-ear Blacksmith & A Brand New Skill
Episodes.Description: Aria and Tama visit the armor shop of their familiar blacksmith, Vulcan, to have Tama's armor tailored.

Episodes.Title: Urgent Quest - Defeat the Demons!
Episodes.Description: Disappearances plague the neighboring town of Lenard and the demon, Beryl, is behind it all. Aria accepts a quest to save the people in trouble.

Episodes.Title: Awaken - Behemoth!
Episodes.Description: Tama takes on the earth dragon, his fated enemy, in order to save Aria from the brink of death. Tama turns into a real behemoth!

Episodes.Title: Elf Girl & Dragon Girl
Episodes.Description: Stella continues making passes at Tama with her telepathic skills. Meanwhile, Tama feels uneasy as he watches her fight, driven by her old earth dragon instincts.

Episodes.Title: Girls of the Wandering Woods
Episodes.Description: The group is caught up in a new forest labyrinth. Tama and Aria are excited to explore an untouched earth said to be full of rare materials and rarer treasure chest.

Episodes.Title: Undead on Approach - Dark Tales of the Earl
Episodes.Description: Aria and friends desperately search for Lily and Feri. According to Vulcan, the Earl of Gladstone is rumored to be kidnapping young, beautiful women.

Episodes.Title: The Elf Girl Makes a Move
Episodes.Description: Lily and Feri join Aria's party. Aria is rewarded with a promotion to A-Rank Adventurer! Meanwhile, Tama unlocks the ability to evolve into his third behemoth form.

Episodes.Title: Fated Reunion in the Imperial City!
Episodes.Description: By invitation of the emperor, Aria and company travel to the imperial city of Klareal. There they meet legendary hero Prince Julius and the Holy Demoness Belzebuth.

Episodes.Title: The Powers of Tama and Aria
Episodes.Description: With news that one of the Demonic Four has returned to the labyrinth in Ruine, Aria's party, Julius, and Cedric's knights make way for its deepest depths.

Episodes.Title: The Philosopher's Stone and the Secret of Lumines
Episodes.Description: After escaping to the demon world, Vasaago's next stop is Aria's birthplace: Lumines. His target? The Philosopher's Stone.

Episodes.Title: Sacred Blade & Beast
Episodes.Description: The battle against Vasaago for the fate of the world has begun. Tama evolves into his third behemoth form and takes to the skies with Aria to retaliate!

Entries.Title: The First Night with the Duke
Entries.Description: K finds herself inhabiting the body of Cha Sun Chaek, a wealthy but completely irrelevant side character. With a VVIP ticket to watch the epic romance unfold, her simple plan is to stay out of the way and enjoy the show. But that plan is spectacularly derailed after a wild night of celebration ends with her accidentally stealing the male lead’s first night.

Episodes.Title: Reading a Book is Inviting Another's Life into Yours
Episodes.Description: K finds herself inhabiting the body of Cha Sun Chaek, a wealthy but completely irrelevant side character. With a VVIP ticket to watch the epic romance unfold, her simple plan is to stay out of the way and enjoy the show. But that plan is spectacularly derailed after a wild night of celebration ends with her accidentally stealing the male lead’s first night.

Episodes.Title: The First Night in This Lifetime
Episodes.Description: Cha Sun Chaek tried her best to run from Yi Beon.

Episodes.Title: Something Always Happens on a Moonlit Night
Episodes.Description: Yi Beon encountered an unusual figure. Cha Sun Chaek tries to fix the story she broke. Jeong Su Gyeom held a gathering for the Astral Philosophy Club.

Episodes.Title: We Need a Backup Plan
Episodes.Description: Yi Beon's persistence reached Cha Sun Chaek's family. Cha Sun Chaek encountered a foreigner. Do Hwa Sun persuaded the Queen Dowager to do something in her favor.

Episodes.Title: There is No Such Thing as "As It Was"
Episodes.Description: The Palace officially hold the bride selection process for Yi Beon.

Episodes.Title: Playing the Field and a Disguise
Episodes.Description: Yi Beon continues investigating the figures surrounding Cha Sun Chaek's incident. Jeong Su Gyeom gets jealous. Cha Sun Chaek made it to the final round of selection.

Episodes.Title: The Inflection Point
Episodes.Description: Yi Beon and Cha Sun Chaek are getting closer. Jeong Su Gyeom braves himself to pursue his dream woman. A new villain entered the story.

Episodes.Title: The Shadow that has Returned
Episodes.Description: Someone from Cha Sun Chaek's childhood past emerged. Yi Beon and Cha Sun Chaek's courtship faces another obstacle. Yi Beon's relationship with the King is being tested with the return of the exiled prince.

Episodes.Title: The Wounded Things
Episodes.Description: Cha Sun Chaek and Yi Beon's courtship gained blessings, but the hardships remain. A highly unlikely pair starts to join forces.

Episodes.Title: Once Again, Because of Fate
Episodes.Description: Jeong Su Gyeom obtained the truth. Yi Beon received punishment from the King. The Black Gang is getting stronger.

Episodes.Title: A Dream or an End?
Episodes.Description: Yi Beon fights for his life, and his lover. Lee Kyu's plan fell into place. Cha Sun Chaek take matters into her own hands.

Episodes.Title: Into the New World
Episodes.Description: Yi Beon and Cha Sun Chaek overcome their adversaries.

Entries.Title: Anne Shirley
Entries.Description: Eleven-year-old orphan Anne goes to live with her new family, only to discover that they expected a boy.

Episodes.Title: It’s Such an Interesting World
Episodes.Description: Eleven-year-old orphan Anne goes to live with her new family, only to discover that they expected a boy.

Episodes.Title: I Love Pretty Things
Episodes.Description: Anne rejoices in her new life at Green Gables, but unkind words from Mrs. Lynde spark a stormy confrontation.

Episodes.Title: Looking Forward to Things Is Half the Pleasure of Them
Episodes.Description: Anne thrills in anticipation of her first picnic, but a lost brooch puts her dreams in jeopardy.

Episodes.Title: One Can’t Stay Sad Very Long in Such an Interesting World
Episodes.Description: Anne invites Diana to tea, but a mix-up with bottles could make it their last meeting as friends.

Episodes.Title: Let Us Look on the Bright Side of Things
Episodes.Description: Newly twelve-year-old Anne comes to grief in an affair of honor. Matthew insists on puffed sleeves.

Episodes.Title: I Thought Nothing Could Be as Bad as Red Hair
Episodes.Description: The story club is formed. Then, Anne's vanity leads to vexation of spirit.

Episodes.Title: I’ve Been Making Mistakes, but Each Mistake Has Helped to Cure Me of My Shortcomings
Episodes.Description: Anne becomes an unfortunate lily maid, and the Queen's class is organized.

Episodes.Title: I Don’t Want to Be Anyone but Myself
Episodes.Description: The pass list is out. Anne celebrates at the hotel concert.

Episodes.Title: Next to Trying and Winning, the Best Thing Is Trying and Failing
Episodes.Description: Anne becomes a Queen's girl and spends the winter at Queen's, chasing the glory and the dream.

Episodes.Title: I Don’t Know What Lies Around the Bend, but I’m Going to Believe That the Best Does
Episodes.Description: After the reaper whose name is Death touches her life, Anne comes to the bend in the road.

Episodes.Title: I’d Like to Add Some Beauty to Life
