Entries.Title: Farmagia
Entries.Description: On the vast farmlands of Centvelt in the continent of Avrion, the Farmagias diligently tend to their fields. Meanwhile, Ten spends his days slacking off, focused on raising the ultimate monster. One day, shocking news arrives: The Magus Diluculum has suddenly died.

Episodes.Title: The Beginning of Chaos
Episodes.Description: On the vast farmlands of Centvelt in the continent of Avrion, the Farmagias diligently tend to their fields. Meanwhile, Ten spends his days slacking off, focused on raising the ultimate monster. One day, shocking news arrives: The Magus Diluculum has suddenly died.

Episodes.Title: Rebellion of Avrion
Episodes.Description: Airing on Friday, January 17, 2025 Ten and Leii face off against the masked warrior Zanas, who attacks an orphanage. Overwhelmed by the vast difference in their abilities as Farmagias, the two find themselves in a dire situation. However, with the timely assistance of Nares, they manage to successfully repel Zanas. After the battle, gazing upon the ruins of the burned-down orphanage, Ten and the others resolve to rebel against the new Magus, Glaza.

Episodes.Title: Reunion in Enemy Territory
Episodes.Description: To defeat Manas, Ten, Leii, and Arche infiltrate Perfectus as an elite strike team, aiming for the castle. During their mission, they reunite with their missing comrade, Emero. While Ten is overjoyed by the reunion, Emero gazes at them with a stern expression and utters a chilling remark.

Episodes.Title: Uniting Bonds
Episodes.Description: Determined to match Emero, who demonstrated mastery over controlling monster powers, Ten repeatedly attempts to "Unite" but fails no matter how hard he tries, growing increasingly frustrated. Then, Emero appears before Ten and the others once more, but this time, he shows even greater hostility toward them.

Episodes.Title: To the City of Muscles
Episodes.Description: After defeating Manas and returning to Avrion, Ten and the others let Arche rest to recover from a sudden collapse. Ten and Leii then head to their next destination, Rahatluk, on their own. Successfully infiltrating the city, they pull a cart through the streets, only to realize someone is hiding in the cargo. That person is...

Episodes.Title: Beyond the Corpses
Episodes.Description: As Ten and the others panic over Chica's disappearance, Zanas once again stands in their way. Effortlessly deflecting their attacks, Zanas reveals that Chica has been captured by the Corpus before leaving. Determined to ensure their dear comrade's safety, Ten and his group rush to Rahatluk Fortress.

Episodes.Title: In return for the Truth
Episodes.Description: After a fierce battle with the Corpus, Ten and his group emerge victorious. Returning to Avrion, they throw a party to celebrate Emero's return. While everyone enjoys the festivities, Ten, worried about Arche’s absence due to poor health, goes to visit her—only to discover that she has disappeared. Together with his comrades, Ten desperately searches for her, but...

Episodes.Title: The Chosen Ones
Episodes.Description: Receiving a report from Anzar, who has infiltrated Sonrisa and uncovered the guard placements, Nares assigns Ten and the group the mission to defeat L'Oreille. They land in Sonrisa and begin their advance, but while Anzar steps away to scout the enemy, they are ambushed by L'Oreille, Zanas, and Glaza.

Episodes.Title: The Three Angels
Episodes.Description: On the day of peace negotiations, Nares faces L'Oreille with her army on the continent of. Tension fills the air as Ten and the others quietly observe the two. Declaring no intent to attack, Nares speaks calmly, but L'Oreille, with a sinister smile, unleashes the supposedly undecipherable grand magic, "Harvest Festival.

Episodes.Title: Through the Darkness
Episodes.Description: Nares wakes up in the Magus’s castle, where she is shocked to see the Oración Seis, who were believed to be dead. To her further confusion, Lisan mocks her, and standing before her is the former Magus, Diluculum. Meanwhile, Ten and the others, assaulted by L'Oreille, are swallowed by an impenetrable darkness with no light in sight.

Episodes.Title: The Path of the Brother
Episodes.Description: Having completely lost their sense of self, the Oración Seis transform into Reapers and charge at Ten and the others with terrifying roars. Each of them faces a one-on-one battle, but Ten, confronted by Nares, hesitates to fight. Unable to summon any monsters, he desperately continues to call out to her, torn and unsure of what to do.

Episodes.Title: Dragons of Centvelt
Episodes.Description: Together with Anzar, who has regained his sense of self, Ten and the others challenge the Magus Diluculum to a final battle. However, even their strongest attacks have no effect on Diluculum. As the world gradually collapses due to the "Grand Harvest Festival," Ten and his comrades continue to struggle desperately, refusing to give up.

Entries.Title: Too Much

Episodes.Description: Felix takes charge when Astrid suffers a dire medical emergency. Jessica finally meets with someone she's been hoping to speak to for a very long time.

Episodes.Title: Revenge
Episodes.Description: He spent his life working for a black company, only to learn that his beloved daughter was born from the man his wife spent years cheating on him with - his own boss. Yearning for revenge on his death bed, he's reincarnated in a space fantasy as the Evil Lord Liam.

Episodes.Title: Rebirth
Episodes.Description: At the ripe age of 5, Liam is gifted a custom-order AI robot by his parents, and then granted full control of their fiefdom, the stellar system of Alcaeus, so they can abandon him for the capital and leave him shouldered with the family's debts.

Episodes.Title: Way of the Flash
Episodes.Description: Liam retains a martial arts instructor of questionable character.

Episodes.Title: First Battle
Episodes.Description: Nias customizes the Avid. Liam masters Flash, then defends his mine from pirates.

Episodes.Title: Honey Trap
Episodes.Description: Liam uses his loot from the pirates to replace his fleet and Nias tries to seduce him into buying her ships.

Episodes.Title: Treasure Island
Episodes.Description: Logs on the pirate ships reveals their home base and Liam argues with the warp gate so he can go raid them.

Episodes.Title: Princess Knight
Episodes.Description: Goaz tortures Christiania and her soldiers, grotesquely modifying their bodies. Liam rescues them.

Episodes.Title: Harem Project
Episodes.Description: Liam tries to build an NTR harem, but struggles because over 10,000 women are ready to eagerly consent to it.

Episodes.Title: Mass-Produced Maids
Episodes.Description: Liam laments not being more of an evil lord but his people & robots love him. The Guide leads pirates to him.

Episodes.Title: Decisive Battle
Episodes.Description: The Goaz pirates declare war on the Banfield domain, and Liam faces them in battle.

Episodes.Title: Evil Lord
Episodes.Description: Liam routs the pirates and faces Goaz in a final showdown.

Episodes.Title: Family
Episodes.Description: After hearing about Liam's success, his good-for-nothing family comes begging for more money.

Episodes.Description: An up-and-coming anime director, Natsuko Hirose, is busy trying to storyboard a rom-com themed feature film, but because she's never experienced first love, she can't seem to progress with her storyboards.

Episodes.Title: DEFEND
Episodes.Description: The prophet of the Last Town, Elder Baobab, decides that Natsuko should join the Nine Soldiers, but her and Luke are at odds. Natsuko tries to figure out a way back home, but then remembers what happens next in "A Tale of Perishing" and realizes everyone's in danger again.

Episodes.Title: DESTINY
Episodes.Description: The Last Town has their Harvest Festival and the Nine Soldiers get some time off. That's where Luke meets Destiny. In "A Tale of Perishing," the two fall in love, but Natsuko coming into the this world seems to be throwing off that destiny...

Episodes.Title: ETERNITY
Episodes.Description: Natsuko notices that Memmeln is acting strange. In the movie, there is a scene with Memmeln that's a mystery even to fans, so Natsuko tails her...

Episodes.Title: JUSTICE
Episodes.Description: Destiny asks the Nine Soldiers to bring food to some orphans and they run into a former Nine Soldier, Justice.

Episodes.Title: CHANGE
Episodes.Description: Natsuko loses to the Voids for the first time, but still tries to continue her selfish actions.

Episodes.Title: FIRST LOVE
Episodes.Description: Natsuko tries to figure out exactly what first love feels like for her upcoming film.

Episodes.Title: CONFESSION
Episodes.Description: Luke finally tells Natsuko how he really feels about her.

Episodes.Title: HERO
Episodes.Description: Luke thinks about his life as the legendary hero.

Episodes.Title: CHAOS
Episodes.Description: Rumors start to spread about Natsuko which leads the people of the Last Town to turn on her.

Episodes.Title: DESPAIR
Episodes.Description: Luke suffers more loss and falls into despair while Memmeln comes up with a certain plan with Meg and Sally.

Episodes.Title: ZENSHU
Episodes.Description: Natsuko has to draw one final thing to save the Last Town from its greatest threat.

Episodes.Description: Issa and Anton look for meaning after an unexpected loss, while Samir and Paul Baker start underage drinking.

Episodes.Title: Annabelle
Episodes.Description: Anton and Paul Baker host a visitor from out of town, while Issa takes a stand at work.

Episodes.Title: The Mail
Episodes.Description: The group opens the mailbox for the first time in months.

Entries.Title: Babanba Banban Vampire
Entries.Description: A vampire works in a bathhouse in hopes of drinking the virgin blood of its heir Rihito, who worryingly falls in love on his first day of high school.

Episodes.Title: The Vampire of the Public Bathhouse
Episodes.Description: A vampire works in a bathhouse in hopes of drinking the virgin blood of its heir Rihito, who worryingly falls in love on his first day of high school.

Episodes.Title: The Unpleasant Vampire
Episodes.Description: Ranmaru worries he has inadvertently made Aoi interested in Rihito. Rihito chats with Aoi the next day after school, but they soon get into trouble.

Episodes.Title: Franken and the Vampire
Episodes.Description: After saving Aoi, a hungry Ranmaru tries to resist the urge to feed on her. Rihito soon arrives at the scene and comes to a mistaken realization.

Episodes.Title: The Vampire's Slumber Party
Episodes.Description: Franken proclaims his admiration for Ranmaru, who tasks him with protecting Rihito. Franken tags along with them back to the Tatsuno house for dinner.

Episodes.Title: The Vampire of Fate
Episodes.Description: Rihito's teacher Sakamoto — an undercover vampire hunter of notable lineage — learns that his longtime foe Ranmaru lives with the Tatsunos.

Episodes.Title: A Vampire Put on The Spot
Episodes.Description: As Sakamoto tells Ranmaru the reason for his unexpected request, a puzzled Rihito walks in on them. Ranmaru reveals how Sakamoto's ancestor died.

Episodes.Title: The Cornered Vampire
Episodes.Description: At the Koi Bathhouse, Franken and Sakamoto attempt to bring their plan to fruition by urging Rihito to tell Aoi how he feels about her.

Episodes.Title: A Gal and the Vampire
Episodes.Description: Tough girl Kaoru is charmed by Rihito's cuteness, but when she goes to return a handkerchief he lent her, she can't seem to drop her brash attitude.

Episodes.Title: A Certain family and the Vampire
Episodes.Description: After a confrontation with Kaoru's father, Ranmaru attempts to drink Kaoru's blood. However, he's repulsed by her makeup — which gives him an idea.

Episodes.Title: Mr. Sakamoto and the Vampire
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto tells Ranmaru he was attacked by a vampire at the school. After a remedial night class, Franken and Kaoru encounter a boyish-looking vampire.

Episodes.Title: Love, the Cross, and the Vampire
Episodes.Description: Thoughts of Rihito give Ranmaru strength as he struggles against the formidable Nagayoshi. Suddenly, Kaoru appears with an improvised weapon in hand.

Episodes.Title: And Thus, A New Vampire
Episodes.Description: Ranmaru asks Rihito's father to let Nagayoshi stay in the apartment behind the bathhouse. A newly inspired Nagayoshi declares he's in love with Kaoru.

Episodes.Description: A wounded man flees to Hotel Inhumans, where they cater to a certain clientele and the concierges are skilled.

Episodes.Title: Dying Service 1
Episodes.Description: Kase is a hitman who stays at the hotel when he escapes the life others believe he leads.

Episodes.Title: Dying Service 2
Episodes.Description: Kase's wound is dire. As his consciousness fades, memories of his wife, and one last request, fill his mind.

Episodes.Title: Corpse Reviver
Episodes.Description: Nina has been raised to kill. One night, at the hotel bar, she listens to her next target's newest song.

Episodes.Title: Remember Me
Episodes.Description: A couple arrives at the hotel. As Ikuro offers to take their weapons, Sara stops him for a surprising reason.

Episodes.Title: A Last Supper 2
Episodes.Description: Sara and Ikuro fight in their own ways for the sake of their guest, Ringo, as her condition quickly worsens.

Entries.Title: OKITSURA: Fell in Love with an Okinawan Girl, but I Just Wish I Know What She's Saying
Entries.Description: Nakamura Teruaki has moved south to Okinawa from Tokyo and fallen in love with a local girl. There's just one problem, though: her Okinawan dialect is so thick that he can't understand a word she says!

Episodes.Title: The Girl I Like Speaks in Uchinaaguchi
Episodes.Description: Nakamura Teruaki has moved south to Okinawa from Tokyo and fallen in love with a local girl. There's just one problem, though: her Okinawan dialect is so thick that he can't understand a word she says!

Episodes.Title: A Beach Party Is Just a Social Gathering?!
Episodes.Description: Teruaki is excited for the big class beach party, but he's the only one who wants to swim?!

Episodes.Title: Shiisaa and Eisaa
Episodes.Description: Teruaki learns more about Okinawan traditions, goes to a festival...and sneaks off somewhere "naughty"?!

Episodes.Title: Blow Your Finger Whistle at the Beautiful Sea!
Episodes.Description: Teruaki learns to whistle, and how the Okinawans dance.

Episodes.Title: Kariyushi Wear by Mistake!
Episodes.Description: Teruaki tries on what he thinks is just a Hawaiian shirt, and discovers it has a deeper history than he imagines.

Episodes.Title: I Want to Cry "Okinawa Soba"!
Episodes.Description: Teruaki learns the history of Okinawan soba, and a typhoon closes in.

Episodes.Title: Vipers and Mongooses
Episodes.Description: Teruaki learns the sorrowful tale of the time mongooses were brought to Okinawa.

Episodes.Title: Yui Rail Rides to the Music!
Episodes.Description: Teruaki discovers that there are no trains in Okinawa.

Episodes.Title: Amazing! The Iriomote Cat!
Episodes.Description: Kyan tells Suzu the story of the Iriomote cat and its ancient history.

Episodes.Title: The True Identity of the Yaaruu?!
Episodes.Description: Teruaki takes Higa on a test of courage and is shocked by what he finds.

Episodes.Title: Goya? Gooyaa?
Episodes.Description: Teruaki learns the truth about goya and gooyaa.

Episodes.Title: Anshee Matayaa! (See You Again Sometime!)
Episodes.Description: Kyan panics when she finds out that Teruaki likes her.

Entries.Title: Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX
Entries.Description: Amate Yuzuriha, a high-school girl living in the Izuma colony, meets a female courier named Nyaan.

Episodes.Title: The Red Gundam
Episodes.Description: Amate Yuzuriha, a high-school girl living in the Izuma colony, meets a female courier named Nyaan.

Episodes.Title: The White Gundam
Episodes.Description: Char, an ace pilot of the Principality of Zeon forces, captures the Earth Federation's latest mobile suit Gundam, a key component to their "Operation V," at Side7. From that moment, the tide of war shifts dramatically, ultimately leading to Principality of Zeon’s victory in the One Year War. However, just before the end of the war, Gundam and Char...

Episodes.Title: Machu in Clan Battle
Episodes.Description: Amate meets a boy named Shuji, who pilots the Red Gundam. She can’t forget the sensation of the glowing universe they experienced together and suggests forming a MAV to enter the Clan Battle. Amate decides to use the entry name "MACHU."

Episodes.Title: The Witch's War
Episodes.Description: A super unicum known as the "Witch," who shot down over 100 enemies during the One Year War, enters the Clan Battle to settle an old score with the Red Gundam. Seeing this Witch, who clings to mobile suit combat even at the cost of abandoning her husband and child, Machu witnesses the depths of human obsession.

Episodes.Title: Nyaan Doesn't Know About Kira-Kira
Episodes.Description: Machu plans to earn money in the Clan Battle and travel to Earth with Shuji and Nyaan. However, on the day of the Clan Battle, Machu is caught by Xavier. At this rate, the trip to Earth will remain just a dream. At that moment, Nyaan…

Episodes.Title: The Plot to Assassinate Kycilia
Episodes.Description: Annqi discovers Shuji’s hideout. Information about the Red Gundam is worth more than any Clan Battle prize money. Machu finds out that Annqi schemes to sell that intel during the Clan Battle. Earth Federation forces’ intelligence agency finds out about Kycilia’s top secret information decides to…

Episodes.Title: Machu's Rebellion
Episodes.Description: Upon learning of Annqi's plan, Machu devises a plan with Nyaan to use the Clan Battle as a means to help Shuji escape. However, their opponent in the next Clan Battle turns out to be a newly built mobile armor operated by terrorists aiming to assassinate Kycilia.

Episodes.Title: Falling on the Moon
Episodes.Description: In the final stages of the One Year War, the Sodon Fleet led by Char launched to stop the Earth Federation forces' operation to drop Solomon Fortress; to protect the lunar city of Granada. Five years later in Granada. Nyaan was there with Kycilia.

Episodes.Title: The Rose of Sharon
Episodes.Description: Guided by a mysterious message, Machu escapes Sodon and descends alone to Earth in GQuuuuuuX. After crash-landing to Earth, she is rescued by a woman adored as “lady,” who is being held captive in the Kabas estate. Machu decides to escape with her and attempts to flee in the Core Fighter.

Episodes.Title: Yomagn'tho Blockade
Episodes.Description: To stop Yomagn'tho from causing destruction, Machu takes on a mission from Challia Bull to rescue the girl of rose. However, Kycilia makes her move first. Nyaan’s mobile suit, the GFreD, begins activating the Zeknova cannon. Its target: all of humanity on Earth—

Episodes.Title: Alphacide
Episodes.Description: Machu's GQuuuuuuX fights against Nyaan's GFreD as she tries to rescue the girl of rose. Eventually, guided by Shuji, Machu ventures alone into the heart of Yomagn'tho. There, she meets Char and Kycilia.

Episodes.Title: That's Why I...
Episodes.Description: This is the end game. A white mobile suit appears from the other side, attempting to kill Lalah. To Machu’s shock, the pilot of this White Devil is none other than Shuji. Determined to protect Lalah, Machu becomes a MAV with Nyaan and decides to fight Shuji.

Entries.Title: Milky☆Subway: The Galactic Limited Express
Entries.Description:
Freshly arrested, Chiharu and Makina are sentenced to scrub the Milky☆Subway.

It was supposed to be simple.

Episodes.Title: All Aboard!
Episodes.Description:
Freshly arrested, Chiharu and Makina are sentenced to scrub the Milky☆Subway.

It was supposed to be simple.

Episodes.Title: False Departure
Episodes.Description:
As part of their rehab program, Chiharu and Makina board the train for cleanup duty.

They’re joined by four reluctant misfits who clearly didn’t sign up for what’s coming.

Episodes.Title: Chiharu and Makina
Episodes.Description:
The Milky☆Subway launches without warning, six convicts aboard.

Flashback to the beginning: during interrogation, cracks start to show in Chiharu and Makina—and Officer Ryoko begins connecting the dots.

Episodes.Title: Eat, Fight, Repeat
Episodes.Description:
Chiharu and Makina head for the front car to stop the runaway train—only to crash into biker duo Akane and Kanata.

Forced to team up (awkward), they press on… straight into what appears to be a dining car?

Episodes.Title: HAIJO-KUN
Episodes.Description:
Now with Akane and Kanata on board, the crew pushes forward.

But a sketchy security bot blocks the way—and it’s not in the mood to negotiate.

Episodes.Title: Kurt and Max
Episodes.Description:
Flashback again: just hours before launch, cyborgs Kurt and Max are interrogated by Officer Ryoko.

Something’s off. But what?

Episodes.Title: Labor and Reward
Episodes.Description:
The gang struggles to get past the rogue security bot.

Their only hope? Kurt and Max.

Too bad those two are deeply allergic to teamwork.

Episodes.Title: Tempura Shrimp Tail
Episodes.Description: With Kurt and Max finally joining in, the six misfits charge ahead—only to be stopped cold by an unexpected bathroom break.

Episodes.Title: Delusion and Panic
Episodes.Description: A system glitch traps everyone in the train's bathroom. Chiharu gets stuck in the women's bathroom door, while Kanata, Kurt, and Max launch a daring escape plan.

Episodes.Title: Akane and Kanata
Episodes.Description:
Still trapped in the train’s bathroom, the team’s fate rests in Kanata’s hands.

Can he save the others—and maybe earn the trust of Akane, who once called him “a tempura shrimp tail”?

Entries.Title: North of North
Entries.Description: Feeling stuck in her life in her tiny Arctic community, Siaja decides it's time to shake things up during the annual Spring Festival, but her plans are derailed by personal upheavals.

Episodes.Title: Top of the World
Episodes.Description: Feeling stuck in her life in her tiny Arctic community, Siaja decides it's time to shake things up during the annual Spring Festival, but her plans are derailed by personal upheavals.

Episodes.Title: No Freeloading
Episodes.Description: Siaja struggles to pick up the pieces and prove herself capable of handling more than just her messy personal life.

Episodes.Title: Dumpcano
Episodes.Description: Siaja’s first day of work goes awry when she accidentally starts a fire at the dump and Alistair and Kuuk visit the community center to discuss Ice Cove's candidacy to host a polar research station.

Episodes.Title: Joy to the Effing World
Episodes.Description: With Kuuk’s help, Siaja forms a plan to shake up Elder’s night by coaxing children to attend, hoping to raise the Elders’ spirits. Meanwhile, Neevee seems to run into Alistair everywhere she goes.

Episodes.Title: Walrus D*ck Baseball
Episodes.Description: Ice Cove is shortlisted for the polar research station, so Siaja proposes they host a baseball fundraiser to afford upgrades to the community centre to better their chances. Helen is coerced into a winner-takes-all bet by the rival town’s leader.

Episodes.Title: Carnivores
Episodes.Description: Love is not in the air in Ice Cove as Siaja re-enters the dating world in epic style, Neevee and Alistair reach a turning point, and Kuuk has a surprise visitor.

Episodes.Title: Lost and Found
Episodes.Description: The community comes together for an exhausting multi-day search for Ting. Siaja entrusts Alistair to babysit Bun during the search.

Episodes.Title: Bad Influences
Episodes.Description: Siaja and Helen put the final touches on their pitch for the polar research station, when Helen is pulled away. Siaja uses this opportunity to view the only available apartment in town with Kuuk’s help.

Entries.Title: Mid-Century Modern
Entries.Description: Bunny, Jerry and Arthur reunite at the funeral of their longtime friend, George, which inspires Bunny to invite Jerry and Arthur to live with him and his mother, Sybil, in his Palm Springs home.

Episodes.Title: Bye, George
Episodes.Description: Bunny, Jerry and Arthur reunite at the funeral of their longtime friend, George, which inspires Bunny to invite Jerry and Arthur to live with him and his mother, Sybil, in his Palm Springs home.

Episodes.Title: Working Girls
Episodes.Description: Sybil helps Arthur get a job as a personal shopper, but his condescending boss reminds Arthur he’s no longer in fashion; he’s in sales. At a casino, Jerry tries to get tickets to a Donny Osmond concert, while Bunny negotiates with a pit boss when he feels he lost money unfairly.

Episodes.Title: Turbulence
Episodes.Description: On a flight, Arthur encourages Jerry to repair his relationship with his estranged daughter. When Bunny's sister, Mindy, visits, he tries to keep the peace between her and Sybil.

Episodes.Title: Never Have I Ever
Episodes.Description: While quarantining during a bout of COVID, Bunny, Jerry and Arthur play “Never Have I Ever,” where secrets come out that could forever change the group dynamic.

Episodes.Title: Hello, Fisty’s
Episodes.Description: Bunny, Jerry and Arthur return to Fire Island with hopes of hooking up, but the connections they make are not what they expected. Back home, Sybil takes on a scam caller.

Episodes.Title: Maid Serviced
Episodes.Description: Going against Sybil’s advice, Bunny, Jerry and Arthur hire a sexy but unqualified hunk as their new housekeeper.

Episodes.Title: Love Thy Neighbor
Episodes.Description: Bunny, Jerry and Arthur plan to confront their neighbor, a populist congresswoman by day, wild party girl by night. Meanwhile, old friends Sybil and Judy get to the bottom of why they've been annoying the hell out of each other lately.

Episodes.Title: Sour Pickleball
Episodes.Description: Bunny asks Jerry and Arthur to let Mindy join their pickleball team. Meanwhile, Sybil reconnects with an old friend.

Episodes.Title: Here's to You, Mrs. Schneiderman
Episodes.Description: Bunny, Jerry and Arthur deal with a sudden tragedy. Together, they try to figure out how to move on.

Episodes.Title: The Show Must Go On
Episodes.Description: Bunny, Jerry and Arthur decide to make a change in the house, but unexpected guests show up and alter their plans. Meanwhile, Mindy has trouble finding closure.

Entries.Title: The Secret Path
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: mono
Entries.Description: Satsuki Amamiya, a member of the Photography Club, finds herself in a slump as her beloved club president graduates from high school. Her best friend, An Kiriyama, cheers her up, reigniting Satsuki's motivation to give the club her best again. But the 360-degree camera Satsuki bought at an online auction hasn't arrived yet! Satsuki and An pay the seller a visit.

Episodes.Title: mono Trip
Episodes.Description: Satsuki Amamiya, a member of the Photography Club, finds herself in a slump as her beloved club president graduates from high school. Her best friend, An Kiriyama, cheers her up, reigniting Satsuki's motivation to give the club her best again. But the 360-degree camera Satsuki bought at an online auction hasn't arrived yet! Satsuki and An pay the seller a visit.

Episodes.Title: Making of Some Aerial Photography! / Visiting a Classmate, 3000 Leagues - Motovlog Part 12
Episodes.Description: Satsuki and An use a makeshift drone to try some photography when they receive notice that the photography club will be dissolved due to the lack of members. Troubled by this news, they invite fellow classmate Sakurako Shikishima from the Cinema Club, which has also received a dissolution notice. Meanwhile, Haruno is stuck on her manga draft when her high school friend, Kako Komada, pays her a visit. The two hit the road for a tour.

Episodes.Title: Right Before It Becomes an Anime!! The Manga Pilgrimage Stamp Rally with a Schedule from Hell!
Episodes.Description: Haruno gets word of a manga that will be adapted into an anime. As she lives in the real-life location of that manga's story, she scouts out locations and decides to make it a focus for her manga creations. Haruno tries to carry out her plan to visit these manga pilgrimage sites on an ambitious schedule, but the other members of the Cinephoto Club can't seem to hide their unease. And so begins the hellish schedule of this location scouting tour....

Episodes.Title: A Comfy Manga Artist Goes on a Winery Tour - Motovlog Part 13 / Taking Pictures of Food and Getting Full Until We Explode
Episodes.Description: Haruno invites Satsuki and the rest to join an event where they take pictures and eat while walking. The three girls happily accept, thinking it's the perfect event for the Cinephoto Club, but they find out they'll be going around shops that serve generous portions of food to the point they'll be full! They're disappointed in the food brought to them, but this is just the beginning of their fight.

Episodes.Title: The Story of Dry-Cured Ham in Yamanashi / A Haunted Spot and Incident of Possession
Episodes.Description: The dry-cured ham that Haruno was looking forward to enjoying ended up being used as one of the recipe's ingredients! With a little convincing from Kako, the group heads out to buy some famous Yatsugatake ham instead. While on the road, they drop by abandoned places and ski areas here and there, enjoying some Kiyosato curry and visiting a variety of stores that sell ham.

Episodes.Title: Taking the Perfect Picture of a Maruishi Dosojin in Yamanashi! / We'll Enjoy Some Curry in Yamanashi
Episodes.Description: As a story idea for Haruno's manga, the girls participate in a "maruishi" hunting event in the prefecture.

Episodes.Title: First Time for an Anime Adaptation / Calling All Manga Artists! Minobu Walker
Episodes.Description: One of Haruno's manga artist friends, Isuzu, gets her work selected to be adapted into an anime! Worried about the money involved and how busy she'll be, she confides in Kurokuma and Haruno about how uneasy she feels about everything. The girls worry for Isuzu and, as a change of pace, participate in the Minobu Donburi Walk together.

Episodes.Title: Nagano/Toyama Trip That's on the Test (The First Night)
Episodes.Description: Haruno and the Cinephoto Club head to Nagano for a two-night-three-day trip for a scoop. While everyone raises their hand to suggest places they want to go to, An says she wants to film some skateboarding downhill with an action camera. To do this, though, they'll need someone to ride the skateboard with her....

Episodes.Title: Nagano/Toyama Trip That's on the Test (The Second Night)
Episodes.Description: The girls meet up and head over to Kurobe Dam, where they watch a documentary about the dam's construction.

Episodes.Title: Nagano/Toyama Trip That's on the Test (The Third Night)
Episodes.Description: It's the last day, and the group has gone all over Nagano to get this scoop. The group arrives at Togakushi, Nagano, where they try making fresh soba. They break into two teams: adults and children, and have a competition to make some soba! And finally, the group makes their last stop at a Ninja Trick Mansion, but what exactly awaits them there?

Episodes.Title: Enjoying All the Spots on the Yamanashi Shaved Ice Map
Episodes.Description: There are only two days left of summer vacation. As Cinephoto Club reflects upon this past summer, they realize they haven't eaten shaved ice yet! To make this the best summer vacation without any regrets, the group takes one last trip to enjoy all the shaved ice spots listed on the Yamanashi Shaved Iced Map.

Episodes.Title: POV Horror - What ever shall we do?
Episodes.Description: The Cinephoto Club begins shooting a horror film, though not everything is as it seems.

Entries.Title: I Am Married...But!

Episodes.Title: Episode 1

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Fed up with living under her in-laws' roof, I-ling announces she and Xue-you are moving out — a mission that proves to be much harder than she expects.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: While Xue-you works overtime to avoid his wife, I-ling confides in her friends about their marriage problems. The wedge between them grows deeper.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: After a romantic encounter, I-ling returns to her cold reality. Luckily, her mother-in-law's brief departure offers a moment for personal space.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: A guest interrupts I-ling and Xue-you's intimate moment. Later, a surprise power outage leaves them each trapped with unexpected company.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6

Episodes.Title: Episode 7

Episodes.Title: Episode 8

Episodes.Title: Episode 9

Episodes.Title: Episode 10

Episodes.Title: Episode 11

Episodes.Title: Episode 12

Episodes.Title: The Leg Farm

Episodes.Title: Unquenchable Thurst
Episodes.Description: NICE TO PEAT YOU! Pliny dislodges a naturalist from a bog and joins him on a journey of discovery.

Episodes.Description: ELE-FAN-FIC-TASTIC! Sara lies in order to join the kids' "Elephant Triumvirate" book club.

Episodes.Title: Z.O.R.B.Z. (Zorbular Orb Rorb Borb Zorbs)
Episodes.Description: ZORBZ RORB THE BORB! Larry asks Mr. Okay to help unlock the true power of his dud Zorb.

Episodes.Title: Spider-Dog / Messy Golf / To Fly Again
Episodes.Description: Holm and Button pretend to be squirrel-fighting superheroes. A game of golf goes off course when the ball goes missing. A pigeon eats too much dog food.

Episodes.Title: Doggy Kart Race / The Baby-Sitters / Turkey Rush
Episodes.Description: The dogs and toys rev up to race around the neighborhood. Sneaky squirrels plot to swipe Holm's snack. Momo's ball hides inside a delicious turkey.

Episodes.Title: Protect the Sausage Tree / Banana Figure Skating / Dancing King or Queen
Episodes.Description: Holm plants sausages in the ground to try and grow more. Slippery banana peels turn the street into a skating rink. The dog friends have a dance battle.

Episodes.Title: The Birthday Gift / The Golden Treasure Hunt / Soccer Day
Episodes.Description: A pigeon steals a special present. Holm and Button follow a treasure map and find a surprise. A soccer match brings out the pups' competitive sides.

Episodes.Title: Crazy Frisbee / The Missing Bucket List / Stormy Roller Coaster
Episodes.Description: The dogs and their pals have a frisbee catching contest. Someone snatches Holm's bucket list bone. A storm shakes up Holm and Button's camping plans.

Episodes.Title: A Sleepless Night / Bubble Town / Catch That Ghost
Episodes.Description: Janggoon's snoring ruins Holm and Button's sleep. A floating fart bubble threatens to stink up the neighborhood. Holm and Button host a Halloween party.

Episodes.Title: Stick Together / Escaping the Heat / Bath Time Is No Fun
Episodes.Description: A bubble gum balloon goes "pop!" The dogs fight over a block of ice during a heatwave. Victoria and D5 team up to give Holm and Button a bath.

Episodes.Title: Burger Bedlam / The Disastrous Date / Moving Tree House
Episodes.Description: Momo tries to get his paws on a spicy hamburger. Holm goes on a date with Wari — but he can't stop farting! Holm and Button's tree house rolls away.

Entries.Title: Please Put Them On, Takamine-san
Entries.Description: Takamine is basically a goddess. Shirota is like an NPC, but he glimpses her bare breasts. Weirdness ensues...

Episodes.Title: Become My Closet
Episodes.Description: Takamine is basically a goddess. Shirota is like an NPC, but he glimpses her bare breasts. Weirdness ensues...

Episodes.Title: Let Me Redo It Until I'm Satisfied.
Episodes.Description: It's Shirota's first day as Takamine's closet. How is he even supposed to pull off what she's asking of him?

Episodes.Title: I Want You to Enjoy the Very Best
Episodes.Description: Shirota learns how much effort Takamine has put in to be who she is. Later she helps him get first place.

Episodes.Title: Don't Be Dense, Be Sharp.
Episodes.Description: When Shirota gets sick, Takamine nurses him with surprising devotion, making him wonder if it means something.

Episodes.Title: I Want You to Make This Cat Purr, Meow.
Episodes.Description: Shirota is over at Takamine's place, but then the lightning knocks out the power and sends her into his arms.

Episodes.Title: Honey, Let Me Wash Your Back.
Episodes.Description: Takamine and Shirota roleplay newly-weds. She escalates things by joining him in the bath to wash his back.

Episodes.Title: Even That Which Isn't Visible From There
Episodes.Description: Takamine and Shirota talk about the future. When he says he's set on work, not college, she briefly looks sad.

Episodes.Title: You Two Seem Quite Intimate
Episodes.Description: Shirota runs into Ellie, a friend from grade school. They're hanging out in the park where Takamine sees them.

Episodes.Title: Let Me Do It!!
Episodes.Description: Takamine challenges Shirota to a water balloon fight, the loser has to obey the winner. What will it be?

Episodes.Title: It Rains, and Shirota Freezes Up
Episodes.Description: The class will put on the play Cinderella. Naturally, Takamine will be Cinderella, but who will be the prince?

Episodes.Title: I'll Let You Do a Dry Run
Episodes.Description: To calm Shirota's nerves, Takamine goes into the haunted house with him. It works, but now where is Ouji?

Episodes.Title: Only Look At Me
Episodes.Description: Can Shirota make it to the end of Cinderella without messing up? Near the end, something unexpected happens!

Entries.Title: Hell Teacher: Jigoku Sensei Nube
Entries.Description: The town of Domori may be plagued by mysterious phenomena, but things are not going well for Class 5-3's new homeroom teacher Meisuke Nueno, either. Right from the start, Nueno, or "Nube" for short, becomes the target of fifth-grader Hiroshi's bursts of rage. After witnessing something bizarre, Nueno suspects there may be an otherworldly reason behind Hiroshi's sudden personality change.

Episodes.Title: The 99-Legged Bug
Episodes.Description: The town of Domori may be plagued by mysterious phenomena, but things are not going well for Class 5-3's new homeroom teacher Meisuke Nueno, either. Right from the start, Nueno, or "Nube" for short, becomes the target of fifth-grader Hiroshi's bursts of rage. After witnessing something bizarre, Nueno suspects there may be an otherworldly reason behind Hiroshi's sudden personality change.

Episodes.Title: Rampage of the Fox Demon
Episodes.Description: Nueno uses his ultimate weapon Demon Hand to exorcise the Yokai possessing Hiroshi. But suddenly, the mysterious and handsome Tamamo appears, kidnapping Hiroshi right before Nueno's eyes! As Nueno gives chase, Tamamo makes preparations throughout town for an unknown ritual. Just why did he kidnap Hiroshi, and what is his true identity?

Episodes.Title: The Midnight Honor Student
Episodes.Description: An unsettling shadow appears in the school in the dead of night. It's rumored that an honor student is erasing blackboards, replacing flowers of flower vases, and cleaning the rabbit cages when there should be no one there. To get to the truth of the matter, Hiroshi and his friends sneak into the school, only to encounter a voice in the dark saying, "Let's be friends!"

Episodes.Title: The Rokurokubi
Episodes.Description: After witnessing Nueno's amazing power, Miki becomes obsessed with gaining psychic abilities. She even tries to train while sleeping. When her efforts produce an unusual result, she joyfully celebrates her success. However, her friends are far from impressed. In fact, they are scared of what Miki has become.

Episodes.Title: Hatamonba's Curse
Episodes.Description: Katsuya will do anything to make his sister Manami happy, even if it means he has to run around borrowing money. That is how he unwittingly falls victim to the evil spirit Hatamonba's trap. When he realizes Hatemonba's deadly blade is not only pointing at his own neck, but also his sister's, he runs to Nueno for help. However, Hatamonba's sword appears to be mightier than Nueno's Demon Hand.

Episodes.Title: The Teketeke Ghost
Episodes.Description: Fear grips Makoto after he hears about Teketeke, the spirit of a girl who lost her lower body in a railway accident. According to the story, now she wanders the world in search of new legs. Makoto grows desperate for help upon learning that the spirit is coming for him within three days. However, Nueno urges him to forget everything, insisting that Teketeke is nothing more than a myth.

Episodes.Title: The Unseasonable Yuki-onna
Episodes.Description: As unseasonable snow blankets the town of Domori, a beautiful young woman appears before Nueno. Her name is Yukime, and she has come to fulfill a promise she made to him five years ago. Excited by their teacher's improbable romance, Nueno's students sneakily tag along on their date, only to witness Yukime's frosty intentions.

Episodes.Title: Great Inventions and Spirit World Communicators
Episodes.Description: Young inventor Akira finds a broken tablet and becomes even more obsessed with building great machines, as if he is possessed by something. One day, Akira announces he can bring the dead back to life, scaring his friends. Nueno senses something is wrong and investigates Akira's inventions, when he notices something strange within Akira's tablet...

Episodes.Title: The Girl Who Brings Happiness
Episodes.Description: One day, Nube meets a little girl in town. She is a Zashiki Warashi, a spirit that brings good fortune to people. The Zashiki Warashi becomes attached to Nube and follows him to school. From that day on, unexpected good fortune begins to befall his classmates one after another. However, as he sees how the students in his class gradually forget about hard work and start relying on good fortune, Nube finds it difficult to say goodbye to the Zashiki Warashi, but...

Entries.Title: Food for the Soul
Entries.Description: University student Mako Kawai lives a quiet life. Then one day, she's unexpectedly invited to join a club.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the Food Culture Research Club
Episodes.Description: University student Mako Kawai lives a quiet life. Then one day, she's unexpectedly invited to join a club.

Episodes.Title: I Might Want to Cook
Episodes.Description: Mako and the others are told they must hold an activity to show what their club is about or be disbanded!

Episodes.Title: My Money's Gone!
Episodes.Description: Mako and the others decide to go out together on the weekend, but then Shinon's money for the trip disappears!

Episodes.Title: This Is Nana Hoshi
Episodes.Description: Mako accidentally bumps into a scary girl after German class. Later, that same girl shows up at the club room!

Episodes.Title: Want to Go for a Drive?
Episodes.Description: Kurea and Shinon get their licenses, so the club decides to go for a drive... but they end up on the freeway!

Episodes.Title: Could It Be I’ve Gained Some Weight?
Episodes.Description: The club goes out for a day of shopping. When Mako tries on a skirt, she's shocked to find it doesn't fit!

Episodes.Title: I Don't Think I'll Ever Forget
Episodes.Description: The club trip begins! After the train and sightseeing, they plan to use the outdoor oven. But then, it rains!

Episodes.Title: The Air Conditioner Is... Broken?
Episodes.Description: Nana spots her escaped pet in the worst location. Then, one hot day, the club's air conditioner won't turn on!

Episodes.Title: Let's Try Running a Stall!
Episodes.Description: The club decides to have a food stall at the university fair, which means Nana will have to help customers!

Episodes.Title: I'm Home
Episodes.Description: The club takes a trip to Mako and Shinon's hometown. Mako is nervous about meeting her old friends again.

Episodes.Title: Are You Free for Christmas?
Episodes.Description: Three of the club members study late and get locked in the building! Later, the club plans a Christmas party.

Episodes.Title: Thanks for the Feast!
Episodes.Description: The club gathers to give their clubroom a New Year's cleaning. They reminisce and enter the new year together!

Entries.Title: Spy High
Entries.Description: High school sophomore Blake Robbins' entire life changes when he's called into the principal's office and accused of selling drugs. The evidence is a photo of Blake taken in his bedroom. Blake's family files a lawsuit against the school district, causing a media frenzy, triggering an FBI investigation, and exposing shocking new evidence that sends his small suburban township into a furor.

Episodes.Title: Caught in the Act
Episodes.Description: High school sophomore Blake Robbins' entire life changes when he's called into the principal's office and accused of selling drugs. The evidence is a photo of Blake taken in his bedroom. Blake's family files a lawsuit against the school district, causing a media frenzy, triggering an FBI investigation, and exposing shocking new evidence that sends his small suburban township into a furor.

Episodes.Title: Project Green Light
Episodes.Description: The Lower Merion School District hires a prominent law firm to conduct an investigation into the spying allegations. The investigation reveals a startling discovery: over 56,000 images were captured from students' laptop webcams and dozens of students were recorded in their homes. The Robbins' attorney digs further, uncovering disturbing revelations from behind the scenes.

Episodes.Title: Not For Us
Episodes.Description: As the FBI investigate allegations that the Lower Merion School District spied on Blake Robbins, students Keron Williams and Jalil Hassan are notified that photos were taken of them with their laptop webcams. This discovery leads to an exploration of the complicated history of racial inequity in the school district. As the family and community prepare for trial, new obstacles arise.

Episodes.Title: Canary in the Coal Mine
Episodes.Description: When a settlement is reached, uncomfortable truths emerge about the winners and losers of the lawsuit. As the community moves on, the lasting impact on the victims and their families remains, while, today, student activity monitoring software is more prevalent than ever, leading to a host of troubling new consequences that raise the question: are we protecting children or harming them?

Entries.Title: SAKAMOTO DAYS
Entries.Description: Sakamoto enjoys a quiet life in retirement with his family. But one day, an old colleague demands he return to the assassin world — or face consequences.

Episodes.Title: The Legendary Hit Man
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto enjoys a quiet life in retirement with his family. But one day, an old colleague demands he return to the assassin world — or face consequences.

Episodes.Title: Vs. Son Hee and Bacho
Episodes.Description: While out on an errand, Sakamoto and Shin encounter Lu Shaotang, the daughter of a mafia boss, who's on the run and targeted by twin assassins.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Sugar Park
Episodes.Description: After learning of the huge bounty on Sakamoto's head, the crew tries to enjoy a family outing at the amusement park while fending off assassins.

Episodes.Title: Hard-Boiled
Episodes.Description: With the poison-wielding hitman taken out, the Sakamotos head to their next attraction, where they're ambushed by Dondenkai Ltd's ultimate assassin duo.

Episodes.Title: Source of Strength
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto goes all out in a fierce one-on-one duel with Boiled. Meanwhile, ORDER members are tasked with handling a serial case targeting assassins.

Episodes.Title: Heisuke Mashimo
Episodes.Description: Hoping to win the million-yen prize, Team Sakamoto enters the shopping district's survival tournament and teams up with a completely clueless sniper.

Episodes.Title: Jurassic Bastard
Episodes.Description: While manning the store alone, Lu gets kidnapped by a mysterious group. Sakamoto and Shin pursue her but are halted by an invisible assassin.

Episodes.Title: Sakamoto's vs. the Lab
Episodes.Description: To rescue Lu, Sakamoto and Shin infiltrate a top-secret lab seized by assassins. Meanwhile, in the prison cell, Lu meets someone from Shin's childhood.

Episodes.Title: All Aboard
Episodes.Description: In the depths of the Lab, Shin and Heisuke join forces to take down the invisible assailant, while Sakamoto engages in an intense battle against Kashima.

Episodes.Title: Bathhouse Roughhouse
Episodes.Description: Exhausted from their battle, the crew heads to a local bathhouse but finds it too dangerous to relax. Later, a mysterious man arrives in search of Lu.

Episodes.Title: Casino Battle
Episodes.Description: The crew faces Wutang in a high-stakes casino showdown to learn who issued Sakamoto's bounty. Meanwhile, X sends a group of vicious assassins their way

Episodes.Title: Overload
Episodes.Description: As Sakamoto gathers intel on the assassins targeting him, ORDER begins hunting the death row inmates. Later, Shin and Lu face a deadly assault.

Episodes.Title: Just Desserts
Episodes.Description: Saw's attacks push Shin and Lu to awaken new abilities, turning the tables on the deadly killer. Meanwhile, Dump ambushes Osaragi at a temple.

Episodes.Title: Strong Assault
Episodes.Description: The battles rage on even as the crew gets treated by Granny Miya! Minimalist threatens Aoi at the store while Heisuke clashes with Apart at Tokyo Tower.

Episodes.Title: Round and Round the Tower
Episodes.Description: Deadly battles with death row inmates break out everywhere! The Minimalist who attacked the Sakamoto Store is defeated by Nagumo of ORDER, disguised as Aoi, leaving only Apart as the only death row inmate remaining.

Episodes.Title: Slice Slice Dance
Episodes.Description: While X and Gaku invade the JAA, a lone ORDER assassin stands in their way. Amid the chaos, Sakamoto discovers the shocking truth about X's identity.

Episodes.Title: Have a Nice Flight
Episodes.Description: After facing Takamura, X and his men temporarily retreat from the devastated JAA Kanto Branch and begin a new plan. Meanwhile, Sakamoto learns that X is his former JCC classmate, Uzuki. Advised by Hyo, Sakamoto and Shin board a plane to take the JCC transfer exam and search for clues in the JCC data bank.

Episodes.Title: Kanaguri
Episodes.Description: It's every assassin for themselves as the exam takes to the skies. While Sakamoto impresses fellow candidate Akira, Shin takes on the germaphobe Mafuyu.

Episodes.Title: Exam, Stage Three
Episodes.Description: Stage Three of the JCC exams begins as a trio of special applicants joins the fray. Toramaru, a devoted Sakamoto fan, immediately clashes with Shin.

Episodes.Title: Mutual Fans
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto discovers Akira's ties to an old friend. While Shin and Toramaru vie over their favorite assassin, X's secret plans throw the exam into chaos.

Entries.Title: Mama Drama
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Grisaia: Phantom Trigger
Entries.Description: Taiga from the elementary division joins Rena and the others at Mihama Academy Class A. Chris gets named as her higher officer, and she asks Haruto, the handler for the reason. What does Chris think as she carries Taiga on her back after a hard workout?

Episodes.Title: Mother's Cradle I
Episodes.Description: Taiga from the elementary division joins Rena and the others at Mihama Academy Class A. Chris gets named as her higher officer, and she asks Haruto, the handler for the reason. What does Chris think as she carries Taiga on her back after a hard workout?

Episodes.Title: Mother's Cradle II
Episodes.Description: A terrorist attack transpires at the medical university Taiga visited. The perpetrators are members of a new religious group seeking to obtain a virus to be used for bioterrorism. The United Nations decides to conduct an air strike to prevent the virus from spreading worldwide. Receiving the news, Class A was ordered to stay put. However, Chris ignores the order to rescue Taiga on her own.

Episodes.Title: Mother's Cradle III
Episodes.Description: Chris fights the terrorists with explosives but gets shot. Class A heads to the scene after receiving a warning. Class A's operation begins.

Episodes.Title: Phantom Blade I
Episodes.Description: Murasaki's sister, Yuuki, returns to Class A. Rena is annoyed with her, and Murasaki doesn't seem herself. What happened to the sisters in their past?

Episodes.Title: Phantom Blade II
Episodes.Description: Several years before, Haruto visited Yuuki's village to learn "Phantom Blade." One day, the village got ambushed, and Murasaki suspected Haruto.

Episodes.Title: Bluest Blue I
Episodes.Description: Haruto was born by an experiment. He was raised by Ichiru, Nogami, and Aoi Aoi, a group of assassins. Let us look into how "Haruto Aoi" came about.

Episodes.Title: Bluest Blue II
Episodes.Description: Phantom Trigger got a mission to destroy a religious group. Who awaited the team was a very familiar face.

Episodes.Title: Arisaka's Journal
Episodes.Description: Arisaka must decide on Class A's overseas deployment request. Enishi and Chloe awaits Class A.

Episodes.Title: Rite of Passage
Episodes.Description: All SORD forces are called upon. Haruto encounters Chloe. He points his sword to his archenemy who killed Aoi.

Episodes.Title: Heaven's Door
Episodes.Description: Patrick and Bruno meet a group of young Sisters in a dugout. We just want to live...

Episodes.Title: The Right Choice
Episodes.Description: As members of Mihama Academy fight their own battles, former Phantom Trigger makes a big decision.

Episodes.Title: The Fated Answer

Entries.Title: A Killer Among Friends
Entries.Description: Trent DiGiuro, a University of Kentucky football player, is shot and killed while celebrating his 21st birthday with his college buddies. Even though there are many witnesses, no one can identify the killer. Investigators question everyone in Trent's inner circle, but no one can think of a single person who would want to hurt the popular athlete. As the campus reels from the tragedy, Trent's friends fear that the killer was actually targeting one of them and worry that they will come back to finish the job.

Episodes.Title: Friendship in Disguise

Entries.Title: My Dearest Nemesis
Entries.Description: Su-jeong, 19, has been living a hectic life, taking care of her deceased mother's belongings. She meets her first love, 'Black Flame Dragon', in a game she started by chance. However, her first love, which was full of excitement, ends up being the darkest part of her life... 16 years later, Su-jeong, who has become the team leader of Yongseong Department Store, meets the newly appointed head of the headquarters, Ju-yeon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Su-jeong, 19, has been living a hectic life, taking care of her deceased mother's belongings. She meets her first love, 'Black Flame Dragon', in a game she started by chance. However, her first love, which was full of excitement, ends up being the darkest part of her life... 16 years later, Su-jeong, who has become the team leader of Yongseong Department Store, meets the newly appointed head of the headquarters, Ju-yeon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Su-jeong tries to repair her relationship with Ju-yeon, which was wrong from the start, but it is not easy. Su-jeong is just a thorn in Ju-yeon's side, who has a secret he does not want to be found out. Then, Ju-yeon eventually finds out about his private life and the situation changes.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: A large-scale renewal project for Yongseong Department Store is underway, led by Joo-yeon. Joo-yeon and Soo-jeong grow closer as they work together. Joo-yeon's heart also opens up as Soo-jeong begins to understand him. But something happens that disappoints Joo-yeon in Soo-jeong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Eventually, the 'Secret Room' opens. Soo-jung suddenly receives help from Joo-yeon. Joo-yeon's new appearance makes her laugh... Meanwhile, Shin-won does something he's never done before because of Ha-jin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Ha-jin witnesses Su-jeong and Ju-yeon together. They must be separated before they realize each other's identity. Ha-jin's sabotage operation even involves Shin-won! Ju-yeon misunderstands that Su-jeong is interested in Shin-won...

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Why on earth did they kiss? Soo-jung is embarrassed by what happened last night. She believes that Joo-yeon will confess or explain, but Joo-yeon doesn't say anything. Soo-jung, who is upset, decides to go on a blind date with Ha-jin.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Juyeon doesn't hide his feelings for Sujeong. However, Sujeong rejects him due to the 'younger man' trauma. Then Juyeon is about to get caught by Hyoseon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Soo-jung and Joo-yeon finally confirm each other's feelings, and their thrilling secret love begins. It's a love that must be kept secret from everyone, but they're happy that they can be together... What is this ominous feeling? Meanwhile, Shin-won and Ha-jin have a chance meeting at a wedding hall

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Strawberry and Black Flame Dragon meet again. As past wounds resurface, the conflict between Soo-jeong and Joo-yeon deepens. It seems like this is the end... but to make matters worse, a scandal breaks out between the two.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Joo-yeon is fired. In the end, he is abandoned by Hyo-sun and becomes alone. Soo-jeong hides the crisis that is in front of her and tries hard for Joo-yeon. Meanwhile, Ha-jin's ex-husband comes to see him.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Soo-jeong, who lived alone, shouldering everything in order to be recognized and not be ignored. Joo-yeon, who wanted to be loved by her grandmother even while hiding herself. Can the two of them release their respective seals and be together?

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Su Jang turns down an offer to work in the U.S., choosing to stay with Ju Yan, and they receive their happily-ever-after as they are appointed to key positions at Yongsung Department Store. Ju Yan's grandmother, Chairwoman Jang, apologizes to him for her past behavior, and Hyo Seon also makes peace with Ju Yan, leading to a full reconciliation.

Entries.Title: Crystal Wall
Entries.Description: In a world of champagne and opulence, MMA fighter Louna risks her life to save Nico Dardenne, an heir to billions.

Episodes.Title: Blood on Gold
Episodes.Description: In a world of champagne and opulence, MMA fighter Louna risks her life to save Nico Dardenne, an heir to billions.

Episodes.Title: The Job
Episodes.Description: Louna has to face fierce rivals to earn the bodyguard position. Colin harbors doubts, but Nico sees something special in Louna.

Episodes.Title: Day One
Episodes.Description: Louna’s first day as bodyguard becomes a trial by fire, as Colin and Nico ensure her path is strewn with challenges.

Episodes.Title: Fathers
Episodes.Description: When Bernhard collapses, the Dardenne dynasty gathers at his hospital bedside. Nico’s concern for his father is palpable.

Episodes.Title: Mothers
Episodes.Description: Finding herself without a job or a place to live, Louna retreats to her only refuge, the boxing gym. Nico tracks her down, determined to win her back at any cost.

Episodes.Title: Jealousy
Episodes.Description: Louna battles her emotions while chaperoning Nico and Ylva on a double date.

Episodes.Title: On the Fence
Episodes.Description: Samuel forces Louna to face her conscience. Will loyalty to an old friend triumph over new allegiances?

Episodes.Title: The Factory
Episodes.Description: Ghosts from Louna’s past return to haunt her, trapping her between the truth and her deepening feelings for Nico.

Episodes.Title: Decisions
Episodes.Description: Louna begins to trust Nico but soon gains a glimpse into the secret life of the billionaire’s son.

Episodes.Title: Party
Episodes.Description: At a party in Fabian’s apartment, the electricity between Louna and Nico is undeniable.

Episodes.Title: Desire
Episodes.Description: Blissfully in love with Nico, Louna is reminded by Liam of her ultimate goal. Will she sacrifice her heart’s desire and betray Nico for her dream?

Episodes.Title: Betrayal
Episodes.Description: Nico and Louna now each pursue their own goals, but their deep feelings for one another cloud their judgment. Their inner turmoil threatens to destroy everything.

Episodes.Title: Trust
Episodes.Description: After the failed coup, everything hangs by a thread for Louna. The trust between her and Nico lies shattered.

Episodes.Title: Victim
Episodes.Description: Louna and Liam continue to gather information about the factory disaster, slowly piecing it together. But the closer they get to the truth, the more certain they are that Nico is in danger.

Episodes.Title: The Son
Episodes.Description: Nico searches for answers while wrestling with conflicted feelings toward his father. Though Marc proves unexpectedly candid, Louna is the only person Nico needs right now.

Episodes.Title: Shame
Episodes.Description: Following the merger with Dita’s company, the big product launch looms ahead, and Nico must deliver. Yet fresh complications are already brewing on the horizon.

Episodes.Title: Truth
Episodes.Description: Louna makes a discovery about the day her father died. Will she and Nico be able to tear down the barriers dividing them and finally find their way to each other?

Episodes.Title: Game Changer
Episodes.Description: After Louna’s betrayal, Nico rejects her for good. Instead of giving up, she seizes the opportunity and she and Liam make a shocking discovery that could change everything.

Episodes.Title: Two Sides
Episodes.Description: Despite the evidence, Louna remains powerless to expose the truth. Meanwhile, Nico delves deeper into his family’s buried secrets.

Episodes.Title: Kidnapped
Episodes.Description: Louna and Nico cling to fragile hopes for comfort. But reality mercilessly closes in faster than expected, demanding a devastating price.

Episodes.Title: Escalation
Episodes.Description: Time is running out. Nico and Louna risk everything to save Ylva, but their desperate mission puts their own lives on the line.

Episodes.Title: Unmasked
Episodes.Description: While Nico searches for a way to solve all their problems, Marc hatches a ruthless scheme to eliminate every obstacle for once and for all.

Episodes.Title: Flatlining
Episodes.Description: Though she is no longer his bodyguard, Nico needs Louna now more than ever. Time is running out, but she needs to convince Colin first. When the dust settles, will the right people face their downfall?

Episodes.Title: Forever and Always
Episodes.Description: Nico finally feels free, and the only place he wants to be for the rest of his life is with Louna. Yet this freedom comes at a steep price, as the power dynamics within the Dardenne clan have shifted.

Entries.Title: Übel Blatt
Entries.Description: Blatt Meister Ascheriit was slain by his allies and was branded a traitor. Now, 20 years later, he is back with a new name, Köinzell, and a thirst for vengeance. Köinzell arrives at the border wall, Thousand Stonespears, at the Border City of Rielde-Velem. Here, he sets about infiltrating an underground monastery of corrupt monks.

Episodes.Title: Durch Bruch (Break Through)
Episodes.Description: Blatt Meister Ascheriit was slain by his allies and was branded a traitor. Now, 20 years later, he is back with a new name, Köinzell, and a thirst for vengeance. Köinzell arrives at the border wall, Thousand Stonespears, at the Border City of Rielde-Velem. Here, he sets about infiltrating an underground monastery of corrupt monks.

Episodes.Title: Unter Morgen Monde (Under the Morning Moons)
Episodes.Description: During a deadly exchange against Rangzatz, Köinzell is thrust down to the depths of the underground monastery. However, Köinzell had visited this fortress with Ergnach in the past. And now, as Köinzell fends off the elite warrior monks, he releases the magic circle spell his comrade had once sacrificed his life to conjure.

Episodes.Title: Langer Regen (The Long Rain)
Episodes.Description: When Köinzell reaches the Seven Heroes' encampment, he is forced to confront the immense power and glory his former comrades have amassed since they murdered him in cold blood. Despondent, Köinzell is standing in the rain when a masked avenger makes an attempt on his life.

Episodes.Title: Köinzell
Episodes.Description: Chiliarch Fargo invites Wied and Aht to the mayor's manor at night. That night, the two are met by a horde of undead bandits risen through dark Wischtechian magic. Simultaneously, Fargo launches a brutal assault on the refugees, including Peepi. Under the moonlit sky, Köinzell unleashes the power of his Black Sword.

Episodes.Title: Die Burg vom Helden (The Castle of the Hero)
Episodes.Description: Schtemwölech welcomes Köinzell's assault with a powerful blast from Dragon's Maw, a Wischtechian magic artillery. Köinzell diverts its attack and breaches the defenses of the castle.Inside, Geranpen is faced with the ultimate choice: either remain loyal to his Lord or seek out the truth.

Episodes.Title: Schtemwölech
Episodes.Description: In the depths of the castle altar, Schtemwölech had been conducting vile experiments on demihuman girls. By infusing fairyblood to his, the landgrave had attained a physique of steel through a Wischtechian ritual. Now, Köinzell must confront this former friend to put an end to his twisted plan.

Episodes.Title: Der leere Sarg (The Empty Coffin)
Episodes.Description: A state funeral is held to pay tribute to Schtemwölech's glorious rule. Peepi and Altea reconvene with Köinzell, who had taken shelter in the mountains. As the company watch the funeral procession lay the landgrave's coffin to rest at the sacred burial site, Köinzell vows vengeance against the six remaining heroes.

Episodes.Title: Der Heldmörder (The Hero-Killer)
Episodes.Description: In a fit of paranoia, the deranged Batterygrave Barestar commands his men to search for the Hero-Killer in the Free City Jullas-Abllas, where Köinzell sought shelter. Meanwhile, under Glenn's leadership, Elsaria's company hunts for the treacherous rebel.

Episodes.Title: Junge Blätter (Young Leaves)
Episodes.Description: At the Hall of Swords, Glenn entrusts a manhunt mission to Ichfeis, a slave knight vying to restore the title Blatt Meister. Meanwhile, in the Free City Jullas-Abllas, Köinzell's fight against Elsaria and company takes a desperate turn. Eager to prove herself, Aht recklessly charges in, only to sustain an injury.

Episodes.Title: Gegenangriff (Counterattack)
Episodes.Description: Köinzell's stand against the batterygrave's military inspires the townsfolks of Jullas-Abllas to take up arms. Their bravery even convinces Elsaria, the Elector's daughter, to side with the Free City. Just as the tides are about to turn in Köinzell's favor, a powerful blast from a magic artillery cuts through the sky.

Episodes.Title: Gefühl zu… (With Feeling)
Episodes.Description: As Barestar's Floating Castle and magic artillery wreak havoc on all, the people recognize Köinzell's stand to protect the city and call him for what he is, a hero. Meanwhile, Elsaria and company thwart Barestar's men from snatching Marquis Glenn's latest Flagship of the Dragon Airship Fleet, and launch a counteroffensive.

Episodes.Title: Neues Schwert (New Sword)
Episodes.Description: Ichfeis, a slave knight who seeks to earn his freedom, faces Köinzell the Hero-Killer in a fated duel. As they cross blades, Ichfeis coaxes Köinzell to launch the Black Wing, the crowning technique of Ludift-style swordsmanship, and delivers his own imperfect rendition. Köinzell strikes back with a magnificent assault.

Entries.Title: Her Majesty
Entries.Description: Spain, today. After being involved in a financial scandal, King Alfonso XIV decides to step away from the public eye. His provisional replacement as head of the Spanish Monarchy is none other than his only daughter, the irresponsible party girl, Princess Pilar. For a few months, she'll have to act as the head of the State. It's not like she's the best candidate, but she's the only one.

Episodes.Title: The Terrible Princess
Episodes.Description: Spain, today. After being involved in a financial scandal, King Alfonso XIV decides to step away from the public eye. His provisional replacement as head of the Spanish Monarchy is none other than his only daughter, the irresponsible party girl, Princess Pilar. For a few months, she'll have to act as the head of the State. It's not like she's the best candidate, but she's the only one.

Episodes.Title: Buffoon
Episodes.Description: Guillermo, Pilar's secretary, lets her know that her best friend Camino might have compromising materials on her. The princess is incredulous because Camino and her have been friends since they were little. And so Pilar chooses to ignore his secretary's advice and invites her bestie to her first ceremony as head of the Royal Household. However, Guillermo has an ace up his sleeve.

Episodes.Title: Guillotine
Episodes.Description: Pilar and Guillermo work out a deal with a public university so the Princess will be awarded the title of "Distinguished Alumni". It's a delicate matter because she didn't even study there, but the goal is for Pilar to earn the favor of the public opinion. The event has been meticulously planned, but there's one thing that neither Guillermo nor Pilar had prepared for.

Episodes.Title: Townhouse
Episodes.Description: For the first time, Pilar will inaugurate the new judicial year. Although the event is rather bland, a surprise awaits our princess. It's become a tradition for some judges to dine with her father, the king, after the event. Pilar will be hosting this year's lunch as well, but during the meal, she will make a discovery that will completely change the way she views her father and her own life.

Episodes.Title: Richie
Episodes.Description: Richie was heir to the British Crown until one fine day he decided to relinquish his rights to the throne. He's now living as a celebrity, and this week he's traveling to Madrid to release his memoirs. Pilar and him had a passionate affair years ago that, thankfully, didn't make it into the book, but tonight they will reminisce about it, leading to a surprising revelation for our princess.

Episodes.Title: Long Live Pilar!
Episodes.Description: Guillermo's mother has passed away and Pilar attends the funeral in hopes of convincing Guillermo not to quit his job and to come back to the palace with her. But, in the hours before the service, the princess will come to an unexpected realization. She will discover that, for some, the monarchy still means something worthy of upholding.

Episodes.Title: Queen
Episodes.Description: Alfonso XIV has returned to Spain to record the traditional Royal Christmas Speech, in which, rather than abdicating, the King apologizes for putting his immature daughter in charge of the country. The branches of government warn Pilar that her father is out of his mind. They've tried speaking to him, but he refuses to listen. Pilar will have to convince him it's time for him to step aside.

Episodes.Description: Ga-min is passionate about studying and puts all his efforts into it. However, he never received a good grade, which made him go to Yusung Technical High School. Episodes.Title: The School Inspector
Episodes.Description: Ga-min gets into an unexpected fight against Hyeon U, a school bully. As the fight goes on, the two become the center of attention of everyone in school. At that moment, a man enters the classroom that has become a mess because of the two, and it turns out that he is a school inspector. The vice-principal who got furious about the incident decides to expel Ga-min from school.

Episodes.Title: A New Member
Episodes.Description: Someone applied to the study group. Ga Min is excited to meet the applicant, but it turns out that it is Ji U, Hyeon U’s twin sister. Kyu Jin, a member of the student council, picks on Ji U, and Ga Min confronts him. Han Wul tells Hyeon U about Kyu Jin who was blackmailing Ji U. Meanwhile, Ranked 1 among the 1st years comes to see Ga Min.

Episodes.Title: Teach Me How to Fight
Episodes.Description: Jun is impressed by Ga Min who defeated the rankers. He applies to join the study group and asks Ga Min to teach him how to fight. However, Ga Min rejects him because he only wants students who actually want to study in the study group. Jun decides to join the gang to become stronger, but it only gets him in trouble. Ga Min and his friends go to rescue him.

Episodes.Title: A Real Loser
Episodes.Description: The study group is finally complete. But the school’s top student, Kim Ho Min bullies Se Hyun, who grew up in the same neighbourhood. He tramples on Se Hyun’s pride and beats him up, calling him a poor loser. Ga Min steps up to help him, but it only makes Se Hyun feel like a real loser. After refusing to go to Ga Min’s house, Se Hyun wanders around and ends up running into Ho Min.

Episodes.Title: Ga Min’s Transfer
Episodes.Description: Ga Min breaks the curfew that he promised because of Se Hyun, and his mom tries to transfer him to another school. Han Kyeong and the study group, who can’t give up on Ga Min, persistently chase after Ga Min’s mom and try to persuade her. But that’s when the reserves of the Yeonbaek Gang barge in after finding out about Han Kyeong’s plan for Pi Han Wul.

Episodes.Title: Kim Sun Cheol Going to Prison
Episodes.Description: Ga Min runs into Pi Han Ul’s bodyguard, Kim Sun Cheol, at the hospital where his mother is hospitalized. Sun Cheol was working for Pi Han Ul because he needed to take care of his sick grandfather. In order to pay his grandfather’s hospital bills, Kim Sun Cheol decides to go to prison on the false charge of murder instead of Yeonbaek Gang. Ga Min finds out and steps forward to help Sun Cheol with his friends.

Episodes.Title: Midterm Exam
Episodes.Description: The Study Group sneaks into the Reserves General Meeting and struggles against the Yeonbaek Gang. Pi Han Ul forces Kim Sun Cheol to make a false confession to Detective Na Tae Man. Meanwhile, the fated midterm exam finally begins. The Study Group must improve their grades and climb up at least ten places to hold a disciplinary committee against Pi Han Ul. Will they all succeed?

Entries.Description: Renako starts high school determined to leave her introverted self behind and miraculously lands in the top-tier popular group. But keeping up the extrovert act is exhausting. Just as she’s about to break, the school’s princess, Mai Ouzuka, confesses to her!? This isn’t the high school life she imagined!

Episodes.Title: Girlfriends? No Freaking Way!
Episodes.Description: Renako starts high school determined to leave her introverted self behind and miraculously lands in the top-tier popular group. But keeping up the extrovert act is exhausting. Just as she’s about to break, the school’s princess, Mai Ouzuka, confesses to her!? This isn’t the high school life she imagined!

Episodes.Title: First Kiss?! No Freaking Way!
Episodes.Description:
The showdown between Renako and Mai has begun: best friend or girlfriend?

Mai visits Renako as a “friend,” and they have a blast. Friendship is the best!  But Mai’s feelings keep growing. Hoping to prove friendship wins, Renako plans a fun weekend outing. Everything's going great… until a sudden downpour flips everything on its head!?

Episodes.Title: You Can't Freaking Force Me!
Episodes.Description:
Renako tries to forget the kiss, while Mai leaves for work in Paris. Renako walks home with Ajisai after school, holding hands and making plans to hang out later, too. Mai calls her a cheater, but they're not even dating, so how can she be?!

But then when Ajisai comes over, Mai shows up too, bringing her little sister Haruna. Now it’s a chaotic four-person hangout... What could possibly go wrong?

Episodes.Title: Mai?! No Freaking Way! (...Or Maybe?)
Episodes.Description: Mai skips school, and Renako starts to worry... Maybe she really went too far. But then Satsuki calls her in to reveal the truth. Turns out, a heartbroken Mai told her something crazy... She's planning to join a Suitors Party?! How did it come to this?! Renako rushes to the hotel venue, where she and Mai face off… in swimsuits. Now’s the time. Renako has to finally tell Mai how she really feels!

Episodes.Title: Girlfriends? No Freaking Way! (Round 2)
Episodes.Description: Satsuki suddenly drops a bomb: “Let’s be girlfriends.”  It’s clearly revenge for Mai's careless treatment of her. Still, Renako agrees to play along for two weeks if it helps the two make up.  But why does Ajisai seem bothered? No way… right? Meanwhile, Mai’s as calm as ever. Things are shifting with Satsuki, but is it really headed in the right direction?

Episodes.Title: Too Many Freaking Secrets!
Episodes.Description:
Satsuki suddenly starts acting all couple-y in front of Mai, much to Renako's confusion. After seeing an unexpected side of Satsuki, Renako dares to admit she's actually an introvert, only to find out Satsuki already knew. Shocked, Renako runs off, but Satsuki finds her, and somehow she ends up spending the night at Satsuki’s place.

Are they really taking a bath together too!?

Wait, why!?

Episodes.Title: No Freaking Way I’m Surviving This Mess!
Episodes.Description: Thanks to Ajisai-san, Mai finally agrees to talk with Satsuki, and Renako gets roped in as a witness. Just when it seems like they’ll make up, Satsuki drops a secret photo of her and Renako! Wait, what?! Things spiral out of control and somehow it’s turned into an FPS showdown??! There’s no way Renako's losing… absolutely no way…!

Episodes.Title: A Perfect Win? No Freaking Way!
Episodes.Description: After their FPS practice, Renako stays the night at Satsuki’s. “Thanks for letting me face Mai,” Satsuki smiles, making Renako wish they’d just make up already. The long-awaited showdown begins! Mai’s flawless aim, Renako’s sharp instincts… and Satsuki struggling to keep up. But Renako can’t let her lose without a fight!

Episodes.Title: Visiting Ajisai’s House? No Freaking Way!
Episodes.Description: After the troubles with Satsuki settle down, Renako visits Ajisai over summer break... Only to realize that behind her gentle smile are hidden struggles. When Ajisai suddenly declares she’s running away, Renako decides to join her. Their destination: a hot spring! A fleeting summer escape that brings the two closer than ever.
