Episodes.Description: In 1950s Charandaspur, a ritual fails to reach its culmination. In the present day, ex-officer Vikram Singh probes a murder with missing body parts.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 2
Episodes.Description: Officer Rea travels to Charandaspur where she meets Ananya. Vikram confronts someone from his past. A masked figure lurks in the forest.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 3
Episodes.Description: Shastri, a shadow worshipper, reaches out to Rea with an ominous prediction. Vikram learns more about the mandala symbol and its meaning.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 4
Episodes.Description: Haunted by memories of his partner, Vikram teams up with Rea to decode eight mandalas linked to the murders — and to stop a harrowing attack.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 5
Episodes.Description: As Rea searches for the princess's identity, she opens up to Vikram about her fears. Ananya takes charge at home, while Jimmy cracks the next code.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 6
Episodes.Description: Vyankat's revelations leave Vikram shocked and furious. Upon learning that the next victim could be a child, Rea scrambles into rescue mode.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 7
Episodes.Description: In the 1950s, Nandini, a scientist, visits Charandaspur where she meets Rukmini, who brings a sinister warning. Later, she builds a wish-granting device.

Episodes.Title: Chapter 8
Episodes.Description: Vikram is kidnapped to be sacrificed to revive Yast. Can Rea follow in her grandmother's footsteps and stop the ritual before it's too late?

Entries.Title: Sweet Tooth, Good Dentist
Entries.Description: Sant is a broke college student who will take just about any odd job to earn some money. An unexpected expense comes up in his life when he develops a painful toothache.  Sant's best friend Gugg encourages him to check out the university's dental student clinic where Sant reunites with the wacky dentist, Jay.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5

Entries.Title: Undercover High School
Entries.Description: After a botched operation puts Hae-sung and his team in serious jeopardy, the only way for him to salvage his career at the NIS is to accept an assignment that seems almost hard to believe. Hae-sung and his team must infiltrate Byeongmun High School, one of Korea's most elite private institutions, to recover ten tons of gold bars worth a staggering 80 million dollars. With everything on the line, Hae-sung puts on a school uniform, and "Operation Undercover High School" begins.

Episodes.Title: The Emperor's Lost Gold
Episodes.Description: After a botched operation puts Hae-sung and his team in serious jeopardy, the only way for him to salvage his career at the NIS is to accept an assignment that seems almost hard to believe. Hae-sung and his team must infiltrate Byeongmun High School, one of Korea's most elite private institutions, to recover ten tons of gold bars worth a staggering 80 million dollars. With everything on the line, Hae-sung puts on a school uniform, and "Operation Undercover High School" begins.

Episodes.Title: Spooky Stories
Episodes.Description: Hae-sung comes dangerously close to blowing his cover while searching for the hidden gold in Byeongmun High School's eerie old building, barely escaping detection by Soo-ah, his sharp-eyed homeroom teacher. As he hears chilling rumors and faces tight security surrounding the building, he believes that's where he'll find the gold. While dealing with school bullies, Hae-sung begins plotting his next move to uncover the dark secrets lurking inside the old building.

Episodes.Title: Ghost Story Riddles
Episodes.Description: Hae-sung uncovers a crucial clue hidden within the old building, but Chairwoman Seo quickly learns its potential connection to the elusive gold bars. Sensing the connection, she keeps Hae-sung under close watch. Meanwhile, as Hae-sung delves deeper into the ghost stories surrounding the school, he finds himself caught in the escalating tension between Tae-soo and Dong-min, whose conflict ignites chaos throughout the school.

Episodes.Title: Joining the Student Council
Episodes.Description: Hae-sung attends the anti-bullying committee session with a key witness who clears his name, while Dong-min finally finds the courage to stand up for himself. With his name vindicated, Hae-sung uncovers the existence of another grandfather clock hidden in the student council room, and the only way to get closer to it is by joining the student council. With the help of his team, he tries to meet the strict requirements.

Episodes.Title: Student Council
Episodes.Description: Hae Seong and the team grow increasingly concerned that Su A's suspicions could threaten his undercover mission. However, Hae Seong defies the odds and successfully gains a spot in the student council. With this new role, his focus shifts to unraveling the mystery behind the old clocks. Meanwhile, a shadowy figure emerges, threatening to expose Hae Seong's true identity

Episodes.Title: Hye Seong's Father's Notebook
Episodes.Description: The school's security guard dies, leaving Hae Seong a notebook belonging to his missing father. The revelation is shocking, and he storms the NIS for answers. The answer pushes him away from the mission, and he takes time off. However, he resolves to continue but returns only to discover Su A witnessed it all

Episodes.Title: The 24th Anniversary of Byeongmun High School
Episodes.Description: Hae Seong is caught off guard when he recognises Su A's childhood name, Bong Ja, which stirs memories of his first love and distracts him from his focus. Despite the emotional turmoil, Hae Seong pushes forward with the mission to uncover the secrets behind the third ghost story. However, a missing key component forces Su A to join the mission despite Hae Seong's strong opposition to her involvement

Episodes.Title: The Plan for VIP Students
Episodes.Description: After uncovering the possibility of a mole within the NIS, Hae Seong becomes increasingly distrustful of those around him, causing him to question the mission's integrity. Meanwhile, Su A exposes a secretive scheme within the school that guarantees top grades for VIP students. As the web of secrets deepens, Hae Seong uncovers the connection between the gold bars and Chairwoman Seo, prompting him to vow to end her sinister plans

Episodes.Title: The Mathematics Teacher
Episodes.Description: As Su A recovers in the hospital following the attack during the break-in, Hae Seong and the team uncover the culprit: Lee Jun Ho, the mathematics teacher. When Hae Seong detects his father's notebook missing, he realizes that Seo Myeong Ju orchestrated the break-in. After Lee Jun Ho's arrest and confession, the revelation of the school's grade-rigging scandal throws the institution into chaos. Amid the turmoil, Hae Seong stumbles upon a crucial clue to the final scary story.

Episodes.Title: Retribution
Episodes.Description: To everyone's shock, Seo Myeong Ju returns to the school. Unimpressed by Hae Seong, she expels him and demonstrates her power by dismantling his team. However, refusing to back down, Hae Seong and the team, including Su A and her mother, devise a daring plan to infiltrate the school once more to retrieve the hidden gold bars

Episodes.Title: The Devastating Truth
Episodes.Description: The gold bars vanish just as they are within reach, and Seo Myeong Ju suspects Hae Seong has them. In the vault, Hae Seong makes a heartbreaking discovery of his father's remains. Overcome with grief, he finally finds closure, but a shocking truth emerges. He learns Director Kim Hyung Bae was behind it all. Determined to uncover the whole story, Hae Seong heads to confront him alone.

Episodes.Title: Where The Stars Lead
Episodes.Description: Despite getting badly injured, Hae Seong manages to call Su A and his team. They conclude that the only evidence they can secure is the flash drive that contains the voice recording of Principal Park murdering Director Kim Hyung Bae. After finding out that an arrest warrant had been issued for her, Seo Myeong Ju decides to take a special measure to end everything.

Episodes.Description: Ju Ga-ram reemerges after a doping scandal to coach the struggling rugby team at his alma mater — facing pushback from colleagues, players and his ex.

Episodes.Description: Ga-ram risks dismissal after clashing with school staff. After, Yoon Seong-jun quits the team in protest — just before their next match.

Entries.Title: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman
Entries.Description: Beryl Gardenant lives a quiet life running a dojo in the backwaters, until Allucia, his former student, appears with a new job for him – special instructor to the knights she commands! Beryl accepts the job, but Vice-Commander Henblitz doesn’t think he’s up to the task and challenges him to a duel.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes to the Capital
Episodes.Description: Beryl Gardenant lives a quiet life running a dojo in the backwaters, until Allucia, his former student, appears with a new job for him – special instructor to the knights she commands! Beryl accepts the job, but Vice-Commander Henblitz doesn’t think he’s up to the task and challenges him to a duel.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Is Astounded by a Wizard
Episodes.Description: Allucia reminisces about her training with Beryl, and her resolve to have him instruct the knights hardens. While taking in the city sights with Curuni, Beryl meets up with Ficelle, another former student. She surprises him with her magic. But another wizard gives him even more of a surprise!

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Weathers a Fierce Attack
Episodes.Description: Former student and top-ranking adventurer Surena enlists Beryl’s help to train new adventurers. At the Adventurer’s Guild, Beryl ends up in a duel with her to prove he has what it takes for the job. He isn’t really happy with the turn of events, but Surena seems to feel differently.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Takes Flight With a Monster
Episodes.Description: To protect the new adventurers, Beryl faces off against a dangerous monster. Unlike other opponents, it acts on instinct, and he’s drawn into a ferocious battle, unable to get a read on its moves. Later on, he faces an encounter that will turn his future upside down.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets Enraged by the Bad Guys
Episodes.Description: Beryl encounters a pickpocket. Seeing the despair in her eyes, he confronts her in an attempt to get her to open up, but it’s not as easy as he thinks. With the help of Allucia and Lucy, he strives to help her free herself from the clutches of shadowy forces and the evil that binds her.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Faces the Dead
Episodes.Description: Someone is controlling the lowlifes taking advantage of Mewi behind the scenes. Religion and international relations come to the forefront, and with no ties that might cause an international incident, Beryl is asked to flush out the mastermind. New sword in hand, Beryl battles for Mewi’s future.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Learns the Challenges of Parenting
Episodes.Description: Beryl and Mewi start living in the house Lucy gave Beryl. Although unsure, Beryl works on becoming a parent figure for Mewi. When they find out that the magic institute Mewi is enrolled at has a student dormitory, Beryl wonders whether it is best for her to live with him, or on campus.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets Struck by a Lightning-Fast Sword
Episodes.Description: When a delegation from a neighboring country arrives, Allucia asks Beryl to help guard the VIPs, and he can’t refuse. Beryl needs the right clothes for the job, so he and Allucia go shopping. It’s just like a date! The next day, Allucia approaches Beryl with an offer.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes on His First Hunt in Ages
Episodes.Description: Mewi needs a new bag for school, so Beryl goes shopping. But he quickly realizes just how expensive bags can be! A job offer from Surena provides a means to make some extra cash, and he jumps at the chance. But he soon realizes – this job is one even high-ranking adventurers have never completed!

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Guards a Princess
Episodes.Description: The Vice Commander of the Holy Order of the Church of Sphene is Beryl’s former student, Rose, and he renews his ties with her. When the delegation arrives, Beryl is assigned to guard the two royal families as they tour the capital. But a shadow looms over what is supposed to be a joyous event.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Throws Himself into a Deadly Fight
Episodes.Description: Beryl helps protect the royal family from assassins, but the assassins all kill themselves, and any clues to the mastermind are lost. Lucy thinks a conflict between royalty and religion is at play. Despite Beryl wanting to cancel the tour of the capital to keep the prince safe, the plan goes ahead.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets Praised as a Master Swordsman
Episodes.Description: It was Rose behind the flood of assassins. Beryl confronts her in an effort to find where her true intentions lie. Rose tells him, and the two draw their swords against each other. What will the outcome be in this battle between master and student?

Entries.Title: Cute High Earth Defense Club Hi-CARA!
Entries.Description:
Once upon a time, there was a hero who protected the Earth from a great crisis... And now, in the face of another crisis, a new hero is born from Binan High School's "Earth Defense Club"! ...Huh? Who were those former heroes? Well, it was "those guys", "those guys". ...Huh? Why are you blurring out the names? It's a multi-verse setting, so mumble mumble... (vague)　

Anyway, the new defense department - Unzen Shinkuro, Sukayu Narushi, Unohana Sousuke, Oshamanbe Ushio and Aso Akuta.

Once upon a time, there was a hero who protected the Earth from a great crisis... And now, in the face of another crisis, a new hero is born from Binan High School's "Earth Defense Club"! ...Huh? Then, before them appears the "Ban-CARA Avant Guard Corps", an Earth Conquest Club led by the mysterious prairie dog Master Kyan. Their true identities are none other than Doumeki Straight, Nyutou Samon and Nekoma Tasuku, roommates at the Kurotama Dorm and members of the Binan High School Student Council. With lies and enemies under the same roof, it's impossible for something not to happen... right?

Entries.Title: Bullet Bullet

Despite their poverty, the people use remnants of past civilizations to lead resilient lives. Gear works in a junk shop while also retrieving stolen goods alongside the robot Qu-0213 and White Bear, a gambler.

Episodes.Title: Beyond the Horizon
Episodes.Description: In the near future, civilization has collapsed, and the world has become a wasteland. Despite their poverty, the people use remnants of past civilizations to lead resilient lives. Gear works in a junk shop while also retrieving stolen goods alongside the robot Qu-0213 and White Bear, a gambler.

Episodes.Title: You Decided to Do It
Episodes.Description: The city is abuzz with the news that a grand theft has been carried out by Gear, White Bear, and Qu-0213. On the run from the police, the three culprits return to the junk shop, only to fail to receive their reward.

Episodes.Title: I Learned Not to Trust People
Episodes.Description: With one assassin after another hot on their trail, Gear, White Bear, and Qu-0213 find themselves fleeing from intense pursuit. They cannot get hold of Noah, and their beloved car, Bullet, is running dangerously low on gas. The trio must quickly devise a plan to escape the mess they are in.

Episodes.Title: We Are Your Family
Episodes.Description: Reunited safely with Noah, the trio hands over the requested item, only to find that it is not what Noah wanted at all. The real treasure is a completely different item.

Episodes.Title: You Fool
Episodes.Description: Gear is left crushed by a sense of helplessness after Noah is kidnapped. Gear stumbles across a Gotcha spinoff titled, "The Escape Story of the Great Villain Road." Watching the unstoppable determination of the hero stirs something within Gear, reigniting his resolve.

Episodes.Title: You Have the Right to Know
Episodes.Description: After Gear, Qu-0213, and Noah are arrested by the capital's police and separated from White Bear, they are taken underground, facing imminent execution. However, at the last moment, their restraints are mysteriously removed.

Episodes.Title: Time to Get to Work
Episodes.Description: Shaken with sorrow and anger after learning the truth, Gear and his friends decide to collaborate with the Resistance, determined to expose the government's secret to the world. As the day of the operation approaches, they work tirelessly to prepare for the challenges that loom on the horizon.

Episodes.Title: The World Is Much Bigger, Tougher, and Uglier
Episodes.Description: Gear and his team race to escape with the top-secret government data they have stolen, but Barrel blocks their path, announcing that their plan has already failed. Gear, driven by an unshakeable determination to change the world, refuses to give up.

Episodes.Title: That Guy Is Like Spinach Stuck in Your Teeth
Episodes.Description: Captured by the National Security Agency, Gear, White Bear and Qu-0213 are imprisoned in an extremely cold and desolate facility. Stripped of their freedom, each of the three is forced to confront their personal struggles and the harsh realities of their situation.

Episodes.Title: I Have Discovered a Way Only I Can Change the World
Episodes.Description: Following their failed escape attempt, Gear, White Bear, and Qu-0213 are imprisoned on a secluded island surrounded only by the sea. As they adapt to life behind bars, they unexpectedly cross paths with the assassin Cook siblings.

Episodes.Title: Do Not Stop Moving Forward
Episodes.Description: Gear and his comrades, joined by the assassins and the Resistance, race toward the capital at full speed. However, their path is blocked by the government’s autonomous security system. To make matters worse, the capital’s police forces launch an assault from both the ground and the skies.

Episodes.Title: Bullet/Bullet
Episodes.Description: After a fierce struggle, Gear, White Bear, and Qu-0213 finally reach the deepest part of the capital’s underground. To destroy the core of the system, they head through a door, eventually arriving in a pitch-black space. A spotlight flickers on, revealing a mysterious figure.

Entries.Title: The Divorce Insurance
Entries.Description: For genius actuary Ki-jun, divorce was the worst disaster of his life. Determined to turn it into an insurance product, he forms a team with his recently divorced neighbor, Han-deul, as an underwriter, and his ex-ex-ex-wife, Na-rae, as a quant. Thus, the divorce insurance project officially begins.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: For genius actuary Ki-jun, divorce was the worst disaster of his life. Determined to turn it into an insurance product, he forms a team with his recently divorced neighbor, Han-deul, as an underwriter, and his ex-ex-ex-wife, Na-rae, as a quant. Thus, the divorce insurance project officially begins.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: The team is astonished to learn that Na-rae, who joins the task force as a special advisor quant and a senior managing director at Plus General Insurance, is also Ki-jun’s ex-ex-ex-wife, though the two seem surprisingly unfazed. As the team pairs up to gather data for the divorce insurance policy, Ki-jun takes Han-deul to an unexpected place seemingly unrelated to their research.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: The team works tirelessly, fully dedicated to developing a divorce insurance policy. After much effort, the team finally secures conditional approval. But to everyone’s dismay, Ki-jun leads them to a wedding fair to meet their subscriber target. However, Han-deul suddenly cancels all sign-ups at the fair, abruptly halting the plan for reasons unknown.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: When Han-deul bumps into Ki-jun, weary from a run-in with his former brother-in-law, they begin to understand each other's demons of the past. Meanwhile, Na-rae and Jeon-man click and spark a mutual attraction, and Ah-young meets dancer and farmer Woong-sik on a blind date. However, as the task force gains momentum, they face a new challenge— rising divorce rates among their clientele.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Ki-jun and Han-deul rush to resolve a complaint that their divorce insurance subscription event violates industry regulations. Meanwhile, a policyholder couple's decision to get a divorce breaches both industry regulations and company conditions. The task force scrambles to locate the couple, only to discover that the husband, who holds the key to saving the divorce insurance, is missing.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Ki-jun and Han-deul get lost searching for Hyeon-jae when a looming shadow sparks fear—could the rumored tiger be real? They find Hyeon-jae just in time and escape. Upon reuniting with the team, they notice Mi-rae has come for Hyeon-jae but keeps her distance. With village head Woong-sik’s help, they find lodging and work to mend the couple’s rift while reflecting on their past and future.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: "Would you like to live at my place?" In an effort to make Han-deul feel more comfortable, Ki-jun suggests they swap homes. Thanks to his thoughtful gesture, she gradually regains her self-esteem. However, when an elderly couple files for divorce, the divorce insurance faces a new challenge, sparking a heated debate within the team over the implications of late-life divorce.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Ki-jun and Han-deul have no choice but to explain their situation when Na-rae and Jeon-man catch them living in each other's homes. Meanwhile, evidence of Young-kyu's affair comes to light, voiding his divorce insurance subscription. This development helps the project avoid another crisis. However, for some reason, Han-deul suddenly tries to dissuade Seon-hee from proceeding with her divorce.

Thriller, starring Katherine Kelly

Episodes.Title: A Cute Junior
Episodes.Description: At a part-time job interview, Naoto meets Umezawa Makina, a junior from middle school and the ace of the track and field club. When Makina finds out that Naoto doesn't have a smartphone, she forcefully takes him to buy one, but once he gets the phone, the first person he calls is Murasaki. Makina, who went on to join the track and field club at a prestigious girls' high school in Tokyo, has actually fallen into a slump and has been skipping club activities. Seeing that Naoto seems happy, unlike her, Makina plots to make him break up with her and become her toy to kill time...

Episodes.Title: The Fireworks
Episodes.Description: Makina, who is showing off to her club members by saying she is going to the fireworks festival with her boyfriend, asks Naoto to play the role of her boyfriend. Naoto recommends Tokui for the role and makes an arrangement to meet Murasaki, who is going with some local friends, on the way. On the day of the fireworks festival, Naoto and Murasaki sneak out of the festival midway and head home as it starts to rain. Soon, the downpour begins to pour, and the two seek shelter at Naoto's house, where they find Satsuki, who has come to take care of her vegetable garden out of concern for it. Everyone is soaked, and the three of them end up staying at the house for the night, but...

Entries.Title: Overcompensating
Entries.Description: Benny Scanlon arrives at Yates and makes fast friends with Carmen at Orientation. Will Benny and Carmen be more than friends? Or will the fact that he’s totally… you know… get in the way? His sister Grace hooks him up with unflavored vodka for his pregame, while her boyfriend, Peter, imparts sage senior bro wisdom: get laid day one or suffer the consequences. The stakes couldn't be higher tbh.

Episodes.Title: Lucky
Episodes.Description: Benny Scanlon arrives at Yates and makes fast friends with Carmen at Orientation. Will Benny and Carmen be more than friends? Or will the fact that he’s totally… you know… get in the way? His sister Grace hooks him up with unflavored vodka for his pregame, while her boyfriend, Peter, imparts sage senior bro wisdom: get laid day one or suffer the consequences. The stakes couldn't be higher tbh.

Episodes.Title: Who's That Girl
Episodes.Description: Benny and Carmen scour the campus for fake IDs so they can join the rest of the freshmen class–including certified HOTTIE Miles–at Rock Bar. Peter comes through for Benny but not even Carmen's party girl roommate, Hailee, can help her out. Peter flakes on date night at the local Italian restaurant and Grace befriends an elderly woman (for her volunteer hours, duh!). Hailee throws up.

Episodes.Title: Black and Yellow
Episodes.Description: Benny gets noticed by a secret society and will stop at nothing to get his bestie / security blanket, Carmen, the same attention. Lucky for them, it's alumni tailgate weekend so she gets to show off her legendary drinking prowess. Peter gets some sobering news from a coked out "brother" and Grace reconnects with Mimi, who is back from her semester abroad. What sport is this tailgate for again?

Episodes.Title: Boom Clap
Episodes.Description: Benny gets caught in a lie so our main besties are in a fight. That won't stop Carmen from basking in her new legend status from the tailgate. While Grace works the Charli xcx concert, Peter hazes the F&G male pledges. Meanwhile, Carmen is psychologically tortured alongside the female pledges. :/ Oh! And the episode ends with "party 4 u"!

Episodes.Title: Scary Monsters and Nice Sprites
Episodes.Description: It's Halloweekend and Benny is still on the outs with Carmen so he and Miles have been getting… closer. Carmen and Hailee reconcile just as the latter enters her bad girl era. Grace calls Peter out for treating her like an assistant. Tensions (sexual and otherwise) rise at the annual Chem Party. But who will go home with who (or is it whom)? This episode is so good.

Episodes.Title: The Edge of Glory
Episodes.Description: Carmen expertly avoids confronting her disastrous love life while trying to help Benny with his. Grace confides in Janet who pushes her to explore other romantic endeavors. Peter does something drastic that's gonna make you go "oh my god dude" at the end. Oh, and Hailee has mono!

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the Black Parade
Episodes.Description: Carmen tags along with Benny and Grace for an Idaho Thanksgiving, complete with karaoke, a fist fight, and some ghosts from the past. We are nothing if not consistent! Benny regresses in front of his dad, while Carmen and Grace start to understand each other a bit more over some vodka crans and onion rings. But Carmen is still keeping her devastating secret...

Episodes.Title: Crown on the Ground
Episodes.Description: It's finals week and relationships are put to the test (get it?). Carmen forces Benny to explain his web of lies, Grace makes a discovery, Peter goes to get what's his, Hailee wants to know where her performance enhancing meds are, and Miles wonders what he did wrong. Answers lead to more questions at the final Bader House party of the semester... your jaw is gonna be on the floor, sweetheart!

Entries.Title: Par de ideotas
Entries.Description: Vadhir and José Eduardo open a pop-up bar, but with high expectations and tough new business challenges, disaster looms on the very first week!

Episodes.Title: Cero Experiencia
Episodes.Description: Vadhir and José Eduardo open a pop-up bar, but with high expectations and tough new business challenges, disaster looms on the very first week!

Episodes.Title: Bar de ideotas
Episodes.Description: The bar is back up and running, but now José Eduardo is nursing a hangover while trying to plan next night's theme. Vadhir is trying to stop his mom from ruining Ladies Night when she shows up unexpectedly.

Episodes.Title: Terciopelo y números rojos
Episodes.Description: Vadhir's mom crashes the party, and to make matters worse, José Eduardo invites Vadhir’s ex without telling him. The accountant also tells the brothers that they’re in the red! All hands are on deck to try to recover the money.

Entries.Title: Murder Most Puzzling
Entries.Description: When a murder takes place in the sleepy market town of Bakerbury, the police are baffled by a crossword puzzle left on the body. With their case going nowhere, they turn reluctantly to Cora Felton, a recent arrival, whose fame as a newspaper puzzle writer suggests she can help DCI Hooper and the local police unravel the clue and solve the case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: When a murder takes place in the sleepy market town of Bakerbury, the police are baffled by a crossword puzzle left on the body. With their case going nowhere, they turn reluctantly to Cora Felton, a recent arrival, whose fame as a newspaper puzzle writer suggests she can help DCI Hooper and the local police unravel the clue and solve the case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: It's Cora's birthday and she's fed up. It's been too quiet since she jailed The Graveyard Killer and she's itching for another mystery to solve, so Cora is thrilled when Becky hires her to investigate a case.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Wealthy businessman, Ray, and his dynamic wife Gloria, have sponsored Dennis Pride to play a gig in Bakerbury. Meanwhile, Cora is distracted by love, as she's wooed by a charming suitor, Gilbert. When Sherry says he seems too good to be true, it causes a rift between the women but plants a seed of doubt in Cora's mind.

Entries.Title: Fight For Love
Entries.Description: After breaking Thang’s camera, Binh works at a café to repay him. Will sparks fly when Thang joins the café, or is it the start of a love battle?

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: After breaking Thang’s camera, Binh works at a café to repay him. Will sparks fly when Thang joins the café, or is it the start of a love battle?

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Thang discovers Van and Khanh's relationship, but what will happen when Binh finds out the truth? Will this incident bring Thang and Binh closer?

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: After Binh discovers his boyfriend's affair with his best friend, will Thang's support lead their relationship to blossom?

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: When Thang’s first love reappears, jealousy stirs. Could this be the beginning for Thang and Binh?

Entries.Title: This City Is Ours
Entries.Description: Michael and Diana try for a baby. Meanwhile, his criminal empire faces a shocking betrayal from within after a shipment of Columbian cocaine is intercepted.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Michael and Diana try for a baby. Meanwhile, his criminal empire faces a shocking betrayal from within after a shipment of Columbian cocaine is intercepted.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: As Ronnie and Jamie grow closer, Michael fears he is being usurped. Tensions escalate, and Michael makes a big decision.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Chaos ensues in the aftermath of a shocking death. Michael takes control, and the gang agree to smuggle the body back to Liverpool. Aboard the ferry, tension and suspicion runs rife.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Back in Liverpool, tension brews as Michael assumes leadership. Meanwhile, Michael and Diana's IVF is successful.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: An unexpected player causes trouble for the gang. Diana wants to be honest with Michael about her past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Michael and Jamie agree to a winner-takes-all fight to decide who leads the gang, while a disappointed Diana has reached her wits' end.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Michael and Jamie's rivalry is pushed to the limit, causing Michael to reevaluate his life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Jamie remains suspicious of Michael, despite his attempts to walk away. Jamie goes rogue, leading to a gripping final showdown.

Entries.Title: Apocalypse Hotel
Entries.Description: Yachiyo and her staff are ready to welcome you to the Gingarou Hotel... except there's nobody left on Earth.

Episodes.Title: A True Hotel Is Always Storied
Episodes.Description: Yachiyo and her staff are ready to welcome you to the Gingarou Hotel... except there's nobody left on Earth.

Episodes.Title: Tradition Evolves with Innovation and Experimentation
Episodes.Description: The Gingarou Hotel gets its first guest in over a century, but he's not human! Do aliens even count as guests?

Episodes.Title: A Smile Is the Ultimate Ambiance
Episodes.Description: A group of humans return to Earth... but not all is as it seems.

Episodes.Title: Food and Etiquette Are Mainstays of Culture
Episodes.Description: Yachiyo and Ponko head out in search of new ingredients.

Episodes.Title: Provide Unlimited Hospitality in Limited Time
Episodes.Description: A new pair of aliens arrive at the hotel, but the shortage of alcohol will be a problem.

Episodes.Title: Our Only Vice Is Service
Episodes.Description: The end times have come to Earth... and it seems they will be staying at the Gingarou Hotel?

Episodes.Title: Bow Down Deep But Always Aim High
Episodes.Description: The gang decides to launch a satellite for promotion, but Ponko has other ideas.

Episodes.Title: Discipline with a Fist! Reconcile with a High Five!
Episodes.Description: What happens after Yachiyo gets stranded in space?

Episodes.Title: Bookmark Today's Page in Our Guests' Lives
Episodes.Description: After reconciling with Yachiyo, Ponko has some news to share.

Episodes.Title: Clean Sheets Symbolize Pure Hearts
Episodes.Description: The Gingarou receives an unnerving guest who requests total secrecy about his visit...

Episodes.Title: Wag Your Tail, but Never Wag a Shift!
Episodes.Description: Labor standards say Yachiyo has been overworked, and Ponko demands that she take time off.

Episodes.Title: Aim to Be the Number One Hotel in the Galaxy
Episodes.Description: Gingarou and Earth receive a visit from an old, old friend.

Entries.Title: Stingers
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Dept. Q
Entries.Description: DCI Carl Morck returns to work after a near-fatal incident and finds himself head of a new department. A prosecutor faces a tough day in court.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: DCI Carl Morck returns to work after a near-fatal incident and finds himself head of a new department. A prosecutor faces a tough day in court.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: As Carl and his new assistant start digging into their first cold case, he can't stop his personal demons encroaching on his professional life.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Carl and Akram recreate the fateful ferry journey on their way to the Isle of Mhòr. A frustrated Rose makes her case for joining their Department.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Rose goes to the island to find out what Carl couldn't. Akram finds a note which sends the investigation in an entirely new direction.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: The prosecutor's disappearance becomes connected with a death. A scuffle in a newspaper office sees Carl making headlines, and Moira sees a therapist.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: The police detain a suspect for the Leith Park shooting. Carl returns to the scene of the crime, before losing his temper in public once again.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Carl makes some dangerous allegations to some powerful men, while Rose takes a fresh angle to uncover more information about Sam Haig.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The kidnappers give their victim a clue as they press her for an answer to their question. Dept. Q gets closer to unravelling its own riddle.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: A decades-old recording helps all the clues to fall into place. But as the pressure rises — in and out of the chamber — can Carl get there in time?

Entries.Title: The Beginning After the End
Entries.Description: Having defeated countless enemies, obtaining wealth, fame, and everything else imaginable, the most powerful king, Grey, abruptly dies one day. He then awakens suddenly, having reincarnated in a world where magic exists. He is given the name Arthur, and begins living a second life, with loving parents.

Episodes.Title: The Rebirth of the King
Episodes.Description: Having defeated countless enemies, obtaining wealth, fame, and everything else imaginable, the most powerful king, Grey, abruptly dies one day. He then awakens suddenly, having reincarnated in a world where magic exists. He is given the name Arthur, and begins living a second life, with loving parents.

Episodes.Title: The King, Under Attack
Episodes.Description: The Leywin family travels to the floating city of Xyrus so that Arthur can begin his formal education in magic. The adventuring party that Reynolds and Alice belong to, the Twin Horns, accompany them as guards, when they run into something unexpected...

Episodes.Title: Meeting the King
Episodes.Description: During the battle with the bandits, Arthur falls off of a cliff. When he awakens he encounters a mysterious beast, clad in armor. Her name is Sylvia. She helps Arthur, and seems to know where his family is, but who is she really...?

Episodes.Title: Saved by the King
Episodes.Description: Having parted ways with Sylvia, Arthur hears a girl's scream in the woods. Upon rushing to the voice, he encounters an elf girl named Tessia, who has been captured by slavers. With Sylvia's words to "seek light in his new life" ringing in his ears, Arthur decides to challenge them by himself.

Episodes.Title: The King's Test
Episodes.Description: Arthur arrives in the Elenoir Kingdom with Tessia, before being arrested by elvish soldiers who harbor deep resentment toward humans. Things are looking tense until Elenoir's former ruler, Virion, has him released. Arthur is then invited to the kingdom's castle. But the pain in his mana core seems to be getting worse...

Episodes.Title: The King's Training
Episodes.Description: After being informed of a way to let Reynolds and Alice know about his survival, Arthur joins Virion and they head to a witch's house. Using special sorcery, he is able to see his parents. Witnessing the depth of their grief, Arthur decides that he will train under Virion to protect those he cares about, and to control the dangerous power growing within him.

Episodes.Title: The King Says Goodbye
Episodes.Description: It's been three years after Arthur began his training in the Kingdom of Elenoir, having worked alongside Tessia as they both grew stronger. Arthur enlists Virion's help in order to awaken the beast that slumbers within his mana core. Then, one night, the stone Sylvia gave him begins to shine…

Episodes.Title: Reunited with the King
Episodes.Description: Having arrived in the city of Xyrus, Arthur is thrilled to meet his younger sister, Eleanor, and to reunite with his parents. While sparring with Reynolds, he demonstrates how much he has grown. After witnessing Arthur's strength, Vincent Helstea proposes that the reborn king enroll in Xyrus Academy, a prestigious sorcery school.

Episodes.Title: The King Teaches
Episodes.Description: Vincent and his wife Tabitha are hoping to enroll their daughter, Lilia, in Xyrus Academy. And while Lilia hopes to live up to her parents’ expectations, she has yet to awaken her mana. In the meantime, Arthur runs into a group of the academy’s students while shopping in town.

Episodes.Title: The King’s Defiance
Episodes.Description: The Helstea Auction, which even the royals of the Sapin Kingdom attend, is opened. Vincent invites Arthur to the auction house. While among valuables on offer, Arthur discovers Sylvie has gone missing, and that she’s attracted the attention of a court sorcerer in the service of the Sapin Royal family!

Episodes.Title: The King’s Decision
Episodes.Description: Having arrived at Xyrus Academy, Arthur displays his skills to the school’s director, Cynthia, who proves to be every bit as formidable as her position as the head of the prestigious magic academy suggests. Despite being overwhelmed, Arthur still shows his power and the two strike a deal...

Episodes.Title: The King’s Departure
Episodes.Description: Donning a mask and taking up the alter-ego of Note, Arthur arrives at the guild to begin service as an adventurer. He has new encounters meeting Elijah, a young boy with ties to dwarven royalty, and Lucas, a half-elf member of the Sapin royal family. Afterwards, Arthur and Jasmine leave on their first adventure together. In order to protect those he cares for, the king seeks even greater power.

Entries.Title: Your Forma
Entries.Description: The main suspect in a recent assault case turns out to be Harold. However, during Harold's interrogation, someone else attacks his flatmate, Darya. Echika "Brain Dives" into Darya's "Your Forma" where she sees the attacker's face—which is identical to Harold's.

Episodes.Title: Mechanical Friends Amicus Robots
Episodes.Description: The main suspect in a recent assault case turns out to be Harold. However, during Harold's interrogation, someone else attacks his flatmate, Darya. Echika "Brain Dives" into Darya's "Your Forma" where she sees the attacker's face—which is identical to Harold's.

Episodes.Title: A Black Box
Episodes.Description: While interviewing Lexie, Echika receives a report about the ongoing investigation. It only strengthens her suspicions towards Harold. Echika decides to get to the bottom of this case, but shortly after, something unexpected happens to her.

Episodes.Title: Pursuit
Episodes.Description: It seemed like the investigation had advanced after apprehending Furman, but instead the case ends up taking a new turn. After further deductions, Echika and Harold arrive at a place where…

Episodes.Title: Regret
Episodes.Description: Echika, having realized Furman's true motives, discovers the shocking truth…and it's a huge secret involving Harold.

Episodes.Title: Persona
Episodes.Description: Echika feels uneasy from keeping the major secret about Harold. In the meantime, posts targeting the Cybercrime Investigation Department have been exposed on a message board.

Episodes.Title: Father and Daughter
Episodes.Description: Echika and her team found the spot where E's followers meet up. Bigga, who's helping with the investigation, can't contain her shock when she sees a certain person there.

Episodes.Title: Flower of Fire
Episodes.Description: The forces of evil hadn't stopped with the explosion at Totoki's apartment, they've also been creeping up on Echika. Once again, she finds herself in danger, and Harold takes on the taboo…

Episodes.Title: Fiction
Episodes.Description: Cyber-Inspector Echika and Assistant-inspector Harold once again partner up. Thanks to Harold's strategy, the real villain has finally come to light, but behind the culprit lies an unexpected truth.

Episodes.Title: The Nightmare of Petersburg
Episodes.Description: The time has come to reveal Harold's past. Once a wandering, lost Amicus, Harold was taken in by Sozon and began working alongside him as a detective. But then a gruesome case that would later be known as "The Nightmare of Petersburg” shook their world...

Episodes.Title: Footsteps of the Nightmare
Episodes.Description: After receiving an incomprehensible report from Totoki, Echika, and Harold head to the municipal police to find out the truth. It turns out that the report was about a phone call from someone who was never supposed to be able to reach them…

Episodes.Title: Replay of the Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Echika and Harold grow more and more suspicious upon learning that Abaev was the one who received the digital clone requested by Elena. At the same time, another incident once again mimicking the "Nightmare" takes place. The victim this time turns out to be someone completely unexpected.

Episodes.Title: Manifestation of the Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Harold and Bigga notice what all the victims from these attacks have in common from the message Echika left behind. They identify who and where the culprit is, and rush to rescue the abducted Echika, but…

Episodes.Title: Dawn of the Nightmare
Episodes.Description: It's time for Harold and Echika to confront each other. Echika tries to reason with Harold, who's burning with the desire for revenge. In the end, Harold comes to a decision, and―

Entries.Title: With Vengeance, Sincerely, Your Broken Saintess
Entries.Description: Rua, who is called the defective saint, risks her life to save her beloved Garrot. However, her achievement is stolen by her best friend Arian, and the two become engaged. Having lost everything, Rua vows to take revenge on those who believed in her.

Episodes.Title: Scarred Saint
Episodes.Description: Rua, who is called the defective saint, risks her life to save her beloved Garrot. However, her achievement is stolen by her best friend Arian, and the two become engaged. Having lost everything, Rua vows to take revenge on those who believed in her.

Episodes.Title: Darkness of the Temple
Episodes.Description: After being betrayed by Arian, the second prince, Sven, appears before Rua. Sven proposes revenge, and Rua learns of the shocking dark secrets of the temple.

Episodes.Title: Suspicious Figure
Episodes.Description: In search of the cause of the magical beasts' attacks, Rua sneaks out of the room at night and finds suspicious figures.

Entries.Title: Tasokare Hotel
Entries.Description: Neko Tsukahara wakes up in a vast, desolate wilderness, where the twilight stretches to the horizon. She has no memory of who is or how she ended up there. Suddenly, the "Tasogare Hotel" appears behind her. Upon entering, she is greeted by a manager with a head on fire. Unsure whether she's alive or dead, Neko begins searching for a way to regain her memories, when a mysterious guest arrives.

Episodes.Title: Twilight Girl
Episodes.Description: Neko Tsukahara wakes up in a vast, desolate wilderness, where the twilight stretches to the horizon. She has no memory of who is or how she ended up there. Suddenly, the "Tasogare Hotel" appears behind her. Upon entering, she is greeted by a manager with a head on fire. Unsure whether she's alive or dead, Neko begins searching for a way to regain her memories, when a mysterious guest arrives.

Episodes.Title: The Bet of a Lifetime
Episodes.Description: Neko Tsukahara decides to work at the "Tasogare Hotel", a place that exists between the worlds of the living and the dead. Under the guidance of Atori-senpai, she begins her strange life there. One day, a guest with a love for gambling and a pachinko ball for a head requests a game of mahjong. Later, as she tries to tidy up his cluttered room, an old black telephone suddenly starts ringing...

Episodes.Title: The Blood-Soaked Pansy
Episodes.Description: Neko Tsukahara is settling into her job at Tasogare Hotel. Hoping to prove herself, she volunteers to assist a new guest—a man with a pansy-shaped head and an unsettling vibe. After escorting him to his room, Neko searches for clues to help him recover his memories. She soon discovers that in the living world, he was a medical student and part-time detective named Masaki Osoto.

Episodes.Title: Friendship and Responsibility
Episodes.Description: Neko Tsukahara and Haruto Atori guide two unusual guests—one with a kendo mask for a head and the other with a smartphone head—at the Tasogare Hotel. Clues in their rooms reveal the women were childhood friends and members of the same high school kendo club. As their rooms transform, they gradually recover memories of their shared past and the events that brought them to the Tasogare Hotel.

Episodes.Title: The Seaside Ash-covered Princess
Episodes.Description: Neko and Ruri escort a loving couple to an ocean-view suite, where the woman has a sudden realization. While searching, they find a Cinderella script, sparking memories of the couple's past, though their fate remains unknown. As Osoto and Neko discuss the relationship's oddities, a piercing scream from the woman echoes through the hotel.

Episodes.Title: Space and Music
Episodes.Description: A rocket-headed boy and a black cat wander into Tasokare Hotel. The boy chases the cat around, desperate to befriend it, but never catches it. The cat keeps its distance yet stays close, silently watching over him. Just then, a record-headed guest appears and cheers up the boy. As they play, the boy realizes this man is the legendary saxophonist who once inspired Atori to pursue music.

Episodes.Title: A Carousel and Brass Knuckles
Episodes.Description: Neko runs into Ruri as she is about to leave her room. Looking inside the room, Neko learns what happened to Ruri in the living world. Then a woman with a brass knuckle head arrives at the hotel. She seems disinterested in searching her room for clues, but eventually Neko learns that the woman is a single mother. And Ruri starts to notice similarities between her own mother and the new guest…

Episodes.Title: The Idol Girl
Episodes.Description: National idol group 365 Sister Q (aka 3Q)’s Kaneko Konomi arrives at the hotel. Neko is thrilled to meet her longtime idol. Unlike other guests, Kaneko’s face remains unaltered, and she still has her name and memories. During a meal, a radio in the restaurant suddenly airs 3Q’s press conference - revealing Kaneko’s fate. She entrusts Neko with her final, unfulfilled wish.

Episodes.Title: A Girl's True Face
Episodes.Description: With Konomi Kaneko’s long-lost solo performance - her final wish - approaching, Neko scrambles to gather band members. She repeatedly tries to convince Atori to join as the saxophonist, but he refuses due to a painful past. Can they pull off the concert and send Kaneko off to the afterlife as she wished? As emotions clash, the stage is set for a night of fate and farewells.

Episodes.Title: The Hidden Room
Episodes.Description: After successfully pulling off Konomi Kaneko’s live show and making peace with Atori, Neko suddenly recalls a past-life incident, though the details remain unclear. Meanwhile, Atori mentions Osoto's complaints about room service. Curious and unconvinced, Neko heads to the room alone, notices something has changed, and as she digs deeper, she uncovers a hidden room…

Episodes.Title: Handguns and Hell
Episodes.Description: Neko discovers a hidden room belonging to Osoto, where she finds a diary listing new victims and countless photos of Atori from the living world. Convinced he’s scheming something at the hotel, she prepares to stop him. Kiriko tells her about a special handgun in the manager’s office and determined, she confronts Osoto, demanding to know why he’s obsessed with Atori even now.

Episodes.Title: Revenge
Episodes.Description: In the heat of battle, Osoto is shot and killed. As a consequence, Atori is dragged into the depths of Hell. Blamed for the tragedy, Neko is fired and sent back to the living world. She finds out that her salary from the hotel is paid in hours, and Ruri approaches her with a request. Given a chance to turn back time, Neko returns, determined to face Osoto one last time.

Entries.Title: Fred and Rose West: A British Horror Story
Entries.Description: Fred West is taken into custody and questioned about his missing daughter. After he initially denies everything, the horrifying truth starts to emerge.

Episodes.Title: Fred
Episodes.Description: Fred West is taken into custody and questioned about his missing daughter. After he initially denies everything, the horrifying truth starts to emerge.

Episodes.Title: Rose
Episodes.Description: As the investigation unfolds, the police learn more about the couple's dark, twisted relationship — and deduce that Fred couldn't have been acting alone.

Episodes.Title: The Trial
Episodes.Description: The search for bodies extends beyond Cromwell Street and the police uncover evidence which shows that Rose may be more involved than they ever suspected.

Entries.Title: Bookish
Entries.Description: There's a new assistant to train up at Book's Books, but the excavation of a nearby bombsite that's full of skeletons leads to book-selling taking a back seat.

Episodes.Title: Slightly Foxed (1)
Episodes.Description: There's a new assistant to train up at Book's Books, but the excavation of a nearby bombsite that's full of skeletons leads to book-selling taking a back seat.

Episodes.Title: Slightly Foxed (2)
Episodes.Description: Bliss and Book's investigation into Harkup's death continues as Book discovers some surprising evidence in the case of the bombsite skeletons.

Episodes.Title: Deadly Nitrate (1)
Episodes.Description: There's excitement in the air when a film crew arrives at Archangel Lane - until an extra drops dead after eating poisoned chocolates meant for one of the cast.

Episodes.Title: Deadly Nitrate (2)
Episodes.Description: Book must race against time to uncover the truth before anyone else ends up dead. Meanwhile, Jack gets an unexpected answer when he confronts Trottie and Book.

Episodes.Title: Such Devoted Sisters (1)
Episodes.Description: A grand hotel, exiled royalty, a poisoned army captain and Trottie as a suspect. Could this prove to be Book’s toughest case yet?

Episodes.Title: Such Devoted Sisters (2)
Episodes.Description: As tension builds, the staff rebel and the Walsingham Hotel lists like an old ship, can Book unmask Captain Orr’s murderer?

Entries.Title: Hunter with a Scalpel
Entries.Description: One of the bodies entrusted to Seo Se -hyun, a promising soup autopsy. The thread sutured with the smell of rocks in the body reminds me of her past. Jung Hyun, the head of the strong team, is in charge of the investigation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: One of the bodies entrusted to Seo Se -hyun, a promising soup autopsy. The thread sutured with the smell of rocks in the body reminds me of her past. Jung Hyun, the head of the strong team, is in charge of the investigation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Se -hyun, who visited the body organic field with Chung Hyun, recalls the traces of his dead murderer, Yoon Jo Kyun. Meanwhile, after visiting Yongcheon site, Oh Min -ho, the team member of Se -hyun, continues the absence for a few days.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: In Yongcheon, a carcass with a thread is found, and the identity of the body is found to be the missing team of Sehyun. Sehyun, who discovered the same technique and clues in the second body, feels that the bacteria are back.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Chung Hyun, who arrested an innocent citizen as a suspect, is hit by the media, and Se -hyun, who helps him, announces a serial murder. Sehyun, who reveals his existence to Cho Kyun, tries to stimulate him and pull him over the surface.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Sehyun installs a temporary autopsy in Yongcheon and chases traces of the bacteria. That night, Sehyun finds a third carcass in front of his studio. Sehyun tells Cho Kyun, who celebrates his birthday, and tells him to start playing in the future.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Sehyun finds his childhood photographs planted by Cho Kyun in the third body and is shocked. Se -hyun, who is in a hurry by the caught clue, heads to Hae -ryong, who lived with Jo Kyun in the past. There, there is a faces of Cho Kyun and his new murder assistant, Se -eun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Jung Hyun's investigation expands to the “Cheongwoon Port Incident”, where Se -hyun and Cho Kyun were together. In the investigation situation, Se -hyun suggests that Cho Kyun is making a fake criminal. However, Sehyun falls into a trap from the address sent by Cho Kyun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Sehyun, who managed to deal with the trap of Cho Kyun, meets Jocyun at the appointment. On the other hand, Jung Hyun finds out that Se -hyun hid the outcome of the drug and doubts.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Jung Hyun is confused by the suspicious circumstances of Se -hyun, and Cho Kyun makes a full war to isolate Sehyun. Se -hyun, who has been seized and searched for the sin for deceiving the result of the drug, chooses silence in front of Jung -hyun, who asks for the truth.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Sehyun is a suspect of all murder in Cho Kyun's careful manipulation, and even Hyun -hyun pursues Sehyun. Se -hyun, who is at a corner, heads to a nursing hospital with a mother -in -law, and finds the situation where Cho Kyun went there. Sehyun decides with the last battle and heads to the residence of Joseun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: An attempted murder occurs at a laundromat, and Se-hyeon is wanted. Jeong-hyeon, who has been suspended from duty, decides to conduct an independent investigation. Meanwhile, Se-hyeon, who was captured by Jo Gyun and imprisoned in a truck, encounters Se-eun, the girl who replaced him, and gets caught up in a horrific family game.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Jeong-hyeon, who got closer to the truth through the living victim, tracks down Jo Gyun's truck. Se-hyeon and Se-eun devise a way to escape from the truck.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: Jung-hyun is in danger due to a serious injury. Se-hyun is forced to make a crucial decision to protect Se-eun, and let the world know that there is another victim, Se-eun, who is still suffering.

Episodes.Title: Episode 14
Episodes.Description: Se-hyeon confesses his past to Jeong-hyeon. The two decide to work together to capture Jo Gyun. Meanwhile, Jo Gyun threatens Se-hyeon using Se-eun's life as an excuse.

Episodes.Title: Episode 15
Episodes.Description: With Se-eun's whereabouts unknown, Se-hyeon becomes enraged, believing that Jo-gyun has already killed the girl. After receiving Jo-gyun's message, Se-hyeon escapes the hospital and tracks down Jo-gyun. Jeong-hyeon sets out to find Se-eun.

Episodes.Title: Episode 16
Episodes.Description: Despite his injury, Jeong-hyeon does not give up on finding Se-eun to keep his promise to Se-hyeon. At the same time, Se-hyeon faces Jo-gyun at the Mujin Tidal Flat and is faced with a final choice.

Entries.Title: Nine Bodies in a Mexican Morgue
Entries.Description: Nine people survive a plane crash into the Mexican jungle. But they don’t know that a murderer lurks in their midst… Nine days later, their bodies are recovered by the Mexican army. One of the passengers is missing...but who?

Episodes.Description: Nine people survive a plane crash into the Mexican jungle. But they don’t know that a murderer lurks in their midst… Nine days later, their bodies are recovered by the Mexican army. One of the passengers is missing...but who?

Episodes.Title: Black Angels
Episodes.Description: Alliances form, enemies are made and lines are drawn as the passengers search for food and water; but when another passenger dies, they realize they may all be targets.

Episodes.Title: Rapido
Episodes.Description: The survivors work out how to call for help - but are faced with a treacherous climb; as some of the group begin to crack under the pressure, a third death - the most violent so far - warns that they are running out of time.

Episodes.Title: The Short Straw
Episodes.Description: The deadly secret hidden in Flight CBZ517 is discovered, but it still doesn't explain the murders or help the survivors escape; the passengers believe they have found the traitor in the group - but are they right?

Episodes.Title: Cloud Cover
Episodes.Description: Air authorities search desperately for the plane and federal agencies spring into action; as the group becomes smaller and smaller, the last survivors know they are going to have to fight to stay alive.

Episodes.Title: Body Bags
Episodes.Description: A high-octane showdown between the killer and one of their supposed victims reveals the secrets of flight CBZ51.

Episodes.Title: The Maharaja and the CEO.
Episodes.Description: The Royal BnB launch coincides with a painful anniversary for Sophia. After Aviraaj's coronation, a letter from his father reveals a shocking secret.

Episodes.Title: The Maharaja who Loved.
Episodes.Description: Reeling from her recent betrayal, Sophia goes missing. After Aviraaj confronts Padmaja about his father's secret, Diggy and Jinnie share their own.

Episodes.Title: Lights, Camera, AUCTION!
Episodes.Description: A steadfast Sophia throws her efforts into a fundraiser for the palace. Padmaja confronts the mysterious Maurice, and family secrets come to light.

Episodes.Title: The Cat and Pumpkins
Episodes.Description: Fuji's twin brother, Teru, and his pregnant wife, Wako, leave their cat at Fuji's.

Episodes.Title: The Cry

Episodes.Title: A Secret

Entries.Title: Medalist
Entries.Description: When former figure skater Tsukasa Akeuraji meets a self-taught skater, Inori Yuitsuka, he tries to persuade her to join a formal ice skating club. Unfortunately, Inori's mother wants her clumsy daughter to give up skating altogether.

Episodes.Title: A Genius on the Ice
Episodes.Description: When former figure skater Tsukasa Akeuraji meets a self-taught skater, Inori Yuitsuka, he tries to persuade her to join a formal ice skating club. Unfortunately, Inori's mother wants her clumsy daughter to give up skating altogether.

Episodes.Title: Prelim Badge Test
Episodes.Description: Tsukasa and Hitomi encourage Inori to take the Badge Test, a certification exam for figure skating which will allow Inori to qualify for competitions. On the day of the test, Inori meets a beautiful girl who looks like a princess.

Episodes.Title: Taiyaki and Cake
Episodes.Description: Tsukasa decides to enter Inori into the Meikoh Cup to build up her record of success. When Inori feels shy dancing in front of others, Tsukasa gets her to dance in his shadow to conquer her nerves. During skating practice, Inori also meets a girl named Miké at the rink.

Episodes.Title: Meikoh Cup, Junior Women's Prelim Free Skating (1)
Episodes.Description: Inori's first competition, the Meikoh cup, begins. Inori's future is at stake, and while she gets off to a rocky start, her mother and sister are there to support her from the sidelines.

Episodes.Title: Meikoh Cup, Junior Women's Prelim Free Skating (2)
Episodes.Description: Inori came in top in the first round of the Prelims, whereas Miké was the last one to secure a spot. Determined to turn things around, Miké decides to try and pull off a double rotation combination that no one at the Prelims has done before.

Episodes.Title: The Night of the First Competition
Episodes.Description: Hikaru is one of the best performers of Inori's generation, and Inori is eager to catch up. However, she worries about how far behind she is in terms of her skill level compared to others her age. Tsukasa suggests Inori compete in a competition immediately after passing the level one badge test.

Episodes.Title: Level One Badge Test
Episodes.Description: Inori faces the level one badge test, setting her next step of competing in a championship. A successful double jump will be essential for a high score.

Episodes.Title: Western Powerhouses (1)
Episodes.Description: On the way to a competition, Inori leaves her skates on a train by accident. Tsukasa goes on a mad hunt for the skates ten stations away.

Episodes.Title: Western Powerhouses (2)
Episodes.Description: After a smooth start, Inori decides to take each jump carefully, one by one. She controls her center of gravity and maintains a high speed, and Tsukasa cannot hide his excitement as she continues with her flawless performance.

Episodes.Title: Howling at Night
Episodes.Description: Inori competes in her second Meikoh cup, but she will need to perfect the extremely difficult double Axel if she is to progress to the next level. Meanwhile, Tsukasa is asked by Olympic silver medalist Shinichiro Sonidori to mentor his son, Rioh.

Episodes.Title: Dance the Night
Episodes.Description: The Lux Higashiyama FSC summer training camp begins, and Inori plans to perfect her double Axel. Meanwhile, Tsukasa offers to help Rioh, but Rioh turns him down.

Episodes.Title: Shirone's Lesson
Episodes.Description: Tsukasa learns of the anguish Rioh has been carrying, and dances Rioh's program on the rink. Rioh is surprised to see that Tsukasa's skating is much more skillful than he expected.

Episodes.Title: Morning Arrives
Episodes.Description: The day of the Level Six Badge Test has finally arrived. The venue is the memorable place where Inori first met Hikaru. When Hikaru suddenly appears, she promises to meet Inori again at the All-Japans.

Episodes.Title: SOS from South Sudan
Episodes.Description: Facing a malpractice investigation, Kang-hyuk's crisis doubles: save a critical patient and defend his reputation. After, he embarks for a case abroad.

Episodes.Title: Patient: Baek Kang-hyuk
Episodes.Description: Amid flying bullets, Kang-hyuk leads his team to save a military captain. Upon his return, he suddenly finds his life in the hands of his protégés.

Entries.Title: I, Jack Wright

Episodes.Title: Fight Like Hell

Episodes.Description: As Sally's legal challenge runs into trouble, her friendship with Arnaud takes a darker turn. With the court date approaching, Rose and Bobby come to a momentous decision.

Episodes.Title: Salt in the Wound
Episodes.Description: A revelation threatens to ruin not only Sally's legal challenge, but the entire bedrock of her family life. Meanwhile, DCI Morgan closes in on his prime suspect.

Episodes.Title: Testament
Episodes.Description: Sally faces the wrath of an increasingly unhinged Arnaud. Elsewhere, Rose shocks Bobby by taking a huge risk, and DCI Morgan finally brings charges for the murder of Jack Wright.
